notes.title: Version 2.1.4 Update Announcement (September 24)
notes.notes:
Dear Metas,
The Version 2.1.4 server maintenance and update is planned for September 24 at 4:00 PM (PT) and expected to last about 2 hours (actual time may differ). Please plan your game time accordingly for the best experience. The update size is approximately 14.49GB for the PC launcher, around 634MB for the PC client (Note: If there is a delay in the Steam platform's push, repeated downloads may occur), about 3.5GB for Android, and approximately 4.7GB for iOS (actual sizes may vary). It is recommended to perform the update in a Wi-Fi environment!

This update includes the new Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve scenario, Visional Wheel S2: Lunar Revelry, updates to airdrops, fresh combat content, an S2 limited-time event, Lightforge Loot Crate: Rimecold Sovereign, Lightforge Loot Crate Comeback: Choose 1 of 3, various optimizations such as construction mirroring, and bug fixes.

After the maintenance, the following rewards will be issued: Starchrom ×1,000, Mitsuko's Mark ×100, Starwish Token ×300, Butterfly's Emissary Crate II ×1, Blueprint Conversion Attempt ×3. A new Shop discount coupon: Spend 500 Crystgin and save 150!

Below are the details of this update:


Content/Feature UpdatesDeviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve – A new scenario in Early Access
Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve, a brand-new scenario, will be launched in Early Access! Become the first explorers to venture into a world of Deviation companions!

* Early Access Details: Due to significant gameplay differences between scenarios, we've decided to preview new scenarios in Early Access before their official launch to ensure the best quality. Our aim during Early Access is to gather as much feedback as possible to make the game more fun and engaging. Therefore, we hope you'll share your thoughts and suggestions through the Feedback Platform. We'll check your feedback regularly and use it to optimize the scenario. Thank you for helping us to improve Once Human! (Feedback Platform:反馈平台链接)

Delve into a Deviation ecosystem

Deviations can be found in every corner of this world. It's clear that they're the ones in charge! Some Deviations may even hide their tracks following special rules. You must craft unique capturing items and learn each Deviation's habits to secure them all!

Awaken Deviation abilities

Having broken free from the Cradle, Deviations will not join you as lively companions! Whether in exploration, combat, or territory work, each Deviation has unique abilities to unleash. Our old friend Chefosaurus Rex deals Burn damage over time. The Digby Boy is no longer limited to mining, but can continuously knock back enemies and provide a shield when you're low on HP. Meanwhile, Enchanting Void can transform into a black panther with unpredictable attacks. Unleash the potential of your Deviations!

Customize your Deviation team

Strategy is everything! You can form a team of up to three Deviations. Mix and match their unique traits to create battle squads for various situations.

Engage in Deviation battles

Challenge the NPC-run arenas, or go head-to-head with other Metas in thrilling real-time matches! The key to victory isn't strength, but your bond with your Deviations!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/d3a3148d8d3a7977bb6d2a8ca5b0684b778f1abe.jpg"]

Secure the Chaos Deviations

Hidden across the world are powerful Chaos Deviations with strange forms and terrifying power. They are the source of this world's troubles! Your task is to uncover their mysteries and secure them for good.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/62a3f7a84bc250de7e26454bb45bca8e481c61fb.jpg"]

Deviation Fusion

The highly anticipated Deviation fusion system will make its debut in Early Access for Deviation: Survive, Capture, Preserve! You can fuse Deviations with each other, or even with animals and furniture, to create unique entities with interesting and amusing traits.

* Deviation fusion will be available in all non-RaidZone scenarios.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/2882ee95271daf0431f617887439affdced4f0ef.png"]

For more information, refer to the Deviation scenario dev blog:

Visional Wheel S2 – Lunar Revelry
The Visional Wheel turns, and a crimson moon rises once again, bringing stronger forces to bear upon Nalcott. The Blood Moon will manipulate Nalcott for its amusement, provoking conflict among humans with tempting treasures. Only by defeating its avatar, the Lord of Moonlight, will you earn the ultimate reward.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/5067a4720f2b41fa8a15ac1bc60ce09aced90951.png"]

Visional Wheel Period: September 24, post-update (PT) – End time TBD

Affected Scenarios: Manibus (excluding novice), Evolution's Call, Prismverse's Clash, The Way of Winter, Endless Dream

Every day from 7:00 PM to 7:00 AM (30 minutes in real time, double that of S0: Lunar Oracle), as day turns to night, the Blood Moon will rise over Nalcott. During this time, Deviants will grow stronger, and Meta-Humans will be infected with Lunacy, diminishing their Sanity.

Rules:

1. While in Lunacy, Metas of at least Lv. 20 with Lunar Whispers will be subject to the moon's gaze. When the gaze's intensity reaches a certain level, the Lord of Moonlight will try to attack you and steal some of your Lunar Whispers before fleeing. Watch the map to pursue it!

2. The Lord of Moonlight will summon Lunarspawn to defend itself. When it's near death, it will also use an Adrenaline Shot and gain the ability to clone nearby Metas to confuse you.

3. The Lord of Moonlight's strength scales with the number of participating Metas. In some situations, the Lord of Moonlight has a chance to transform into a stronger \[Phantom] Lord of Moonlight.

4. After the Lord of Moonlight is defeated, the Lunar Whispers it stole will be recovered by their original owner, who will also receive a certain percentage of bonus Lunar Whispers.

5. The Lord of Moonlight drops a chest upon defeat. Metas who participated in the battle and the original owner can open the chest.

6. In Endless Dream, the Lord of Moonlight is unaffected by Dream Zones, keeping its difficulty in line with other scenarios.

For more information, refer to the Blood Moon dev blog:

S2 Lunar Revelry – New gear and mods

NOTE: This content is not available in RaidZone, which will receive separate new weapons.

New weapons

1.SKS - Pathfinder: Guaranteed to trigger Frost Vortex on hit. Has a cooldown. Each hit reduces the cooldown.

▪ Chance to generate Deviant Particles on hit (picking them up puts you in a Charging state). Increases the maximum number of Charging stacks.

▪ While Charging, consume Deviant Particles to fire an ice spike that pierces enemies, dealing Frost Elemental Weapon DMG based on Attack (benefits from Frost Vortex bonus, reduced DMG against Metas).

▪ Increases Frost Elemental DMG. Each charged shot further increases Frost Elemental DMG.

2. PDW90 - Holographic Resonance: Chance to apply The Bull's Eye on hit.

▪ Every few hits, triggers an explosion dealing Weapon DMG equal to a percentage of Attack to enemies within 8m (reduced DMG against Metas).

▪ Reloads some bullets when the explosion hits a target with The Bull's Eye.

▪ Increased Crit Rate against targets with The Bull's Eye.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/f5efc33d5a3d2c6550e72a91c18e5a63fc4807b8.png"]

New armor

1. Snowdrift Top: Upon picking up Deviant Particles, grants additional charge and increased Weapon DMG and Status DMG.

2. Bloodstained Tracker Boots: When applying The Bull's Eye to an enemy already marked by The Bull's Eye, your Attack increases for some time, and The Bull's Eye spreads to one other nearby enemy.

New sets

Savior Set

Set effect:

1 piece: Medicine cooldown reduced.

2 pieces: When shielded, Weapon DMG and Status DMG increase.

3 pieces: Consumes a percentage of current HP on hit to generate a temporary shield equal to a percentage of Max HP, lasting some time. (Has a cooldown; does not trigger if Shield exceeds 40%.) When HP drops, Weapon DMG and Status DMG are increased for some time.

4 pieces: Automatically uses the least potent Activator in the backpack when HP is below 30% (has a cooldown).

New mods

1. Added the Lunar Revelry exclusive mod suffix: Crescent.

Suffix Effect: As your Shield increases, you gain Crit DMG, Elemental DMG, Weapon DMG, and Status DMG buffs.

2. Adjusted the effects of the Rejuvenating and Against All Odds mods.

Cradle: Some Cradle effects will be adjusted to fit the new Visional Wheel season.

For more information, refer to the combat dev blog:

New EventsS2 limited-time event – Omen of Affliction
NOTE: This event is available on open Visional Wheel servers.

Event Period: September 24, post-update (PT) – End time TBD

Unite across sectors to fight the Lord of Moonlight and claim the hidden treasures!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/0cad30961963856a79cb4aa46211670544ec3513.png"]
[p align="center"](* Content is under development. Final version may differ.)

Rules:

1. The Blood Moon will divide Nalcott into sectors. Metas in each sector must band together to defeat the Lord of Moonlight. If you defeat the Lord of Moonlight within the event period, you will gain Lunar Essence, which you can submit to earn an equal number of sector points.

2. To encourage participation and challenge their teamwork, there will be seven rounds of 2v2 trial matches between sectors. When submitting Lunar Essence, you can vote for a Lunar Omen to inflict the opposing sector. This will affect the abilities of their Lord of Moonlight. There are six Lunar Omens in total. The more Lunar Essence your sector submits, the stronger the omen's effects. The three Lunar Omens with the most votes will take effect in the opposing sector, creating different levels of difficulty.

3. Each round of matches lasts one week. The sector that earns the most sector points during this time will earn 1 victory point. Unite to resist the Blood Moon and receive the ultimate glory!

* As the Lord of Moonlight is a formidable opponent, sectors will be divided by time zone (region) to make it easier for you to challenge it together. You can check your sector on the event screen.

RaidZone content updatesContent/feature updates (RaidZone)
Airdrops

Aerial Loot will be renamed to Echoite Crates after this update, bringing new and improved airdrop mechanics! Fights for resources are about to become more exciting and strategic! The highlights are as follows:

1. Optimized the airdrop mechanic. Now, Rosetta Echoite Transporters will spawn on the map, flying between large strongholds and dropping Echoite Crates at random. Predict their flight paths, then deploy and wait along their routes. Strategy is the key to victory!

2. Echoite Crates will deploy a parachute and descend slowly after being released. When an Echoite Crate lands, Metas can open it and retrieve its contents. Once an Echoite Crate appears, you can view its location on the map.

3. Added a new item: Airdrop Flare. It can be obtained as a chance drop from Rosetta Boss Elites or by opening Realm Crates. The more advanced the Realm Crate, the more likely it'll contain an Airdrop Flare.

4. Using an Airdrop Flare will summon an airdrop at its location. After some time, one Echoite Crate will drop at the marked point. Be careful, because using an Airdrop Flare may expose your position!

New Weapons - RaidZone Mode

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/218d5174a8b84c9ecfc5893b0baee344ee629038.png"]

1. Nail Gun

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/f0eb943441d48216436d64a6440616cdc6efb3e6.png"]

Submachine gun. Has a slow fire rate and short range, but it's cheap and easy to make, making it perfect for close-quarters combat in the early game.

This weapon can be unlocked with very few Memory Chips and crafted at a Primary Gear Workbench or better. Its Memetic is located below the Rusted Blade.

The Nail Gun uses exclusive ammunition, Nail Gun Bullets, that can be retrieved like arrows.

DMG per shot: 13

Fire Rate: 400

Magazine Capacity: 18

2. SKS

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/bf0c9f74f874cc7315ccfd066c1d088f4308ff5d.png"]

Sniper rifle that uses medium-caliber ammunition. High recoil but fast max Fire Rate, ideal for mid-range burst suppression.

Its Memetic is located below the MPS7. It can be crafted at an Intermediate Gear Workbench or better.

DMG per shot: 30

Fire Rate: 257

Magazine Capacity: 15

3. PDW90

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/a9701363aab45c84b6fc36cae527d1cfd9012fd4.png"]

Submachine gun that uses small-caliber ammunition. Boasts rapid fire and a large-capacity magazine, with a compact design perfect for close-quarters combat.

Its Memetic is located below the Tactical Rifle Scope. It can be crafted at an Advanced Gear Workbench.

Damage per shot: 12

Fire Rate: 800

Magazine Capacity: 50


Optimizations - RaidZone Mode
Combat

1. Memetic adjustments:

1) Added the Nail Gun, SKS, and PDW90 Memetics.

2) Removed the SOCR Memetic. You can no longer craft SOCR weapons, but can still find them in the wilderness.

3) Moved the KAM Memetic below the PDW90, replacing the SOCR's role. Its rarity has been increased from Rare to Epic, and its DMG increased from 15 to 18. You can still use any KAM weapons you own.

2. Balance adjustments:

1) Weapon trajectory and spread adjustments:

a) All weapons' OTS field of view +20%

b) All weapons' ADS field of view -10%

c) All weapons' bullet velocity (excluding sniper rifles) +20%

Currently, players prefer over-the-shoulder (OTS) aiming for mid-range combat as it has low bullet spread and a wider field of view. We want players to use different aiming methods based on distance, mixing and matching them with various weapon accessories and ammo types. Hence, we've increased the initial bullet velocity for all weapons (except sniper rifles) and adjusted the bullet spread for both OTS and ADS views.

In November (PT), we'll introduce phased bullet trajectories. At close range, all weapons will fire in a straight line, providing more immediate feedback during close-range combat. At medium to long range, bullets will still have travel speed and bullet drop. Stay tuned!

2) Light machine gun optimizations:

Currently, light machine guns don't feel very different from assault rifles in combat, but have a larger bullet spread. This doesn't justify their high crafting cost. We'll optimize light machine guns to provide sustained suppression at medium to long range, synergizing with their high bullet velocity and large magazine capacity. Their bullet trajectory and recoil will also become more stable the longer you fire:

a) MG4

Magazine Capacity: 60 → 100

Reload Speed: 33 → 12; Duration: 4.2s → 5s

Switching Weapons Duration: +10%

OTS/ADS Movement Speed: -10%

During continuous fire, bullet spread gradually decreases, and recoil gradually stabilizes.

b) KVD - Boom! Boom!

Magazine Capacity: 65 → 100

Switching Weapons Duration: +10%

OTS/ADS Movement Speed: -10%

During continuous fire, bullet spread gradually decreases, and recoil gradually stabilizes.

3) Weapon accessory balance adjustments:

a) Reflex Sight:

New bonus: Stability +8

b) Tactical Rifle Scope:

Removed Stability and Mobility penalties.

4) Armor balance adjustments:

a) Tactical Combat Shoes:

Force Bonus: 10 → 20

b) Gas Mask Hood:

Force Bonus: 20 → 30

c) Shaman Vulture:

Force Bonus: 30 → 45

Item Storage Optimization

The storage system for production facilities has been optimized:

1) If your backpack is full, you can no longer claim items from the production queue.

2) When dismantling a facility, both in-progress and completed items will drop on the ground.

3) Canceling production will refund materials based on their source. If your backpack is full, the materials will drop on the ground.

Fair Play Optimizations

1. Optimized the wall-penetration detection to fix false positives when opening or closing doors, and fixed cases where character displacement during construction could trigger false bans.

2. Enhanced detection for abnormal behaviors such as melee abuse, pulling other players, and teleport exploits. We will continue to optimize these systems and patrol actively to eliminate unfair play. Metas, thank you for helping us keep the game fair and healthy. Stay alert for malicious behavior!
Bug Fixes - RaidZone Mode
Combat

Fixed an issue where the Reflex Sight displayed incorrectly after using Festering Gel's battle skill.


Optimization - All Modes
Construction

1. Optimized controller navigation in the Visibility settings menu.

2. Added a mirroring feature in Construction mode; shortcut key: H.

3. In the construction screen, mirrored structures now show only a single base structure, with a mirroring icon in the lower-right corner.

4. Skins selected during construction now support mirroring as well. If a skin has no mirrored version, it will default to the base structure.

*Note: To adapt to the mirror model, we have adjusted the initial coordinates of certain mirror structures. This may affect the orientation of existing constructions such as stairs and other structures. Metas can dismantle and rebuild them to recover normal functionality.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/a77ca777497a868b4d99365ec0d5903eb34f19b2.gif"]

For more information, see 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2139460/view/545620793932906561"][/dynamiclink]

5. For non-RaidZone modes: Added the Storage Terminal facility. Once placed, you can centrally manage all storage crates in your territory and quickly store or retrieve items.

Shop Experience Optimizations

1. Fixed color discrepancies on stocking fashion items.

2. Added quick navigation options to weapon, vehicle, and territory cosmetic screens. You can now use shortcut keys or click "Purchase" to jump straight to the selection screen.

3. Optimized the female character's slow-walk animation and the male character's default standing pose in the cosmetic screen.

4. Added directional hair color swatches. Set previews now include matching hair colors in the shop and cosmetic screens.

5. Unified teeth whitening for a more consistent appearance.

Custom Servers

1. Added an initial backpack setup feature. Server hosts can provide Metas with newcomer benefits.

2. Added a Server Host Shop, where server hosts can list items for sale to other Metas.

3. Increased the server declaration character limit to 2,000.

4. Added an option for custom server hosts to set the maximum size of Hives.

5. Updated default parameter templates with two new types: Free Build and Melee Combat.

6. When joining a new custom server, you can now keep your previous character customization.

7. Added server recommendations. You will now see popular and trending custom servers suggested for you.

Scenario

Scenario History now displays Scenario Honor information during settlement.

Combat

1. Loadout and weapon accessory/cosmetic configuration save optimizations:

1) Loadout saves now also include weapon accessory setups.

2) The loadout detail page no longer lists individual mods separately. It now uses the same display style as the gear screen, giving you a clearer full-set preview.

3) When replacing a weapon with another of the same blueprint, its mods, accessories, and cosmetic settings will automatically transfer.

2. Added unique hit sound effects when damaging buildings or vehicles with firearms.

3. Weapon scope improvements:

1) Reduced reticle overexposure when aiming in certain situations.

2) Scope lenses now reflect the environment and light sources when not aiming.

Game Modes

1. Improved immersion by increasing Rosetta and Vultures' turning speed. They now turn toward the source of footsteps and gunfire more quickly.

2. For non-RaidZone modes: Securement Silos will now match the number and strength of stage Deviants based on participant count, and a Primary Gear Workbench has been added for gear repairs.

3. For non-RaidZone modes: Optimized the appearance of certain Deviants and items in Endless Dream.

Social Feature Optimized

Added a batch management feature for friends.

Mobile-Specific Optimizations

Added destruction effects for territory objects when they are damaged.

Other

1. Added walking navigation lines and improved navigation guidance.

2. Optimized the visual effects of waterfalls in the wilderness.

notes.title: Version 2.1.3 Update Announcement (September 10)
notes.notes:
Dear Metas,
The Version 2.1.3 server maintenance and update is planned for September 10 at 4:00 PM (PT) and expected to last about 2 hours (actual time may differ). Please plan your game time accordingly for the best experience. The update size is approximately 1.48 GB on PC launchers, 77 MB on the PC client (see note below), 220 MB on Android, and 213 MB on iOS (actual size may differ). We recommend downloading the update over Wi-Fi.  NOTE: If the update is delayed on Steam, you may be able to launch the game without downloading any content. The update of 1.48GB will then be downloaded and applied within the game client. After updating, an additional download of 2.1 GB may be required.

This update introduces a gameplay upgrade to Starfall Inversion with improved drops, interactive conversations with V, Lightforge Loot Crate: Astral Nexus, and optimizations and bug fixes to permanent servers, the class system, and more.

After this maintenance, all players will receive the following rewards: Starchrom ×1,000, Mitsuko's Mark ×100, Starwish Token ×300, and Detoxident ×3.

Below are the details of this update for Once Human (henceforth "regular mode") and Once Human: RaidZone (henceforth "RaidZone"):
Content/Feature UpdatesStarfall Inversion gameplay upgrade with improved drops!
During a Starfall Inversion, high-altitude Elite Deviants will randomly spawn in the wilderness. Defeat them to obtain surprise rewards!

Applies to scenarios with the Starfall Inversion tag in regular mode.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/f709de60ced162e061a7d4d25571f1c1389497c3.jpg"]
Chat with V
Applies to regular mode and RaidZone.

An AI assistant in the form of V comes to the World chat channel! If you have any questions or want someone to talk to, just @V in the World chat channel to start a conversation with V!

* Replies are visible to everyone in the World chat channel.
New EventsNew Limited-Time Wish Machine Prize Pools
Applies to regular mode.

After the update on September 10, 2025 (PT), the following new Wish Machine prize pools will be available for 3 weeks:

Frost Abyss: Includes the Legendary weapon blueprint: Abyss Glance.

Doom Hunter: Includes the Legendary weapon blueprint 'Doombringer'.

Frost Threader: Includes the Legendary gear blueprints: Covert Walker Shirt, Blackstone Gloves, Blackstone Pants, and Blackstone Mask.
New Items in Shop
Applies to regular mode and RaidZone.
Lightforge Loot Crate: Astral Nexus now available for a limited time!
"What has made you lighter than flesh and bone?"

Available: After the update on September 10 (PT)

Lightforge Loot Crate: Astral Nexus includes the Astral Leap fashion set (Legendary), Shadow Dash weapon skin (Legendary), and Aether Seat furniture formula (Epic Collection).

Your dispatch will pull the galaxy into a raging maelstrom!

Aether Seat is an interactive furniture item. Sit on it to switch between the Excited or Depressed moods!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/33f72cdc7615ac35243fc36958aafab1172d3273.jpg"]
Upcoming Shop Updates
Available: September 17, 6:00 AM (server time)

"Warmth flows, and time gently soothes the heart."

The Sunlit Hearth furniture pack (Epic) is coming. Prepare your cozy home for autumn!

Some Sunlit Hearth furniture formulas can be dyed at the Designer's Workstation!

Enjoy 36% off in the first week after launch, until September 24, 2025 at 3:00 PM (PT)! Go to Shop > Territory > Furniture to check it out now!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/c890bab6281063f8f0052c5b53518f6bb20a9c0e.jpg"]

"The future is here. The superstar is coming."

The Rising Nova Set (Rare) is coming. A fashionable and comfortable outfit with a perfect fit and lots of star power!

Enjoy 34% off in the first week after launch, until September 24, 2025 at 3:00 PM (PT)! Go to Shop > Character > Set to check it out now!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/565eab27f1124d82309d9297029fa1bab7fd1b0b.jpg"]Small Gift Boxes are also making a surprise return. Check the Shop for details!


OptimizationsRegular modePermanent Servers
1. After this update, World merges on permanent servers will end.

2. Optimizations to sign-up cooldown rules for permanent servers and servers in their settlement phase:

a) When you first sign up for a permanent server or server in its settlement phase, the cooldown starts at 12 hours. This cooldown will grow incrementally each time you sign up for any such server within one natural month.

b) To ensure a smooth experience, the sign-up cooldown period will be reset every 1st day of the month (UTC+8).

For more information, refer to the Dev Blog on permanent servers: 

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2139460/view/545619524187063748


Class System
1. Gardener class optimizations

a) Greenhouse Cores can now operate on any water resource (Boiled Water, Purified Water) and can also be connected to pipes for automation.

b) Changed the Gardener's starting items. After selecting the Gardener class, you can choose one of the following to receive: Portable Planter Box - The Scorcher, Portable Planter Box - Agent, or Portable Planter Box - Digger. You will also receive a Portable Planter Box.

c) Optimized the Portable Planter Box's seed breeding function. It can now breed seeds of a single type in bulk.

d) Added the ability to breed fruit seeds.

e) To prevent mistaken operations, if you are disassembling in bulk at the Disassembly Bench and your Backpack contains biomechanical parts, a second confirmation window will pop up. If you choose Cancel, the corresponding biomechanical parts will not be selected.

f) Optimized the appearance of the Gardener's flower grafting.

2. Chef class optimizations

a) Unlocked Creative Cooking recipes of a single type can be cooked in bulk. Bulk production will be handled by Chefosaurus Rex.

b) Unlocked Gourmet Atlas recipes can be crafted immediately if conditions are met.

c) Optimized the display of dish bonus attribute values. The final bonus attribute values will now be highlighted.

d) Added a new Memetic formula: Fruit Soda. You can now use any fruit to make soda with its ingredient effects. The Blueberry Soda and Orange Soda Memetic formulas have been removed. Items already crafted are not affected.

e) Due to player demand for Sanity recovery during combat, we've adjusted the effects of the following ingredients that offer continuous Sanity recovery:

i. Apple Previous: Gathering Stamina cost -5%. Now: Sanity recovers very slowly (1% Sanity per second).

ii. Goat Milk Previous: Sanity slowly recovers when out of combat. Dish Durability -10%. Now: Sanity gradually recovers (3% Sanity per second). Dish Durability -10%.

iii. Deviated Mushroom Previous: Sanity recovers slowly when out of combat. Non-crop ingredient effect duration -50%. Now: Sanity recovers slowly (3% Sanity per second). Non-crop ingredient effect duration -50%.

3. Beastmaster class optimizations

a) Optimized the following/teleporting status of summoned animals in some situations. When you ride a vehicle, animals will be automatically recalled.

b) Optimized the displayed information of animals in your territory. You can now view an animal's habits and preferences on its Animal Details panel.

c) Optimized the combat performance of bears, wolves, and other large animals. They will no longer obstruct bullets. This change won't apply to PvP scenarios.
Territory
1.To make it easier to relocate your territory, we've optimized the foundation requirements during relocation. Now, when placing your territory, the system will no longer strictly check if every foundation is touching the ground. Instead, it will automatically use the foundation closest to the ground as the support point and adjust the entire structure to fit. After placement, you can also manually adjust the structure to fit the terrain of its new location.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/6d8739e5f23ae0aecd20a92e3457d4f330be75c5.gif"]

2. Outdoor facilities will no longer be removed when relocating. Instead, they will be adjusted to fit the elevation of the new terrain. If the new location is in a no-build zone, outdoor facilities will be dismantled and their materials refunded. Note that the new terrain's elevation may change the direction of water flows, and available resources may affect facilities' operation status.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/62d8b48432d86df931290160f513fa91e423376a.gif"]

3. Optimized the territory protection mechanic in The Way of Winter. You will no longer die because of extreme weather when in your territory, at a campsite, or in a neutral zone.
Game Modes
1. Optimized the performance during the Airplane Ancient One game mode.

2. After defeating a Deep Dreamer, the reward drops would sometimes overlap with its model, making it difficult to interact with them. Therefore, we've increased the interaction distance for Deep Dreamer drops.

3. Starting now, the Loot Crate rewards in the "Dream Zone Trace Box" of the "Endless Dream" scenario have been adjusted so that only players who participate in the kill can receive them. Please note that unopened Loot Crates will disappear after remaining in an unopened state for half an hour, so make sure to claim them in time.
Trade
To make it easier to locate your own Vending Machine in a Harvesters' Market, we've added a map icon for it.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/e05f0a974f36e97be52b2c6016e6b954ccb1055a.jpg"]


RaidZone ModeFairness Experience Optimization
To further ensure the fairness experience in RaidZone Mode, we have optimized the detection mechanisms for weapon fire rate, vehicle attack range, and DMG. Thank you, Meta-Humans, for providing valuable information. We will continue to monitor and strive to create a better gaming environment for you!
Wilderness
1. Added Mining Workshops for ore extraction. You can find Mining Workshops in the wilderness using their map markers (see image below).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/ece1290f6d74cd01f3762f31b109245798e74f7b.jpg"]

a) Use Portable Mixed Fuel to power the Mining Workshop's Power Supply Unit.

b) Once fully powered, the Mining Workshop will start extracting the specified ore.

c) Use Realm Crate Access Cards to greatly increase the Mining Workshop's output rate.
Combat
Optimized the Rocket Launcher Incendiary Warhead's fire field visual effect. The fire field now lasts until the burning has ended.
Territory
1. To improve the resource expenditure balance between attackers and defenders, we've made the following optimizations:

a) Some defensive structures did not have maintenance costs. Therefore, we've added regular maintenance costs to the High Wall and High Wall With Door.

b) Added reinforcement costs to some defensive structures. After this update, the High Wall, High Wall With Door, Shelter Gun Port, Rolling Shutter Door, Iron Mesh Wall, Iron Mesh Floor, and some small and curved alloy buildings will have reinforcement costs.

2. Optimized the rules for facilities in an unoccupied territory:

a) Planter Box: Fruits can be harvested if the territory is unoccupied.

b) Plate: Food can be plundered if the territory is unoccupied.

c) Weapon Rack: Weapons can be plundered if the territory is unoccupied.

d) Fish Tank: Fish can be plundered if the territory is unoccupied.

e) Specimen Rack: Resources can be plundered if the territory is unoccupied.

f) All Turrets: Ammunition can be plundered if the territory is unoccupied.

g) Doors and Windows: Can be opened or closed if the territory is unoccupied.

3. When moving buildings, a collision placeholder will be kept at its original location until the move is complete.
Tasks
We've adjusted the rules for accepting commission tasks. The new rules are as follows:

a) You can accept and complete up to 3 tasks from the Commissions panel each day. After completing a task, you can claim its reward from the Commissions panel.

b) Commission statuses refresh daily at midnight (server time), at which time incomplete commissions will be automatically abandoned.

c) If you have completed commissions with unclaimed rewards at the time of the refresh, you can still claim the rewards from the Commissions panel the following day. This does not affect your daily task limit on the following day.
Other
Optimized the layout of the blackout screen:

a) The blackout screen now includes detailed information about the players who knocked you down and killed you, including the weapon, item, Deviation, or defensive facility that delivered the final blow, as well as their distance.

b) Added more ways to report other players. You can now click the Report button to make a quick report. You can also copy the player's ID and then report them from the Report interface.

c) The location of the players who knocked you down and killed you will be briefly displayed, their character models will have an outline effect, and the camera will focus on them.


General OptimizationsMonetization Experience Optimizations
1. After receiving feedback regarding insufficient Backpack capacity, we've optimized our data storage solution. The Backpack's maximum capacity has been increased to 160 slots, while the fashion Special Backpack's maximum capacity has been increased to 2,500 slots.

2. Removed the preview model from the Shop's display window. It now uses your character model by default.

3. Added a toggle for customized recommendations. When enabled, you will be recommended events and products you may like.

4. Optimized the walking animation for female characters.

5. Added a basic facial expression for idling characters. We will continue to develop more facial expressions and optimize character facial appearances.

6. Optimized the appearance of the character's eyelashes.
Custom Servers
1. Added new issuable items: animal hides and Specialization Cleaner.

2. Added an item issuance limit to prevent too many items from being issued, which may lead to overloaded Backpacks and other problems.
Scenario Honor System
1. Improved the description of the Prime Hunter coating unlock task (in the Manibus scenario), and added a new task completion guide.

2. Improved some Scenario Honor reward item descriptions.
Territory
1. Optimized the hotkey categorization on the Build interface. Functional buttons have been moved to the top-right corner of the screen, including: Structure Replacement, Grid Snap, Visibility Settings, Flight Mode, and Territory Relocation. The G key's function has been changed from Structure Upgrade to Structure Replacement and now includes Sticker Replacement and Skin Replacement.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/5a492324912f56ae36a30b913c1424138980c586.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/68db35f71248558d26236a8b6afc6c021b1c1f13.gif"]

2. Added three new fruit tree crops: Apple, Banana, and Coconut. These crops have a long germination period, but can be harvested continuously after maturing without replanting. The new crops will not produce deviated fruits for now, but we are working on improvements. Stay tuned!

3. Optimized the layout of the Build interface categories:

a) Optimized the categorization and order of tabs on the Build interface and added icons for easy comprehension.

b) Added a filter function to the Structure and Furniture categories. You can now sort them in ascending or descending order.

c) Optimized the Structure categories. They are now categorized by material (e.g., Wood Foundation, Stone Foundation, Marble Foundation). The other changes are as follows:

i. Doors and windows are now under the Door & Window category.

ii. Balconies, parapets, and columns are now under the Parapet Column category.

iii. Passcode Locks are now under the Tactical Facility category.

d) Facilities are now categorized by function.

e) Furniture is now categorized by rarity.

f) Cosmetics are now categorized by set.

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/1b7f04bd08f5f10c15669bf99bb438a28089ed38.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/b9379790500774468564a373269e596b63678a02.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/e9d14d5500c97c4932216d2dd0f6d104200567b2.png"]

4. When crafting items, you can now use materials directly from the Water Tank without having to withdraw them.
Eternaland
1. Added the Island and World chat channels, allowing you to chat in the World channel on Eternaland.

2. Added a function that lets you share your Eternaland with friends in the mobile version.
Guidance

notes.title: Bug Fix for Raining Cash
notes.notes:
Dear Metas,



We've identified an issue where Abyss Glance's and Snowsprite's Ice Crystals gained an extra damage bonus if they exploded while the player was wielding Raining Cash. This is due to a delay in the calculation of the Ice Crystals' damage, causing it to use the player character's status when the Ice Crystals exploded.

Unless otherwise stated, weapon passive effects should only apply to the player character. Therefore, we are adjusting Raining Cash's damage bonus so that it only applies to damage dealt by Raining Cash. This fix will not affect the damage values of Raining Cash or other weapons.

In future updates, we will further review other damage effects to ensure that damage is always calculated correctly. Thank you for your feedback!



Once Human Development Team

notes.title: Version 2.1.2 Update Announcement (August 27)
notes.notes:
Dear Metas,
The Version 2.1.2 server maintenance and update is planned for August 27 at 4:00 PM (PT) and is expected to last about 2 hours (actual time may differ). Please plan your game time accordingly for the best experience.

 The update size is approximately4.05 GB on PC launchers, 157 MB on the PC client(Note: In case of Steam platform push delays, you may encounter a situation where no download is required on the Steam platform to directly access the client. Instead, you can download a 2.2GB update within the client, followed by a 4.5GB download once the push arrives.), 335 MB on Android, and 370 MB on iOS (actual size may differ). We recommend downloading the update over Wi-Fi.

This update introduces the new Scenario Honor system, RaidZone updates, a new Memetic formula: Body Enhancement Feed V, furniture interaction pose options, the S1 Visional Wheel event: Stellar Resonance, Lightforge Loot Crate: Frenzied Kiss, and various optimizations and bug fixes.

After the maintenance, the following rewards will be issued to all players: Starchrom ×1,000, Mitsuko's Mark ×100, Starwish Token ×300, Detoxident ×3, and Blueprint Conversion Attempt ×3. You'll also earn lots of rewards for rising through the Scenario Honor ranks and taking part in the limited-time Stellar Resonance event!

Below are the details of this update:


Content/Feature UpdatesScenario Honor System
This update includes the surprise Scenario Honor system!

Grow your Scenario Rating and ascend through the Scenario Honor ranks to earn scenario-exclusive Honor Badges, Emblems, Star Cups, Prismatic Nicknames, Scenario Marks, and Asterism Crates!

The Scenario Honor system resets annually every 12 months, with the next reset planned for August 2026. The following content will be reset: one-off Honor Rank reward records, Honor Rank history records, and Prismatic Nickname validity period. Other rewards obtained through this system (scenario-exclusive Honor Badges, Emblems, Star Cups, Scenario Marks, and Asterism Crates) will be retained as per the corresponding rules.

Honor Badges have an exclusive coating effect. Complete just one Coating task, and you'll receive a scenario-exclusive badge coating for a limited time after Scenario Honor is settled! And if you complete all Coating tasks, you'll unlock even more spectacular coatings! Coatings can be unlocked repeatedly to extend their validity. Start climbing the ranks now!

Reward Cycle

1. In Once Human, a reward cycle starts when your character joins a scenario and lasts until the start of the settlement phase.

After this update, scenario servers that are nearing their settlement phases may have relatively brief initial reward cycles. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

2. In RaidZone mode, a reward cycle starts when your character joins a scenario and lasts until the server resets.

Reward Requirements

1. Your character must be at least Lv. 20 and have joined the scenario before settlement is complete.

2. If you exit the scenario midway through a reward cycle, you cannot complete settlement, and your run will not be recorded.

If you join a scenario server that has already entered its settlement phase, you cannot complete settlement. Please take this into consideration when choosing a server.

Reward Issuance Rules

1. If you have met the reward requirements and completed settlement, you can claim your rewards by navigating to the Scenario Rating interface and selecting Honor Rewards. Don't worry if you forget to claim your rewards before exiting the scenario. Honor Badges (including coating effects) and Prismatic Nicknames will be automatically unlocked. Emblems, Star Cups, Scenario Marks, and Asterism Crates will be sent to the corresponding character via in-game mail.

2. Rewards are determined by the highest rank attained by your character within a single scenario. Rewards can only be claimed once during the next Scenario Honor cycle, lasting from August 2025 to August 2026.

The display location for Scenario Marks will be replaced with Scenario Honor Badges. Remember to make changes accordingly.

Applicable Servers: All servers with the Starfall Inversion tag

Event Details

1. Stellar Resonance Gameplay Rules: After you craft Gravity Integrator and start a Stellar Battle, the resultant gravity tides will attract hordes of Deviants. Your job is to defend the Gravity Integrator from their assault. Complete the challenge to earn Stellar Core Gravity Samples and other rewards.

NOTE: Deviations cannot stand on Gravity Integrators.

2. Stellar Resonance - Global Challenge: Join forces to collect Stellar Core Gravity Samples and complete Stellar Resonance challenges to unlock global buffs. Plus, accumulate personal contribution to redeem rare items from the Shop.

To improve aerial exploration, we've made the following changes:

1. Combat Optimizations

a) Added a way to glide more quickly. To speed up while gliding, press the Shift key on PC, or drag the joystick to the speed-up zone on mobile.

b) Added a way to descend more quickly. After jumping, press the Crouch key or button to descend quickly.

c) Improved the airborne aiming mechanics. You will now hover briefly when you aim to fire while gliding at high altitudes.

d) Added a way to cancel aiming when performing a plunging melee attack. To cancel aiming, press the Jump key on PC or the Cancel Aim button on mobile.

2. Wilderness Optimizations

a) Adjusted floating objects in the wilderness. Removed objects with small standing surfaces and optimized the angle of standing surfaces on some objects.

b) Increased the interaction range for climbing floating objects.

This is our first Epic weapon skin gift box! Each draw costs 36 Crystgin and grants a chance of obtaining temporary or permanent skins! Try your luck today!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/ec94968db7fd614f6bb261d6f2bdb1ce2f5591fb.jpg"]
OptimizationsCombat
We're implementing our planned balance adjustments in phases. In the August 28 (PT) update, we'll be adjusting the following content: Frost Vortex - keyword effect, Abyss Glance, Silent Anabasis, Icy Rain, Frost Tactical Vest, Cryo Blast, Vortex Multiplier, Obliteration, Polar Jelly, Claymore Mine: Frost Trap - Memetic Specialization, Raining Cash, Doombringer, Corrosion, and Lonewolf's Whisper.

For more information, see https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2139460/view/545618256387375445

After these adjustments, we will continue monitoring each build's effectiveness and usage rates to assess whether further adjustments are necessary.

We've also noticed that Pyro Dino tends to outperform other Deviations, causing balance issues. During this update, we will adjust Polar Jelly and Lonewolf's Whisper. In subsequent updates, we will enhance the other Deviations in batches, based on priority. Stay tuned!

To ensure a smooth transition, we will issue Blueprint Conversion Attempt ×3 to all players after this update.
RaidZone
1. Added the Flamethrower, a static defense installation for the early game.

2. Changed the Shotgun Turret to require electricity and adjusted its Technology level to improve balance.

3. Phase Progression and Ending Adjustments

a) New servers opened after this update will have Scenario Challenges and Daily Commissions unlocked by default. These servers will also consist of a single phase with no phase changes.

b) Servers opened after this update will no longer have triggerable endings or end early due to triggered endings.

4. Survival Optimizations

a) Reduced the Stamina cost of sprinting by 25%. Removed the Stamina cost of gathering. Increased the Stamina recovery speed by 25%.

b) Hydration and Energy effects:

i. Previously, Load would gradually decrease when Energy was below 30%. Now, Load will only be reduced when Energy reaches 0.

ii. Previously, Stamina recovery speed and Movement Speed would be reduced when Hydration was below 30%. Now, only Movement Speed will be reduced when Hydration reaches 0.

iii. Previously, the Stamina cost of sprinting was reduced when Hydration reached 60%. Now, this will only apply when Hydration reaches 100%.

iv. The Force recovery effect will only apply when Energy reaches 100%.

c) Optimizations to returning from blackout:

Previously, after returning from a blackout, Energy and Hydration would be restored to their pre-blackout levels. Now, Energy will be restored to approximately 50% and Hydration to approximately 70% after a blackout. This should improve the experience for players with fewer resources.

d) Sanity optimizations:

We've removed the deduction effect that low Sanity has on Max HP. This ensures that your Max HP remains fixed.

5. Optimized the drop mechanics of crafting facilities. After this update, these facilities will drop all items in their queue upon destruction.

6. Added weekly reset and monthly reset servers. Refer to the server names to choose one that suits you.

7. We've noticed that some players cannot obtain vehicle repair items in the early game and cannot use vehicles as a result. To improve this, we're making these adjustments to the rules for obtaining vehicles in the wilderness:

a) Bicycles that spawn in the wilderness no longer need to be repaired and can be used right away.

b) To maintain fairness and improve balance in RaidZone mode, bicycles can only be used by one player at a time, with no pillion rider.

8. Removed the Mod access point from the Backpack.

9. Reduced the chance of the Inferior Bomb being a dud, and increased the chance of the Inferior Dud being a dud.

10. Reduced the damage that the Torch, Bone Knife, and Wrench deal to buildings to make them more consistent with other melee weapons.

For more information, refer to https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2139460/view/545618256387375285
Scenario
1. Changed the rules for Challenge Shops on permanent servers:

a) After scenario servers are merged into a permanent server, the Challenge Shop's content will inherit the permanent server's Shop content, and purchase chances will not be reset.

b) After the update, when Manibus (Novice) servers are merged into permanent servers, players can purchase the Class System Open Beta Gift Pack from the Challenge Shop.

2. Added special shield generators to the entrances of Securement Silo - ALPHA, Securement Silo - THETA, Securement Silo - PSI, Securement Silo - PSI \[Deviation +0.5], Securement Silo - SIGMA, Securement Silo - EX1, Securement Silo - PHI, and Securement Silo - EX1 \[Deviation -1.4] in Endless Dream. This should help players resist energy surges and lightning in Nightmare Specs zones.

3. Adjusted the methods for obtaining Reality Fragments in Endless Dream:

a) Added large amounts of Reality Fragments to the rewards for Scenario Challenge tasks in each phase.

b) Removed Reality Fragments from the global rewards for defeating an Eternal Dreamer for the first time. After the update, all accounts with characters on Endless Dream servers will receive the following compensation: Reality Fragment ×1,500.

4. One of the descriptions in the Version 2.1.1 Update Announcement was ambiguous. It has been corrected to: "Adjusted the weekly mutations for Securement Silo - PSI and Securement Silo - PSI \[Deviation +0.5]. Get Toughened has been removed from the pool of possible boss mutations." We will pay more attention to clarity of expression in future update announcements. Sorry for any inconvenience caused, and thank you for your understanding.
Monetization Experience Optimizations
1. You can now purchase the Super Value Choice Gift Pack without having to purchase the Shining Newbie Pack first.

2. Optimized the sorting for the Weapon Accessory Paint and Weapon Camo interfaces. Now, items are sorted based on unlock status (from unlocked to locked) and rarity (from most to least rare).

3. Optimized the interaction feedback when selecting makeup. Details will be displayed for makeups you own, and the sorting rules have been optimized.

4. Fixed an issue where, if the backpack is hidden but not the weapon, the weapon appeared to be floating.

5. Optimized the gunfire sound effect for the Lost Spark - MPS5 weapon skin.
Server Launch Adjustments
Affected Regions: North America, Europe, Southeast Asia

One Endless Dream (Visional) and one Manibus (Visional) scenario server will open every Friday at 5:00 PM (PT). For details, go to Scenario Sign-up > Server Launch Schedule in the game.
Custom Servers
1. The Server Host can now issue the following items: Energy Link Loot Crate, Starchrom Crate, Lunar Suffix Mod Box, and Downstar Suffix Mod Box.

2. The Way of Winter and Once Human: RaidZone have been updated to their latest versions. The server host can switch scenarios to experience the latest content.
Wilderness
We've received player feedback that there are too few wolves in the wilderness. Hence, we're optimizing the wolf spawn rates.
Class System
1. Beastmasters can now raise up to 10 animals in their territories.

2. Adjusted the Beastmaster's Beast Whistle mechanics. If the Tameness requirement is met, the cooldown for summoning animal companions is reduced to 10 seconds.

3. Optimized the usage and performance mechanics for the Gardener's Soil Solution. It can now be used normally.
Construction
Optimized the placement range of all facilities on foundations.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/669e2b7953c1f6f622c04a63150563fd62829924.jpg"]
Tasks
To make the introductory experience more exciting and challenging, we've optimized the novice tutorial as follows:

1. Adjusted the weapons available during the novice tutorial. Players will now obtain a pistol in the starting section and can craft an assault rifle at Mitsuko's refuge.

2. Simplified the story in Mitsuko's space inside the novice Monolith.

3. Optimized the monster types encountered in the novice Monolith, and adjusted the combat pacing and enemy spawn rates during the Siren boss battle.

4. Deviations will now assist the player during the Siren boss battle.

5. Added a mirror facility to Mitsuko's refuge. Players can use the mirror to customize their face and body.
Trade
To prevent accidental listings, we've changed the default listing price on Vending Machines from 1 to 0. When the price is 0, the item cannot be listed for sale.
Social Feature Optimized
To prevent spam, chat messages are now limited to 150 characters each.
Mobile-Specific Optimizations
Optimized the combat controls zone. The default button layout is now more comfortable. Players with custom layouts will not be affected.


Bug FixesShop
1. Fixed an issue affecting the appearance of the Final Gambit female shoes.

2. Fixed visual issues such as clipping, broken textures, and deformed character models on some fashion items.

3. Fixed an issue where the Final Gambit set would obstruct the player's view when scoped in while crouching.

notes.title: Development Update | Update Preview: August Balance Adjustments
notes.notes:
Dear Metas,

Every month, we implement new balance adjustments to improve Once Human's combat experience. In the August 28 update, our main focus is optimizing the Frost Vortex keyword effect. We'll also adjust the strength of some weapon blueprints, while buffing the Deviations: Polar Jelly and Lonewolf's Whisper.


I. Frost Vortex Optimizations and Blueprint Effect Adjustments
We've noticed that the Frost Vortex keyword effect isn't performing as intended in some situations for the following reasons:

1. It doesn't generate vortexes in optimal locations.

2. The damage is delayed and has slow damage build-up, requiring multiple vortexes to deal maximum damage.

To resolve these issues, we are optimizing the Frost Vortex keyword effect as follows:

1. Optimize the locations where vortexes are generated so they're more likely to hit enemies or Deviants.

2. Reduce the damage delay, shortening the interval between generation and dealing damage.

3. Increase the damage of a single vortex. A single vortex will be able to deal more damage than three vortexes did previously. To compensate, we will slightly reduce the chance of triggering a vortex with Frost Vortex weapons. This change will enhance Frost Vortex's overall damage and damage build-up speed.

We will also adjust Frost weapons and gear to improve the experience of using Frost builds.

notes.title: Once Human: RaidZone Update Preview
notes.notes:
Dear Meta,

We've been paying close attention to your feedback since the launch of Once Human: RaidZone. The August 28 update will include optimizations to the anti-cheat system, vehicle mechanics, survival experience, and server rules. Below is a preview of the upcoming RaidZone content. We can't wait to share these improvements with you!


I. Anti-Cheat Optimizations
Maintaining fair competition is one of our biggest priorities in Once Human: RaidZone. We have rigorously tackled cheating through continuous upgrades to our monitoring system, reverse-tracing of external cheats, and iterative improvements to our AI detection models. To further strengthen our anti-cheat efforts, we will introduce the following optimizations in the August 28 update:

Increased Transparency on Sanctioned Accounts

1. Banned players on your current server will be displayed in a marquee, ensuring cheaters have nowhere to hide.

2. Character ban status will be displayed in the Friends list and search results, allowing you to identify sanctioned accounts more easily.

Player Moderators

3. To allow players to contribute to maintaining fairness, we will soon start recruiting player moderators through our community channels.

As guardians of the Once Human experience, moderators will assist us in identifying and analyzing rule-breaking behavior.

Successful applicants will receive an exclusive in-game Moderator Badge and earn rewards—including in-game items and limited merch—based on their contributions to game moderation.

Recruitment details will be available in an upcoming dev update. We encourage all interested players to apply!

We're also working on comprehensive upgrades to the in-game reporting system, including a streamlined reporting process, new violation categories, and improved progress tracking. These changes are scheduled for the September version update. Cheating not only undermines fair play but also negatively impacts the open-world experience for all players. We have a zero-tolerance policy against cheating and will continue to invest in our anti-cheat efforts. We also look forward to working with you to safeguard Nalcott through moderation and reporting.


II. Vehicle Optimizations
To allow you to traverse the wilderness more freely and smoothly, this update will introduce the following optimizations to the vehicle mechanics:

1. Bicycles that spawn on the map will have full Durability by default and can be used straight away without repairs.

2. Increased the maximum Durability of bicycles to make them last longer and more resistant to destruction.

3. You can no longer carry a pillion rider on bicycles.

4. Vehicles can now destroy most barriers in the open world by colliding with them, reducing situations where you're stuck on obstacles during exploration.


III. Survival Optimizations
To give you more freedom of exploration while preserving its challenge, this update will introduce the following optimizations to the survival mechanics:

1. Durability

Reduced the Stamina cost of sprinting by 25%.

Removed the Stamina cost of gathering.

Increased the Stamina recovery speed by 25%.

Developer Message: We want Stamina management to be mainly focused on rolling, gliding, and other actions relevant to combat or escaping, rather than regular exploration and gathering.

2. Hydration and Energy Effects

Negative Effects: Previously, Load would gradually decrease when Energy was below 30%. Now, Load will only be reduced when Energy reaches 0. Previously, Stamina recovery speed and Movement Speed would be reduced when Hydration was below 30%. Now, only Movement Speed will be reduced when Hydration reaches 0.

Positive Effects: Previously, the Stamina cost of sprinting was reduced when Hydration reached 60%. Now, this will only apply when Hydration reaches 100%. Likewise, a Force recovery effect will only apply when Energy reaches 100%.

Developer Message: These changes aim to reduce the basic survival pressure, so you don't have to constantly monitor your Energy and Hydration to avoid penalties. At the same time, we want to offer bigger incentives for maintaining full Energy and Hydration to reward careful management of these parameters.

3. Returning from Blackout

Previously, after returning from a blackout, Energy and Hydration would be restored to their pre-blackout levels, which imposed a heavy burden on players with limited supplies. Now, Energy will be restored to approximately 50% and Hydration to approximately 70% after a blackout.

4. Sanity

In RaidZone scenarios, all Sanity-related negative effects will be temporarily disabled, and players' Max HP will remain fixed.


IV. Phase Progression and Ending Adjustments
To deliver a more consistent experience, this update will optimize RaidZone's phase and ending rules as follows:

1. RaidZone servers opened after the August 28 update will have Scenario Challenges unlocked by default and consist of a single phase rather than multiple phases.

2. RaidZone servers opened after the August 28 update will no longer have triggerable endings or end early due to triggered endings.


V. Server Restart Cycle Adjustments
To meet the needs of different players, this update will introduce a new server category for restart cycles, consisting of two types, as well as adjusted server opening rules.
New Server Categories and Opening Rules
To meet the needs of different players, we're adding a new server category for restart cycles, consisting of two types: Weekly Restart and Monthly Restart.

Weekly Restart: The server will restart every 7 days at a fixed time.

Monthly Restart: The server will restart every 28 days at a fixed time.

Additionally, to create a better experience across different restart cycles, we're making the following adjustments to the names, restart schedules, and quantity of RaidZone servers:

notes.title: Version 2.1.1 Bug Fixes (August 21)
notes.notes:
Dear Metas,
If you encounter any issues while playing, please contact us using the following methods:

PC: Open the in-game ESC menu → Feedback & Customer Support → Select Bug Report to submit your issue.

Mobile: Tap the menu button in the upper right corner → Tap the headphone icon in the sidebar → Select Customer Support → Then choose Bug Report to submit your feedback.



If you're offline, you can also report issues via our official email: oncehuman@global.netease.com. We'll investigate as soon as we receive your message.



Since the official release of Once Human version 2.1.1, we've been gathering community feedback and actively addressing your concerns.
Here are the current details of the changes we've made:
1. Fixed an issue where Dendron progress sometimes did not accumulate while fighting a Deep Dreamer in the Endless Dream scenario.

2. Fixed an issue that affected tire appearance on the Golden Radiance vehicle skin.

3. Fixed an issue that affected the appearance of the male headwear in the Steel Claw Raid Set and pants in the Fastwind Mayfly Set under certain conditions.

4. Fixed an issue where navigation lines would disappear when zooming the Mini Map or using a vehicle.

5. Fixed an issue where players could not sign up for a new server after logging in for the first time following the July 17 update.

6. Implemented a sign-up cooldown period for permanent servers and settlement phases to ensure fairness. If a character signs up for and joins a permanent server or a server in its settlement phase, that character cannot join another permanent server or server in its settlement phase for 3 days.

We understand that you may sometimes join the wrong server by accident, so the cooldown will only trigger after a character signs up for a permanent server or a server in its settlement phase for the third time.

notes.title: Version 2.1.0 Bug Fixes (August 12)

Dear Metas,

Please plan your game time accordingly for the best experience. The update size is 2.4 GB on PC, 430 MB on Android, and 420 MB on iOS. We recommend downloading the update over Wi-Fi.

This update includes the new Once Human: RaidZone mode, Endless Dream server updates, the Path of Transcendence limited-time event, Lightforge Loot Crate: Golden Surge, the Carnival Subsidy - Surprise Reforge event, and various optimizations and bug fixes. To celebrate the official launch of Once Human: RaidZone, after the maintenance, all players will receive the following rewards: Starchrom ×2,000, Butterfly's Emissary Crate II ×5, Mitsuko's Mark ×150, Starwish Token ×1000, and Limited Paint: Lily of the Valley – Bashful, Prismatic Laser Dye ×1. Plus, join the update event to claim a weapon skin gift box, limited edition Collection furniture, and more! Invite your friends and play together!

We sincerely apologize once again for the erroneous compensation email incident related to the Reward Covenant package on July 27th(PT). Moving forward, we will further strengthen our technical review and testing processes to prevent similar issues from recurring. Thank you for your continued understanding and support!

Below are the details of this update:
Content/Feature UpdatesOnce Human: RaidZone Officially Launches!
In the wild, everyone is both hunter and prey. It's the survival of the fittest!

Once Human: RaidZone is a new mode for players seeking pure and intense PvP action. Delve into the raid zone and fight to survive!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/404ae54df20be4c4bd29721dc2b19a4bcd58603e.png"]

Since the start of Early Access in May, tens of thousands of players have experienced RaidZone's intense PvP action. After receiving enthusiastic feedback and suggestions from the community and implementing many optimizations and bug fixes, RaidZone is finally ready for launch.

We are excited to announce RaidZone's official global launch on July 29 (PT)! This is only the beginning. We will continue gathering feedback and providing optimizations and content updates for RaidZone to deliver the ultimate PvP experience!

1. Introduction

Join RaidZone and dive into the hardcore PvP survival action!

a) Absolute Fairness: In RaidZone, servers will undergo periodic resets. All players start each match on equal footing, and must explore, build, and survive against environmental threats and rival players alike.

b) Unrestricted Combat: RaidZone is a hardcore PvP experience. Anyone can attack you, anytime and anywhere. You must quickly establish your territory to protect yourself and your resources. Unlock new crafting and building abilities through exploration and construct an impregnable territory before anyone else. Compete to survive the longest and defeat the mightiest enemies, and become the King of the RaidZone!

2. Features

RaidZone features different combat abilities and resource distribution from the regular Once Human mode. Everything is crafted to deliver a fair and competitive PvP experience with intense and enjoyable combat.

Fair PvP Combat

a) Weapons: In RaidZone, weapon combat is more pure and realistic, with no unique blueprint effects. Instead, higher-tier weapons offer superior handling and higher base damage.

b) Armor: All players have the same Max HP, with armor providing additional protection. Higher-tier armor provides better shield bonuses, with various sets and pieces featuring unique effects.

c) Deviations: In RaidZone, Combat Deviations will grant you unique abilities with distinct combat advantages that add strategic depth and variety to fights.

No Safe Supplies

In RaidZone, there are more ways to obtain resources: exploration, crafting, trading, or even raiding and looting others' territories!

If you are defeated or your territory is breached, all held or stored resources will become another player's loot. Only the most cunning Meta-Humans will survive the apocalypse!

Strategic Territory Warfare

In RaidZone, your character persists in the game world and is vulnerable to attack, even when you're offline! To survive, you must build a well-fortified territory that can protect both yourself and your resources from raiders.

Gather resources to upgrade your technology and unlock more territory defense options, including weapons, ammo, tactical items, defense facilities, and structures. Remember, a clever rabbit always has three nests! In RaidZone, you can build up to three territories to outwit your opponents and survive till the end!

3. Server Rules

To ensure a fair survival PvP experience in RaidZone, periodic resets and server tags will be implemented for RaidZone servers after the update on July 29 (PT).

a) Reset Rules: After the update, biweekly servers will be open at first. These servers are reset every 14 days. You can sign up for servers that are resetting soon via the sign-up system.

b) Server Name Rules: To help you distinguish various servers, the rules for RaidZone server names will be standardized to: ResetPeriod_FeatureTag-SerialNumber.

For example, a server named 'Biweekly_Hard-A001' resets every two weeks, has the Intense tag, and its serial number is A001.

c) Server Tag Rules:

Every server features a different reset period and gameplay intensity level. You can easily check the tag in the server's name and choose a suitable server to join. These are some of the tags:

Thursday: The server resets on Thursday.

Easy: The server's concurrent player limit is low, so the PvP encounter rate will be lower.

Hard: The server's concurrent player limit is high, so the PvP encounter rate will be higher.

In the future, we will add more tags based on your requests to deliver a deeper gameplay experience.



For more information on servers and transfers, refer to the Dev Update post: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2139460/view/545615719765639774"][/dynamiclink]



4. Multi-Mode Account and Character Data Rules

You can tap the Mode icon in the top-right corner of the login screen to switch between RaidZone and regular mode and try out their different content.

The rules differ in each mode.

Account Data and Feature Availability:

a) You can play Once Human and Once Human: RaidZone with the same account. The account character limit is shared between modes. When you select a mode, that mode's characters will be prioritized for display. You can also view all characters across all modes in the character list.

b) Content that affects PvP balance (such as blueprints and mods) cannot be used in RaidZone, but their data is retained under your account. Cosmetics (such as fashion pieces, vehicle skins, and furniture skins) can be used in all modes.

c) While in Once Human: RaidZone, characters cannot access Eternaland and the Spacetime Backpack until they leave the RaidZone match.

Shop and Events:

a) Events: Events may differ between modes. For more information, refer to the Events interface.

b) Shop: Premium content purchased from the Shop is shared across all modes, including progress and items.

c) Battle Pass: Non-cosmetic Battle Pass rewards are independent for each mode and can be claimed once per mode. Cosmetic and Silver Key rewards are shared between modes and can only be claimed once per account. Cosmetics can be used in any mode.



For more information RaidZone rules and content, refer to the Dev Update post: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2139460/view/545615719765639774"][/dynamiclink]
