1. Adjusted Ursula's Collapse mechanic. It now only deals multiple damage instances to areas occupied by territory buildings within the Collapse range. The Collapse range has been reduced to 125/150/175 meters. Ursula's Collapse no longer creates a Hollow and does not cause Sanity loss.

2. Optimized the territory demolition experience. Territories can be demolished normally within 30 minutes after being established. If this period is exceeded, demolition will have a 4-second loading time, during which you can interrupt it by pressing R. The demolition target will also be highlighted in yellow.

3. Added a territory protection timer to the World Map. Added a tip when attacking buildings under territory protection.

4. The Rifle Turret and Shotgun Turret now require ammo before attacking enemies.

5. Changed weapon accessories to independent items. Each accessory can only be equipped to one weapon at a time.

a) You can obtain weapon accessories by searching loot crates in the wilderness, unlocking Memetic formulas and crafting them at a Supplies Workbench, or looting other players' weapon accessories or weapons.

b) Weapon accessories will be stored under the Tool category in your Backpack. Weapon accessories equipped to weapons will no longer appear in your Backpack. Unequipping a weapon accessory will return it to your Tool Backpack if the latter has sufficient space.

c) You can now equip weapon accessories directly from the Backpack, alongside the existing method of equipping during weapon modification.

d) When you disassemble a weapon with a weapon accessory, you will obtain that accessory alongside the disassembled materials.

6. Friendly fire is now enabled by default.

7. We've noticed that the high auto-targeting range for melee weapons results in a poor experience during PvP, with both the attacker and defender being unable to predict the result of an attack. Hence, we have reduced the auto-targeting range for melee weapons and increased the auto-targeting angle range.

8. Combat balance adjustments:



To improve fairness, we have made adjustments to the following Deviations in RaidZone: Polar Jelly, Pyro Dino, Zeno-Purifier, ZapCam, Voodoo Doll, Shattered Maiden, and Mini Wonder. For more information, refer to the Dev Update post: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2139460/view/545615719765639770"][/dynamiclink]



We've been closely monitoring your RaidZone combat experience. Balance adjustments are based on extensive player feedback and data analysis, and we will continue to monitor their impact to assess if further changes are required. Moving forward, we will continue to optimize Deviation combat mechanics and balance to make RaidZone combat even more thrilling!

9. Removed the novice tutorial. You can now go straight to the wilderness after creating a character.

10. To maintain RaidZone's balance, we have adjusted the rewards for following us on social media. After this update, you will receive the following compensation: Mitsuko's Mark ×260, Butterfly’s Emissary Crate II ×2, and Starwish Token ×500.

11. To help returning players quickly familiarize themselves and start playing, we have adjusted the rewards for the Return to the Path of Meta-Human event. These changes only apply to players who fulfill the returnee conditions after July 29, 3:00 PM (PT).

More events will come to RaidZone in the future. Stay tuned!
Custom Servers
1. Friendly fire can now be enabled after enabling PvP.

2. Added the Prismverse’s Clash scenario.

3. Added more items that the server host can add: Wakeful Sand, Reality Fragment, and Reality Resetol (Endless Dream only).

4. New servers will automatically become available when an existing server expires. You can purchase a server on the official website's top-up page.
Server Sign-Up
Added a squad sign-up feature to the scenario selection interface. After your current server closes, you can enter the scenario selection interface from the login screen, then use this feature to sign up together with friends you invite.
Combat
Added a gear locking feature. Locked gear cannot be disassembled at a Disassembly Bench.
Construction
The mail you receive after your Territory Terminal is destroyed will now show the name of the player who destroyed it.
Monetization Experience Optimizations
You can now enable or disable the advanced tent skin from the Meta Pass interface.
Wilderness
1. Optimized the coordinates sharing feature. The shared information now includes your current World.

2. Optimized the gathering experience of Wakeful Clocks in Endless Dream. Wakeful Clocks will no longer be destroyed by building and damage effects.
Tasks
1. Optimized the tip shown when accepting some side story tasks in The Way of Winter.

2. Optimized some task descriptions in Manibus, Evolution's Call, The Way of Winter, and Prismverse’s Clash. Also reduced the completion difficulty of some tasks.
Public Crisis Events
1. Optimized the multiplayer experience for event upgrade tasks in the Public Crisis Event: Battleship Blockade:

a) Increased the number of turrets.

b) Increased the Destroyer's HP, and significantly increased the damage that Oil Field Plasma Rounds deal to the Destroyer.

2. Optimized the multiplayer experience for event upgrade tasks in the Public Crisis Event: Fatal Signal. The radar can no longer be rotated if it is at the correct angle.
Mobile Version Only
1. Added a quick demolish feature.

2. Optimized the detection rules for the Billboard alignment minigame. It can now be completed smoothly.

3. Optimized the reconnection experience after being disconnected. No loading is required in most situations.

4. Optimized Battery Saver mode. When Battery Saver is enabled, the number of players and NPCs on the screen and their special effects will be reduced.
Other
1. Optimized character movement startup sensitivity.

2. Optimized character movement startup transitions.

3. Optimized the ease of transitioning into a roll or crouch after jumping.
Bug FixesShop
1. Fixed an issue causing special effect display problems and clipping on some fashion items.

2. Fixed an issue where skins for fences and other furniture items did not snap vertically.

3. Fixed clipping issues with the beard on certain headwear.
Wilderness
Fixed an issue in Endless Dream where the Tall Grass Inn region was incorrectly considered a Dream Zone.
Dungeons
Fixed an issue affecting the appearance of colors in dungeons.
Mobile Version Only
Fixed an issue where the camera angle suddenly changed when moving.
Other
Fixed an issue where accidental inputs could interrupt shooting.

Once Human Development Team

notes.title: Dev Update | Once Human: RaidZone Official Launch Preview
notes.notes:
Dear Metas,

Since Once Human: RaidZone entered Early Access on May 21 (PT), tens of thousands of players have experienced its intense PvP action. After receiving enthusiastic feedback and suggestions from the community and implementing many optimizations and bug fixes, RaidZone is finally ready for launch.

We are excited to announce RaidZone's official global launch on July 29 (PT)! This is only the beginning. We will continue gathering feedback and providing optimizations and content updates for RaidZone to deliver the ultimate search, fight, and loot experience!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/899802891b3d36a6772ec3db560fe5a191dce078.jpg"]


Mode introduction
Join RaidZone and dive into the hardcore PvP survival action!

1. Absolute Fairness: In RaidZone, servers will undergo periodic resets. All players start each match on equal footing, and must explore, build, and survive against environmental threats and rival players alike.

2. Unrestricted Combat: RaidZone is a hardcore PvP experience. Anyone can attack you, anytime and anywhere. You must quickly establish your territory to protect yourself and your resources. Unlock new crafting and building abilities through exploration and construct an impregnable territory before anyone else. Compete to survive the longest and defeat the mightiest enemies, and become the King of the RaidZone!

 
Features
RaidZone features different combat abilities and resource distribution from the regular Once Human mode. Everything is crafted to deliver a fair and competitive PvP experience with intense and enjoyable combat.

 

Fair PvP Combat

1. Weapons: In RaidZone, weapon combat is more pure and realistic, with no unique blueprint effects. Instead, higher-tier weapons offer superior handling and higher base damage.

2. Armor: All players have the same Max HP, with armor providing additional protection. Higher-tier armor provides better shield bonuses, with various sets and pieces featuring unique effects.

3. Deviations: In RaidZone, Combat Deviations will grant you unique abilities with distinct combat advantages that add strategic depth and variety to fights.

 

No Safe Supplies

In RaidZone, there are more ways to obtain resources: exploration, crafting, trading, or even raiding and looting others' territories!

If you are defeated or your territory is breached, all held or stored resources will become another player's loot. Only the most cunning Meta-Humans will survive the apocalypse!

 

Strategic Territory Warfare

In RaidZone, your character persists in the game world and is vulnerable to attack, even when you're offline! To survive, you must build a well-fortified territory that can protect both yourself and your resources from raiders.

Gather resources to upgrade your technology and unlock more territory defense options, including weapons, ammo, tactical items, defense facilities, and structures. Remember, a clever rabbit always has three nests! In RaidZone, you can build up to three territories to outwit your opponents and survive till the end!

 

 
Server Rules
To ensure a fair survival PvP experience in RaidZone, periodic resets and server tags will be implemented for RaidZone servers after the update on July 29 (PT).

Reset Rules: After the update, biweekly servers will be open at first. These servers are reset every 14 days. You can sign up for servers that are resetting soon via the sign-up system.

Server Name Rules: To help you distinguish various servers, the rules for RaidZone server names will be standardized to: ResetPeriod_FeatureTag-SerialNumber.

For example, a server named 'Biweekly_Hard-A001' resets every two weeks, has the Intense tag, and its serial number is A001.

Server Tag Rules:

Every server features a different reset period and gameplay intensity level. You can easily check the tag in the server's name and choose a suitable server to join. These are some of the tags:

Thursday: The server resets on Thursday.

Easy: The server's concurrent player limit is low, so the PvP encounter rate will be lower.

Hard: The server's concurrent player limit is high, so the PvP encounter rate will be higher.

In the future, we will add more tags based on your requests to deliver a deeper gameplay experience.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/d6fe3f9527a25cca7abf57b55688283d49c7dc54.png"]
RaidZone Server Transfer Rule Differences
1. Permanent servers are not available in RaidZone.

2. To deliver a fair PvP experience, RaidZone servers have exclusive resource transfer rules. All resources must be obtained and used within each match.

a) In RaidZone, all gear, items, and Deviations must be unlocked or obtained within each match. Players cannot bring supplies from Eternaland or the Spacetime Backpack into a match. Weapon blueprints, mods, and accessories from other modes cannot be used.

b) All blueprints, weapon accessories, and the vast majority of Deviations obtained in RaidZone are exclusive to this mode and cannot be transferred out.

3. Exiting a RaidZone server does not require a Scenario Exit Card.

4. Characters can be transferred between RaidZone servers and regular Once Human servers.

a) You can pre-register for a regular Once Human server from a RaidZone server.

b) You can also pre-register for a RaidZone server from a regular Once Human server.

For more information about the server launch schedule, refer to the Server Opening Announcement: Link


Multi-Mode Account and Character Data Rules
You can tap the Mode icon in the top-right corner of the login screen to switch between RaidZone and regular mode and try out their different content!

The rules differ in each mode.

1. Account Data and Feature Availability

a) You can play Once Human and RaidZone with the same account. The account character limit is shared between modes. When you select a mode, that mode's characters will be prioritized for display. You can also view all characters across all modes in the character list.

b) Content that affects PvP balance (such as blueprints and mods) cannot be used in RaidZone, but their data is retained under your account. Cosmetics (such as fashion pieces, vehicle skins, and furniture skins) can be used in all modes.

c) While in RaidZone, characters cannot access Eternaland and the Spacetime Backpack until they leave the RaidZone match.

2. Shop and Events

a) Events: Events may differ between modes. For more information, refer to the Events interface.

b) Shop: Premium content purchased from the Shop is shared across all modes, including progress and items.

c) Battle Pass: Non-cosmetic Battle Pass rewards are independent for each mode and can be claimed once per mode. Cosmetic and Silver Key rewards are shared between modes and can only be claimed once per account. Cosmetics can be used in any mode.

 
Anti-Cheat Measures
RaidZone is a competitive PvP mode, so combating cheaters is our utmost priority. After analyzing data and our anti-cheat efforts from Early Access, we have implemented NetEase Games' strictest anti-cheat standards and automated enforcement protocols to immediately ban cheaters with minimal delay.

Beyond account bans, our zero-tolerance anti-cheat policy extends to include device bans and IP bans. We will also pursue legal action, including enforcement and lawsuits, against individuals or organizations who sell cheats.

Cheat prevention is an ongoing process. Cheat developers will continuously upgrade their tools in response to our anti-cheat policies and code. To assist our efforts, please report any suspicious players or behavior encountered in the game. If you have information about cheat sellers or providers, please inform us as well. Valid leads will be rewarded with cash prizes or valuable in-game items. Join us in our fight for fair play!

 

We hope that Once Human: RaidZone will deliver a satisfactory PvP experience. If you have any questions or suggestions, reach out to us via the Co-Dev Feedback Platform or our community channels. We're also preparing more content for future updates. Stay tuned!

 

Once Human Development Team

notes.title: Version 2.0.1 Update Announcement (July 16)
notes.notes:
Dear Metas,

The Version 2.0.1 server maintenance and update is planned for July 16 at 4:00 PM (PT) and is expected to last about 2 hours (actual time may differ). Please plan your game time accordingly for the best experience.

The update size is 2.3GB on PC, 570MB on Android, and 400MB on iOS(actual size may vary, non-updated clients will require 170MB additional patch). We recommend downloading the update over Wi-Fi.

This update will introduce multi-mode accounts and characters, new content for customer servers, server overload prompts, a fill-light function for Camera mode, a new Lightforge Loot Crate: Choose 1 of 3, and various optimizations and bug fixes.

Starchrom ×1,000, Mitsuko's Mark ×100, Starwish Token ×300, Detoxident ×3, and Blueprint Conversion Attempt ×3.

Below are the details of this update:


Content/Feature UpdatesMulti-Mode Account and Character Data Rules
To better serve the needs of different user groups, Once Human and Once Human: RaidZone will be split into separate modes. Once Human will continue to provide a deep and multifaceted survival experience, while Once Human: RaidZone will focus on fair and balanced PvP. Tap the Mode icon in the top-right corner of the login screen to switch between modes and try out their different content!

The rules differ in each mode.

1. System and Data

a) You can play Once Human and Once Human: RaidZone with the same account. The account character limit is shared between modes. When you select a mode, that mode's characters will be prioritized for display. You can also view all characters across all modes in the character list.

b) Content that affects PvP balance (such as blueprints and mods) cannot be used in Once Human: RaidZone, but their data is retained under your account. Cosmetics (such as fashion pieces, vehicle skins, and furniture skins) can be used in all modes.

c) While in Once Human: RaidZone, characters cannot access Eternaland and the Spacetime Backpack until they leave the RaidZone match.

2. Sign-Ups and Transfers

a) Characters in any mode can transfer to a scenario in another mode via the Scenario Sign-Up function. Scenarios from your current mode will be prioritized for display, so please choose carefully.

b) Characters on closed servers can sign up for a new scenario via the Sign-Up system (bottom-right corner of the character list), without having to go to Eternaland first.

3. Events

a) Mode-exclusive events can only be viewed and participated in within their respective modes.

b) Cross-mode events share the same completion progress. However, rewards may differ between modes. Resource and item rewards can be claimed once per mode. Cosmetic rewards can only be claimed once per account.

c) The actual rules will be provided in each event's description.

4. Battle Pass

a) Battle Pass purchase status and level are shared across modes. However, in Once Human: RaidZone, some standard rewards and max-level loot crate rewards may be replaced with RaidZone-exclusive rewards.

b) Battle Pass level is shared across modes. Resource and item rewards can be claimed once per mode.

c) Battle Pass cosmetic and Silver Key rewards can only be claimed once per account.
New Custom Server Content
1. Added Endless Dream to custom servers. The server host can now select the Endless Dream scenario.

2. Added badge cross-compatibility between custom and official servers.

On July 17, at 9:00 PM (PT), more custom servers and upgrade packages will be available on the official top-up page.

1. Maximum concurrent online players has been increased to 100. Purchase an upgrade package on the official top-up page to unlock this capacity!

2. On July 18, 2025, at 6:00 PM (PT), a limited number of servers will be restocked on the official top-up page.
Server Overload Prompts
To guarantee a smooth experience, we have added a server overload prompt to the ping indicator. The number represents your current network ping. If it turns red, it means the server is overloaded.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/451a49cd50de087cd681cd9571190b2ac31ec4fb.gif"]

1. Q: When does server overload occur?

A: Server overload often occurs when many players gather in the same area and engage in intense combat. The sudden spike in traffic exceeds the server's normal capacity, causing server overload.

2. Q: What happens when the server is overloaded?

A: You may experience lag while moving. Skill effects or damage calculations may also be delayed.

3. Q: What do I do when the server is overloaded?

A: To maintain a stable connection, avoid staying in areas with high player concentrations for extended periods. You can switch to a less crowded World or move to a different zone. If you encounter a server overload warning during an event, try reducing your attack frequency to minimize potential skill effect delays or damage lag.

The server will dynamically allocate resources to accommodate the combat situation. Data processing speed will slowly recover, allowing players to resume normal gameplay, and the server overload prompt will disappear. We will continue to optimize server performance to minimize this issue. Thank you for your understanding and support!
New Camera Fill-Light
A fill-light function has been added, giving you more control over your in-game photos.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/c68429e01c4778c4e2cd916a76097bf55cf7e253.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/23207cb4a8d32da9cac5b224247432892b454a66.png"]
New EventsNew Limited-Time Wish Machine Prize Pools
After the update on July 16 (PT), the following new Wish Machine prize pools will be available for 3 weeks:

Tranquil Frost: Includes the Legendary weapon blueprint: Silent Anabasis.

Frost Domain: Includes the Legendary gear blueprints: Snow Camo Gloves, Blackstone Hood, Blackstone Jacket, and Blackstone Shoes.

Perilous Explosives: Includes the Legendary weapon blueprint: Hazardous Object.
New Items in ShopLightforge Loot Crate Choose 1 of 3: Techno Stampede, Arcane Celestial, Stardust Edge
Available: After the update on July 16, 4:00 PM (PT)

Lightforge Loot Crate reruns! Choose one to open!

1. The Lightforge Loot Crate reruns come with collection progress rewards that can be claimed by old and new players who have collected Lightforge Collection items! Progress rewards include: loot crate themes, namecards, and a dyed version of the grand prize fashion.

2. Choose one of three themed Lightforge Loot Crates. You cannot change your choice after drawing/purchasing/redeeming from one or purchasing its half-price Lightforge Ingots.

3. The original draw probability, redemption cost, and guarantee system of each Loot Crate remain unchanged. Draw progress from previous runs is retained.

Attention veteran Meta-Humans: If you participated in previous loot crate events but found no records, please log in with the character used for those crates first to trigger inheritance!

NOTE: The draw rules for reruns differ from the current Lightforge Loot Crate. Every 30 draws from Techno Stampede or Arcane Celestial guarantees one top prize, which will then be removed from the prize pool. Every 20 draws from Stardust Edge guarantees a Lightforge Gem, which can be used to redeem a top prize. Please read the event rules carefully!

* Lightforge Loot Crates are shared across all characters on the same account! You can switch characters to participate in purchases, but only one Lightforge Loot Crate can be chosen during each Choose 1 of 3 event.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/d05eedab802e2c5b5fca7a5358fb8f0e5aa62b8b.png"]

* Lightforge Loot Crate Choose 1 of 3: Beach Bash, Hallow's Masquerade, Hype Party will be removed from sale after the update.
Upcoming Shop Updates
Available: July 24, 6:00 AM (server time)

"Let your pulse and excitement peak with each engine roar!"

The Blazing Speed character set (Epic Collection) and Speed Mania theme pack (Epic Collection) are coming.

Fueled by pure passion! Breathe, dominate, and sprint!

Collection Trait: A full-body luminescent effect that reacts to the game's day/night cycle.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/3b9901763ba478122984310f36a02793bfaa2c56.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/d9db09868990310cce12c061c45ba39519ba6739.gif"]

"Bathing is an elegant ritual."

The Chronowash territory furniture pack (Rare) is coming! Time to relax!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/789ce1330ab40e7cb3a6fd7628bd5cd1516bc343.png"]
OptimizationsOnce Human: RaidZone - Early Access Optimizations
1. To improve the balance between attacks and defenders and prevent reconnaissance from being too easy, we have adjusted territory visibility. You can now only see nearby player territories, and faraway territories can no longer be seen. When setting a territory, the borders of neighboring territories will be visible.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/488e94bda166cf4d121202a2e37b7d4fe9800b21.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/42618da1dce2305ff82206976af7722dff8374d3.png"]

2. You can no longer save territory buildings to a House Blueprint if you don't have the construction permissions.

3. We will adjust Deviant types and distribution, reduce the number of Elite enemies, and increase the rewards for defeating them.

4. The quantities of items sold by camp NPCs are now shared throughout the same scenario realm, rather than being independently counted for each player.

5. To provide a place for safe trading and socializing in Once Human: RaidZone, we have established Safe Zones at the locations of four NPC merchants. Inside a Safe Zone, players cannot be hurt, nor use weapons, tactical items, or other attacks.

* NOTE: If you log out while inside a Safe Zone, your HP will be automatically depleted after 30 minutes of inactivity.

6. New Ammo: Incendiary Blast

a) Small-Caliber Incendiary Blast

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/4401030167df87995159c32a65f12837aabf63a1.png"]

Deals increased damage to wooden structures and has a chance to ignite enemy units on hit. However, Bullet Velocity -25% and Damage Per Hit -10%.

b) Shotgun Incendiary Blast

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/afea87c257fa40a172abc7ef2c15d272b67f88c9.png"]

Deals increased damage to wooden structures and has a chance to ignite enemy units on hit. However, Damage Per Hit -10%.

c) Medium-Caliber Incendiary Blast

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/0f39f9941ea497ff082ace110e01a59d9a9cca06.png"]

Deals increased damage to wooden structures and has a chance to ignite enemy units on hit. However, Bullet Velocity -35% and Damage Per Hit -10%.

7. Combat Balance Adjustments

a) HV Ammo

i. Small-Caliber HV Ammo

BEFORE: Range +10, Stability -10. NOW: Bullet Velocity +35%.

ii. Shotgun HV Ammo

BEFORE: Range +10, Stability -10. NOW: Range +10, Bullet Velocity +50%.

iii. Medium-Caliber HV Ammo

BEFORE: Range +10, Stability -10. NOW: Bullet Velocity +20%.

iv. Sniper Rifle HV Ammo

BEFORE: Range +10, Stability -10. NOW: Bullet Velocity +20%.

b) Demolition Ammo

i. Medium-Caliber Demolition Ammo

BEFORE: Accuracy -13, Stability -13. NOW: Accuracy -13, Bullet Velocity -35%.

ii. Sniper Rifle Demolition Ammo

BEFORE: Accuracy -13, Stability -13. NOW: Accuracy -13, Bullet Velocity -35%.

8. Garages can now be built in Once Human: RaidZone. Find vehicle parts in the wilderness or craft them at a Supplies Workbench to build your dream vehicle.
The Way of Winter Update Test Optimizations
1. Adjusted the Chaosweaver respawn rules in each scenario phase. Chaosweaver levels are now capped at Lv. 35 in Phase I, Lv. 50 in Phase II, and Lv. 60 in Phase III.

2. Reduced Chaosweaver HP and gave them adaptive difficulty in multiplayer challenges.

3. Reduced the difficulty of the scenario progress tasks. You'll need to clear less extreme weather to earn rewards.

4. After the maintenance, the duration of phases in The Way of Winter - Update Test servers will be adjusted as follows:

Phase I: Shortened from 10 to 7 days

Phase II: Shortened from 10 to 7 days

Phase III: Shortened from 10 to 8 days
Combat
We will implement our planned balance adjustments in phase. In the July 16 (PT) update, adjustments to the following content will be implemented: Corrosion, Gas Mask Hood, Conflicting Memories, Pyroclasm Starter, Jaws, Pinpoint Strike, Outer Space, and First Electrocution.

For more information, see 战斗平衡性蓝贴链接

We will continue to monitor the performance and use rates of each build to see if further adjustments are required. Many players have reported that Raining Cash and Abyss Glance are underpowered. We plan to revamp Abyss Glance and adjust Raining Cash's suffixes (to improve its reloading and bolt-pulling experience) in a future update.

We've also received your feedback on the class system. We will gradually optimize the combat experience and stat balance of the class system in future updates.

To ensure a smooth transition, we will issue Blueprint Conversion Attempt ×3 to all players after this update.
Vehicles
1. You can now ride pillion on other players' motorcycles. Go for a joy ride together!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/4e86d8233df13c2678374fa8141817bc327887e2.png"]

2. To resolve the issue of mounting the wrong seat, we've added an independent interaction button for riding as a passenger.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/1189f1e3c6ad1e09462f273939866c1d871a08a9.png"]

3. To prevent an excessive number of buttons, we've moved all rarely used vehicle controls (such as repairing, changing skins, adding fuel, etc.) to the function wheel.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/1465504fd6271c484e33cd531448c40a13c8d3ad.png"]

On July 17, we'll roll out the first update since Version 2.0. This update will bring combat balance adjustments, as well as usability optimizations for vehicles and construction. Below is a preview of the upcoming content.

 
Balance Adjustments

We plan to revamp Abyss Glance and adjust Raining Cash's suffixes (to improve its reloading and bolt-pulling experience) in a future update.

We've also received your feedback on the class system. We will gradually optimize the combat experience and stat balance of the class system in future updates.

To ensure a smooth transition, we will issue Blueprint Conversion Attempt ×3 to all players after this update.

 
Vehicles
1) To align vehicle acquisition with the core survival and exploration gameplay, we have added vehicle scrapyards to the wilderness in all scenarios. After unlocking the Vehicle Garage in Memetics, you can craft Vehicle Repair Electric Drills at the Supplies Workbench and use them to repair and drive these vehicles.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/20eef38de1d20e928ea20cc39f588285da2cf912.gif"]

In non-RaidZone scenarios, vehicles with zero Durability no longer need to be returned to the Garage for repairs. Instead, they can still be summoned and repaired on the spot with Vehicle Repair Electric Drills.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/f96ef6ac41ba2ff0905fb86ace8371e1cf1cf76f.gif"]

Once you've driven a vehicle back to your territory, you can lock it for 5 Copper Ingots and 2 Metal Scraps either by interacting with the vehicle or through your Garage.

 

In non-RaidZone scenarios, vehicles you craft in your Garage are automatically locked, meaning you can summon them and change their skins by default. Additionally, you will never lose ownership of such vehicles.

 

After locking a vehicle, you can summon it or change its skin.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/ef5118cb11f3af95edaf9adb57d9f6feede7f0fd.gif"]

NOTE: In non-RaidZone modes, each player can own up to six locked vehicles. If you already have six vehicles, you must unlock one of them in your Garage before acquiring a new one.

 

2) Garages can now be built in RaidZone mode. Find vehicle parts in the wilderness or craft them at a Supplies Workbench to build your dream vehicle. Vehicles crafted in RaidZone are not locked by default, allowing you to share them with your teammates or trade them with other players.

In the Garage's vehicle list, you can view all vehicles in your territory's range, as well as lock them, change their skins, or modify and repair them.

 

(In non-RaidZone scenarios, you can view all your locked vehicles, regardless of location.)

In RaidZone, your locked vehicles will be unlocked if they are attacked by other players and their HP drops below 20%. An unlocked vehicle does not belong to any player, meaning any player can take it back to their territory and lock it for themselves.

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/be626c4d6601d02ce3f567744231a2177ac4c290.gif"]

NOTE: If your vehicle is stolen by another player in RaidZone mode, any applied skin will be removed, and the vehicle will revert to its default appearance.

 

3) You can now ride pillion on other players' motorcycles. We've also added an independent button for riding as a passenger. Go for a ride with your friends now!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/6b481a3a0bee197b392b64ccd362506e14dc7b88.gif"]

4) In non-RaidZone scenarios, players can summon two vehicles at once, satisfying their social needs.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/792c16e97a8491f84ce97d2095c8976cc6cfe1ec.gif"]

 
Construction
1)  Improved fence placement. Fences can now be placed on foundations and ceilings.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/70111f62558eb96d9198ae48591f76e1bba7bfca.png"]

2) When setting or relocating a territory, it will no longer snap to nearby territories by default.

3) Optimized the appearance of some wallpapers in the PC version. Open-work structures will no longer be fully covered.

After:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/4de14eb0be488499fd9296cdfbbf1a32a06c1e24.png"]
4) Expanded the area in which the territory can be moved while in flight mode. The construction area now includes four corners, and the territory height has been adjusted to the maximum range.

 
Server Selection Screen
To better serve the needs of different user groups, Once Human and Once Human: RaidZone will be split into separate modes after the July 17 update.

Once Human will continue to provide a deep and multifaceted survival experience, while Once Human: RaidZone will focus on fair and balanced PvP. Tap the Mode icon in the top-right corner of the login screen to switch between modes and try out their different content!

You can play on the different modes with the same account. The account character limit is shared between modes.

In RaidZone mode, content that affects PvP balance (such as blueprints and mods) cannot be used. Cosmetics and other assets can be used in all modes.

 
New Custom Server Content
1. Added Endless Dream to custom servers. The server host can now select the Endless Dream scenario.

2. Added badge cross-compatibility between custom and official servers.

On July 18, 2025, at 12:00 noon (UTC+8), more custom servers and upgrade packages will be available on the official top-up page.

 

 
Server Overload Prompts
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/451a49cd50de087cd681cd9571190b2ac31ec4fb.gif"]

For some time now, we've been receiving player feedback regarding server latency issues. Through data analysis, we've identified that high latency mostly occurs when servers are under high load, such as when many players gather in the same area and engage in intense combat. The sudden spike in data traffic exceeds the server's normal capacity, causing server overload. This in turn leads to movement lag, as well as delayed skill effects and damage calculations.

We're working on fixing this issue. However, a complete fix will not be available in the short term, as it requires fundamental server architecture and gameplay changes. Hence, we have added a server overload prompt to the ping indicator. If it turns red, it means the server is overloaded. The server will then dynamically allocate resources to accommodate the combat situation, after which data processing speed will slowly return to normal. You can also switch to a different World or leave the affected area to maintain a stable connection.

This is a short-term solution intended to help players monitor the server load status and avoid negative experiences. We remain committed to implementing performance improvements and server load optimizations as well, so as to achieve smoother gameplay for all players.

 

 
Save Your Controls
In this update, we're introducing a way to save your PC control setup to the cloud, as well as the ability to share your mobile control layout via a share code. This will allow you to apply your preferred controls across multiple devices.

Save PC control settings to the cloud: You can now upload your control settings and download and apply them as needed.

Share control layout on mobile: You can now share or quickly import a custom control layout on mobile via a share code.

 

That concludes our update preview! For more details, stay tuned for the official update announcement. If you have any suggestions, feel free to reach out via our Feedback Platform or community channels. Thank you for your continued support. We'll be adding more new content during our summer update, so stay tuned!

 

Once Human Development Team

notes.title: Once Human: RaidZone Update Preview
notes.notes:
Since the launch of Once Human: RaidZone, we have been closely monitoring the PvP combat and balance in this mode.

Following a period of observation and analysis, we plan to address several game balance issues. In this post, we will share our preliminary plans so you can provide feedback.


Territory Optimizations
Attacking and defending territories is a core gameplay element in Once Human: RaidZone. Currently, some construction features may provide unfair intel advantages, affecting the mode's fairness. Hence, we plan to disable or limit certain features, such as using flight mode in Construction mode, in RaidZone only.

We want to ensure that all players, whether attacking or defending, can compete on an equal footing, where victory is decided by skill, effort, and strategy rather than exploiting shortcuts.

 
Manibus Summon Adjustments
The Manibus summon mechanic is a key feature designed to increase excitement and add variation to Once Human: RaidZone. However, its current implementation does not fully align with our aims.

Notably, its excessive damage and server impact have disrupted Once Human: RaidZone's intended pace.

To make this mechanic more manageable, we're planning adjustments to the following key areas:

1) Increase the tech requirements and resource costs of crafting Evolution Control Units and Manibus's Beacons.

2) Reduce the range of Manibus strikes and limit the damage they deal to structures, making them less destructive than before.

3) Remove the post-strike area effects that continuously drain Sanity and spawn additional Realm Fragments.

4) Reduce the impact of Manibus strikes on the server's realm destruction progress.

In the future, we will implement more comprehensive adjustments to the Manibus summon mechanic. We aim to refine it into a core aspect of the attackers vs. defenders gameplay. Stay tuned!

 
Friendly Fire
Currently in Once Human: RaidZone, having a simple numerical superiority has a disproportionate impact on team battle outcomes, significantly affecting game balance.

To place more emphasis on team coordination and strategy, we will introduce a friendly fire mechanic. This means weapons, Deviation skills, and other attacks will damage allied units and structures.

We will continue to monitor this feature and gather player feedback to decide if further adjustments are necessary.

 
Weapon Accessories Changed to Items
Currently in Once Human: RaidZone, players who wish to strengthen their weapons must spend large amounts of time and resources to unlock accessories via the Memetics system. This approach has clear limitations, not only putting pressure on the player but also restricting their strategic options.

To deliver a richer and freer gameplay experience, we will convert weapon accessories into item form. The actual changes are as follows.

We will change weapon accessories into individual equipment items.

1) Each accessory can only be equipped to one weapon.

2) Equipped accessories can be unequipped and returned to the Tool Backpack.

3) Accessories can be obtained through crafting, exploration, PvP loot, and other methods.

4) Equipped accessories stay on their weapons. Weapons that are transferred through Gear Crates or dropped will retain their equipped accessories.

These changes will diversify players' strategic options in the game. You no longer need to unlock Memetics to strengthen their weapons. As long as you have enough accessory items, you can maintain high stats on weapons in your Supply Box. If you find an accessory while exploring, you can use it to instantly strengthen your current weapon without spending additional resources to unlock Memetics. Additionally, the appearance of rare accessories will greatly improve a weapon's value, making them a high priority during PvP encounters.

 
Anti-Cheat Measures
Fair competition is the core principle of Once Human: RaidZone. We do not tolerate the use of cheats, exploits, or other malicious acts that undermine fair play and the player experience. Combating cheaters is one of our top priorities, and we have implemented a series of forceful countermeasures to this end.

 

We are constantly upgrading our anti-cheat monitoring system. We reverse-engineer third-party cheat programs to learn more about their development and operation, allowing us to better detect and prevent them. Simultaneously, we continue to refine our detection models, using cutting-edge AI and Big Data technologies to analyze and compare player behavior in real time. To date, we have implemented over 100 optimizations to our detection models, and fixed exploitable loopholes involving teleportation, flight, speed-ups, and more.

 

We are also aware of players using "cheat carrying"—knowingly playing with cheaters—to gain unfair advantages. This behavior not only affects the game's balance, but also harms other players, causing frustration to those seeking fair competition. We will show zero tolerance to players who break the rules and impose strict penalties based on the severity of their offenses.

 

We are developing a series of features that will make it easier for players to combat such malicious behavior.

Banned players will be displayed on a real-time ticker in the wilderness. Player namecards will also show their ban status, and similar information will be shown on death screens. We are also developing quick-report buttons and other reporting options.

These features will improve our ability to collaborate with players in maintaining a fair and pleasant game environment.

 

Since the beginning of this year, we have worked closely with our legal team to report and take down online stores selling cheats. So far, we have successfully reported and taken down 617 cheat sellers. But that's not all—we are compiling evidence and working with our legal team and the authorities to launch an even stronger crackdown on cheat developers and distributors. We will wield all legal measures to hold such entities accountable for their illegal actions.

 
Conclusion
The above changes are not final. We will implement further adjustments via future updates if required.

Encountering issues with the territory controls? Have feedback on the Collapse feature or thoughts on team battles and weapon accessories? Reach out to us via the Co-Dev Feedback Platform or our social media channels. We're also preparing more gameplay features for our summer update. Stay tuned!

 

Once Human Development Team

Content/Feature UpdatesNew PvE Scenario: Endless Dream
If the apocalypse descends in a dream, would you be prepared to face it?

In an ever-shifting dreamscape, you must hunt down the Original Entity behind the nightmares and awaken the world from its terrible slumber.



1. Gameplay Features

a) Full Map Access: All existing regions are accessible in Phase I. Explore Nalcott in its entirety—from the southern Broken Delta to Ember Strand in the north—right from the get-go.

b) Dream Zones: Layers of nested Dream Zones encroach upon the wilderness, each featuring unique environmental traits and combat effects. As you venture deeper into the nightmares, their effects stack and multiply. As a Meta-Human, your mission is to purify these layered zones to reshape the environment and its rules. Construction is possible inside Dream Zones even without a Territory Terminal, allowing you to unleash your creativity and overcome the nightmare by any means possible.

c) Player-Driven Progress and Multiple Endings: Dream Zones and Deviants will evolve as the scenario progresses, presenting ever-changing challenges. As Meta-Humans eliminate Eternal Dreamers, they will reduce the durations of Phases I to V, intensifying the scenario's pace and difficulty. Your collective efforts to purge the Eternal Dreamers will also decide the world's fate. Will the world be saved, or will you witness its ultimate destruction? The outcome rests entirely in your hands.

3. Scenario Features

a) Dream Zones

Eternal Nightmare Tubes will continuously generate Deep Dreamers, and Deep Dreamers will continuously generate Light Dreamers. All three types of Nightmare Tubes will transform their surroundings into Dream Zones.

When you are in a Dream Zone:

i. You accumulate Strayness over time. When you reach the limit, you will descend into the nightmare and black out. You can craft Reality Resetols to reset your current Strayness. Deviants known as Nightmares roam the Dream Zones. If you meet their gaze, your Strayness accumulation will speed up.

ii. You can build freely. However, you cannot place a Territory Terminal inside a Dream Zone.

iii. You may encounter Dream Zone events. Complete them to receive rewards from the Dream Zone.

Clear the Dream Zones and restore Nalcott to its former glory!

b) Dreamfused Items

Dream Zones are home to three unique gathering materials: Dreamweaver Trees, Dreamweaver Fruit, and Wakeful Clocks. You can also obtain special drops known as Reality Fragments.

i. Dreamweaver Tree: A tree with leaves of red crystal. Fell it to acquire Stardust Source.

ii. Dreamweaver Fruit: A floating fruit. You'll need to build structures to gather them and acquire various crystals.

iii. Wakeful Clock: A scattered clock. Use tools to gather them and acquire Wakeful Sand.

iv. Reality Fragment: Defeat Deep Dreamers or Light Dreamers to acquire Reality Fragments.

c) Nightmare Tubes

Nightmare Tubes are sinister reliquaries housing twisted dream creatures. When a courageous person uses Wakeful Sand to awaken a Nightmare Tube from its dream, a "minor" disturbance will spill into the real world. Nightmare Tubes will summon different Nightmarelings when awakened, in order of descending power: Eternal Dreamers, Deep Dreamers, and Light Dreamers. You must expend Reality Fragments to obtain the full rewards for defeating an Eternal Dreamer.

i. Eternal Dreamers: Dream sovereigns that have breached the Dream Zone to manifest in reality. Brutal, chaotic, and wielding unfathomable power, they wreak disaster across the continent. They are both unstoppable titans and the ruthless enforcers of the nightmare world. While present, they will absorb the Nightmare Specs and Nightmare States of all nearby Deep Dreamers.

ii. Deep Dreamers: Nightmare wraiths born from gigantic Nightmare Tubes, they are the source of this calamity and creators of despair. While present, they will provide nearby Light Dreamers with Nightmare Specs, and nearby Eternal Dreamers with their Nightmare Specs and Nightmare States.

iii. Light Dreamers: Sinister entities born from smaller Nightmare Tubes, they surge forth and leave misfortune and calamities in their wake. While present, they provide nearby Deep Dreamers with their Nightmare States.

Nightmare States come in attribute and mechanic types. Attribute-type Nightmare States apply to all enemies in the area, while mechanic-type Nightmare States apply only to specific targets (such as Eternal Dreamers).

Mechanic-type Nightmare States: Bubbly Constitution and Bubbly Energy.

Attribute-type Nightmare States: Strength Parasite and Symbiosis.

d) Nightmare Specs

Deep Dreamers provide three types of Nightmare Specs: Explosive, Lightning, and Evernight.

i. Explosive Specs: Causes random, large-area explosions that destroy trees and ores. Deviants explode upon death. If killed by a Weakspot hit, they drop an Unstable Energy orb that can be directed before detonating shortly after. Deviants also gain a shield that provides high DMG Reduction (especially Sorrows!) and can only be broken by Unstable Energy orbs.

ii. Lightning Specs: Lightning will strike periodically. During the inactive phase, lightning strikes are slow and come with a warning. During the active phase, lightning strikes fast with almost no warning! If lightning strikes ore, metal ingots are produced—a rare gift from nature! Rosetta has invented the Lightning Rod to counter these lightning strikes effectively.

iii. Evernight Specs: Meta-Humans in this zone suffer from Dark Corrosion, which quickly builds up Strayness and reduces visibility. If left unchecked, vision worsens and HP steadily drops. Nightmare Light Sources spawn here. Staying close to them helps resist Dark Corrosion and improves visibility. They can also be gathered and used to craft Lumen and Nightmare Lanterns.

e) Specs Entities

Different Nightmare Specs result in different entities.

i. Dream Zone Entities

Nightmareling: An entity that appears in all Dream Zones. Staring at it leads to rapid Strayness accumulation. It will physically pursue Meta-Humans who have almost gone astray in the nightmare. If you have less than 10 minutes of activity left in the Dream Zone, it will teleport to hunt you.

Countermeasures: Construct buildings in the Dream Zone to block Nightmarelings, avoid staring at them, or use Dreamruptive ammo to defeat them.

ii. Explosive Entities

Sorrow: Its unique physiology renders it immune to all damage except explosions. Once it locks onto a target, it will relentlessly pursue them and self-destruct in close proximity, causing nearby units to rapidly lose body temperature.

Countermeasures: Use explosion damage or Unstable Energy orbs to defeat Sorrows.

Innocence: A huge teddy bear born from the dreams of children who adore plush toys and TV shows. Despite appearances, its large fists aren't soft at all, and will burst open when the bear is defeated, unleashing smaller bears from within. And when these smaller bears are defeated, they will unleash even smaller bears.

Countermeasures: Prioritize your targets to keep the enemy count under control.

iii. Lightning Entities

Pain: A unique Deviant that spawns in Nightmare Specs: Lightning zones. Lighting strikes more frequently around Pains and charges them, making them more powerful. However, lightning may also cause them to overload.

Countermeasures: Use lightning orbs to reduce their charge.

iv. Evernight Entities

Spawns Dread and Shade Deviants.

Dread: Only spawns in Nightmare Specs: Evernight zones. Dreads are completely invisible beyond a certain distance. If you get closer, you can see their outline, but they remain protected by Shades and cannot be damaged.

Countermeasures: Nightmare Light Sources can temporarily dispel a Dread's Shade status. You can also use Lumen to remove their Shade protection.


Class System Public Test
To enrich your experience and help you thrive on Nalcott, we are introducing a class system, currently in public testing. Rediscover the world and unleash new possibilities with your chosen class!

* During the public test, you can try the class system without limitations. We will refine the class system based on your feedback. Please submit your suggestions on social media or the Co-Dev Feedback Platform!



The following classes will be available: Chef, Gardener, and Beastmaster.

Each class has a core ability and three unique talents. The core ability fundamentally alters the gameplay rules, while the talents synergize with it to sharpen each class's distinct identity and role.

1. The Chef freely chooses ingredients to craft unique dishes without being restricted by recipes. During creative cooking, there's a chance for a Success that grants the dish enhanced effects with longer durations.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/8e4bae4bb97397bc24cf7b18e5dbcc52c4433635.png"]



2. The Gardener specializes in crops and biomechanics. Can graft crops with other crops or biomechanical parts to yield dual-stat crops or special biomechanical crops. Biomechanical parts are sometimes dropped by Biomechanical Deviants in the wilderness.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/566a7fb29a877a29c71a57f70532123343a8b498.png"]

3. The Beastmaster uses a Beast Whistle to summon and command a Beast Partner to fight, gather, or mine. The Beast Partner can be changed in the territory.





[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/93f2e2c389b204c4437e235761ba145053bbce95.png"]

Notes

1. Availability: The class system will be available in all non-novice scenarios, excluding Once Human: RaidZone.

2. You can choose your class in the wilderness after creating a new character on a server and completing the tutorial tasks.

For existing characters who are at least Lv. 2 before the maintenance, we will issue a unique item that allows you to change your class immediately.

3. If you cannot decide on a class or prefer not to use the class system, you can choose the Freelancer class. The Freelancer class has no unique abilities, but will be given a class-change item.

4. We will regularly refine and balance the class system based on your feedback, as well as add more classes. When that happens, we will issue class-change items to allow you to reselect your class.

notes.title: ANNUAL VERSION 2.0: DREAMVEIL UPDATE PREVIEW - ENDLESS DREAM OFFICIAL LAUNCH
notes.notes:
Where does the nightmare end? Have you ever fought to wake from a terrible dream, only to emerge in another? The new Endless Dream scenario officially launches on July 3!

 
1. Scenario Overview
Nalcott has been plunged into a bizarre daydream. A colossal eye hangs in the sky, the world is shrouded in a hallucinogenic mist, and strange arms extend from flickering television sets... Meta-Humans seek to escape, but at the end of the dream lies an unending nightmare...



Purge the Nightmare!The first PvE scenario with full map access and dynamic progression

The nightmare has descended, and layered Dream Zones encroach upon the world. The once-familiar continent of Nalcott has been twisted into a grotesque realm. Dreams become real—everlasting night, lightning storms, explosions... Regions under the Dream Zones' influence are warped into extreme and hazardous environments. You must work together to purge the nightmare before it consumes everything.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/784a75d348115ea72ddf85408221e67c9a427889.jpg"]A new survival experience awaits. In this scenario, Meta-Humans have a new survival parameter: Strayness. The Dream Zones will expand dynamically until they envelop the entire continent. Will you save the world or witness its destruction? Your combined efforts will determine the fate of Nalcott!



Full Map Access

The full map is accessible from the start. Explore Nalcott in its entirety—from the southern Broken Delta to Ember Strand in the north—right from the get-go.

 

Freely Build in Overlapping Dream Zones:

Layers of nested Dream Zones encroach upon the wilderness, each featuring unique environmental traits and combat effects. As you venture deeper into the nightmares, their effects stack and multiply. As a Meta-Human, your mission is to purify these layered zones to reshape the environment and its rules. Construction is possible inside Dream Zones even without a Territory Terminal, allowing you to unleash your creativity and overcome the nightmare by any means possible.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/c910683733864a39aefdfcb23840d990c86e00bc.jpg"]

Ultimate Freedom of Construction

In Dream Zones, you can build freely even without a Territory Terminal. Unleash your creativity and use every tool at your disposal to banish the nightmares.

  
2. Optimizations
During Early Access, 288,546 players tested the Endless Dream scenario for a total of 6,836,263 hours. Activating1,476,603 Nightmare Tubes and defeating 169,706 Deep Dreamers with their combined efforts, they dispelled the Dream Zone's mist and liberated Nalcott from the nightmare's grasp, bringing it back into the daylight.

Throughout Early Access, our Co-Dev Feedback Platform received 3,569 pieces of feedback on the Endless Dream scenario, and we've implemented 33 optimizations based on your input.

 

Below is a partial list of the optimizations, including some to be implemented with the July 3 update.

Exploration

1) Removed the restriction on teleportation in Dream Zones to make adventuring more convenient.

2) Reduced the strength of wilderness enemies in the early to mid-game, making exploration less dangerous and more enjoyable.

 

Dungeons/Challenges

1) Fixed an issue with lost damage in dungeons to ensure realistic and fluid combat feedback.

2) Reduced the strength of enemies in Securement Silos and Monoliths on all difficulties to match other scenarios.

3) Simplified the process for dispelling Deep Dreamers, reducing the challenge difficulty to make progression more friendly.

 

Wilderness

1) Improved the Endless Dream tutorial to help players familiarize themselves with the game more quickly.

2) Added safe Dream Zones in Lv. 10–20 regions to make it easier to gather Dream Zone materials for steady growth.

3) Improved the visual design of the three starting strongholds in Endless Dream, making them more distinctive and immersive.

4) Reduced the damage that Nightmare Specs deal to buildings and vehicles to make construction more worthwhile.

 

Resource Acquisition

1) Restored resource drops to Securement Silos and Monoliths on all difficulties to make your adventures more rewarding.

2) Restored crystal spawns to non-Dream Zone areas of the wilderness to improve access to resources.

​

In Development

We are also working on additional content based on your feedback and suggestions.

Building on the current mechanics, we'll introduce new Dream Zone purification challenges, including the Dream Zone Purification and Dream Zone Invasion activities.

Unlike simply defeating a Dreamer and clearing a Dream Zone, purifying a Dream Zone will remove its hazardous elements while retaining its resource output characteristics.

As players clear and purify Dream Zones, they will evolve and counterattack, invading previously untouched regions. This will bring a constant sense of excitement and challenge to your adventure.

Going forward, we plan to add more random events to Dream Zones to make every adventure unpredictable and unique.

Within this enriched gameplay framework, long-awaited exclusive Morphed Deviations are also coming.

Additionally, we'll continue to optimize resource distribution and difficulty to maintain game balance and playability.

The highly anticipated Visional Wheel × Endless Dream is also nearing the final stages of development. We'll have more news for you soon!

 
3. Endless Dream and The Way of Winter Permanent Servers
Due to overwhelming demand for a stable and persistent survival and exploration experience, permanent servers are coming to Endless Dream and The Way of Winter update test servers on July 3! This means that your favorite snowy realm and dream zones will become permanent features of the wasteland with no time limit!

The Way of Winter test servers and Endless Dream scenario servers will be converted into permanent servers after they end. Characters on these servers will be transferred to the permanent server.

 

Permanent server details are as follows:

Endless Dream Permanent Server

In addition to your level, resources, and territory buildings being carried over, permanent servers will have independently evolving Dream Zones to offer fresh and diverse challenges.

 

The Way of Winter - Update Test Server

Due to major mechanical changes, permanent servers for The Way of Winter update test servers will operate independently from permanent servers for the original version of The Way of Winter.

In addition to your level, resources, and territory buildings being carried over, Personal Thermal Tower levels will be preserved, and Public Thermal Towers on permanent servers will be at max level by default.

 

We'll continue to monitor these servers and make adjustments based on your feedback and our overall plan. We may introduce exclusive new content or minor adjustments to maintain the longevity of the servers. Stay tuned to our official announcements for the latest news.

 

 

Once Human Development Team

notes.title: Version 1.6.3 Update Announcement (June 18)
notes.notes:
Dear Metas,
We have scheduled the Version 1.6.3 server maintenance and update for June 18 at 4:00 PM (PT). The maintenance is expected to last about 2 hours, but the actual duration may differ. Please plan your game time accordingly for the best experience.

This update will introduce Version 1.0 of custom servers, a server launch schedule feature, a new Battle Pass: Final Gambit, Lightforge Loot Crate Comeback: Choose 1 of 3, and various optimizations and bug fixes.

To thank you for your support during Early Access, we'll be issuing the following rewards via in-game mail after this update: Starchrom ×1,000, Mitsuko's Mark ×100, Starwish Token ×300, and Detoxident ×3.
Below are the details of this update:Content/Feature Updates
Custom Servers Version 1.0

Version 1.0 of custom servers will officially launch after the maintenance on June 18 (PT). The main updated content is as follows:

1. We've increased the number of servers available for purchase on the web. If they sell out, we'll announce a restock schedule.

2. To provide more character customization options, we've enabled the Shop, Lightforge Loot Crates, Battle Pass, and other premium features on custom servers. Additionally, premium cosmetics are now shared between official and custom servers.

Rules:

1) Your Crystgin, Lightforge Gems, Lightforge Ingots, Lightforge Relics, and Silver Keys are shared between official and custom servers. You can use these currencies to purchase or redeem premium cosmetics on custom servers.

2) Your Lightforge Loot Crate guarantee counter, draw history, and discounted Lightforge Ingot purchase limits are shared between official and custom servers.

3) All premium cosmetics are shared between official and custom servers. Fashion items and furniture formulas obtained through the Shop, Lightforge Loot Crates, or the Battle Pass can be used on custom servers. Likewise, any premium cosmetics obtained through these means can also be used on official servers.

4) Your Battle Pass is shared between official and custom servers, including its edition, level, and reward claim progress. Cosmetics and Silver Keys obtained through the Battle Pass can be used on both official and custom servers. The amount of Battle Pass Exp gained on a custom server is affected by the server's parameters.

5) Once purchased, Meta Pass privileges are available on both official and custom servers. Note that the Starshine Coffer guarantee is tracked separately for official and custom servers.

3. You can now purchase renewals or upgrades for your custom server. For more information, refer to the custom server purchase interface.

4. Increased the maximum number of registered players per server from 500 to 1,000.

5. Various optimizations and bug fixes.

Thank you for your feedback and suggestions during Early Access!

New Feature: Server Launch Schedule

We've added a Server Launch Schedule feature to the scenario sign-up interface. Now, you can easily view the next opening time and frequency for each scenario, making it easier to choose your scenario and plan your game time.

You can now pre-register for your next scenario during the first 7 days of your current scenario's settlement phase. This lets you plan your next adventure in advance. After successfully pre-registering, you will enter the new scenario right after your current settlement phase ends, so you don't have to worry about server capacity issues. You can also cancel your pre-registration at any time.

New Discord Features

1. View private chats while offline!

If two players have linked their Discord accounts, their in-game chat messages will appear in their direct message conversation on Discord. Likewise, their Discord direct messages (text only) will be forwarded to their in-game chat.

2. View Hive and Warband channel messages while offline!

In the game, Hive leaders and Warband admins can link their Hive/Warband group chat to a specific channel in the Discord server (admin role required). Once linked, all text messages posted in that channel will be synced with the in-game group chat.

notes.title: Version 1.6.2 Bug Fixes (June 11)
notes.notes:
Dear Metas,

If you encounter any issues while playing, please contact us using the following methods:

PC: Open the in-game ESC menu → Feedback & Customer Support → Select Bug Report to submit your issue.

Mobile: Tap the menu button in the upper right corner → Tap the headphone icon in the sidebar → Select Customer Support → Then choose Bug Report to submit your feedback.



If you're offline, you can also report issues via our official email: oncehuman@global.netease.com. We'll investigate as soon as we receive your message.



Since the official release of Once Human version 1.6.2, we have been gathering community feedback and actively addressing your concerns. Here are the latest fixes we have implemented:

1. Fixed an issue where character weight changes sometimes did not apply when entering or exiting dungeons.

2. Fixed an issue where players could see damage numbers not caused by themselves.

3. Fixed an issue where the scope was sometimes misaligned on the Quantum Fission - HAMR weapon skin.

4. Fixed an issue where Stardust's Advent was incorrectly dropped during Thermal Tower purification.

5. Fixed an issue in Endless Dream where the Scenario Challenge task 'Defeat Manibus, the Creepling once' could not be completed.

6. Fixed an issue where players sometimes could not log in if they were offline during scenario settlement.

7. Fixed an issue where the Evolution Control Unit, Manibus's Beacon, and Ursula were missing from Once Human: RaidZone custom servers.

8. Fixed an issue causing stutter in Deviated Zones near Riddle Spots in Endless Dream.

9. Fixed an issue preventing character deletions on custom servers.

10. Fixed an issue where players could not purchase from the Blueprint Shop on custom servers.

11. Fixed an issue where equipping the Treacherous Tide set caused abnormal HP after teleporting while low on Sanity.

12. Fixed an issue where a 'blueprint obtained' prompt was incorrectly shown when creating a new character on a custom server.

13. Fixed an issue in The Way of Winter where players could not interact with crates in the Black Gold dungeon.

14. Fixed a display issue affecting the Starfall Inversion event.

15. Fixed an issue where some outdoor facilities, including the Vending Machine and Thermal Tower, did not load.




Once Human Development Team

In modes prone to these issues, such as Dream Zones in Endless Dream, we may adjust reward distribution to better reflect player effort, discouraging AFK farming and excessive crowding. notes.title: Version 1.6.2 Update Announcement On June 4th
notes.notes:
Dear Metas,
We have scheduled the Version 1.6.2 server maintenance and update for June 4 at 4:00 PM(PT). The maintenance is expected to last about 2 hours, but the actual duration may differ. Please plan your game time accordingly for the best experience.
This update brings Early Access for custom servers, testing for an enhanced version of The Way of Winter, the Visional Wheel S1 limited-time event Stargate Rush, a new item recovery feature, and several optimizations and bug fixes.
Below are the details of this update:
Content/Feature Updates
Custom Servers - Early Access
Early Access for custom servers in Once Human has arrived! Custom servers are player-managed rental servers. Players can rent a server and customize its gameplay settings to create unique experiences. After the host opens the server, other players can join. This model is widely used in popular games and offers greater autonomy and variety to our players.
* During Early Access, cosmetic items purchased from the Shop cannot be shared with custom servers. When custom servers officially launch on June 18 (PT), paid cosmetics will be shared across both official and custom servers.
Early Access Period: June 4 – June 17(PT) (Official launch scheduled for after the update on June 19)
This early access trial will adopt a limited sale + invitation-only model:
1.Each region will have a limited number of available server rentals. The details will be shown on the rental page.
2.Outstanding community members and players who previously participated in custom server tests will be invited to participate in this Early Access for free.
3.Players who make purchases during the event will receive equivalent Crystgin rebates.
In most games, players must rent and configure custom servers on their own, which can be complicated. To simplify this process and mitigate risks associated with third-party hosting—such as security vulnerabilities, unstable performance, lack of maintenance, and cumbersome configuration—we provide official server rentals and offer reliable support at every step.
Renting a server for personal use is often more expensive than using official servers. This is because Once Human an online game that requires servers to handle complex processing tasks, open-world simulation, and data storage. However, personal servers typically host fewer players, resulting in higher costs on average. After internal discussions, we've decided to offer custom server rentals at cost price with no markup, ensuring players can access professional-grade service at a reasonable cost.
* The in-game access point for renting a custom server may vary depending on the game version or platform partner.
For more information, see https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2139460/view/545610646775924366
The Way of Winter - Update Test
We're launching The Way of Winter scenario servers with the Update Testing tag, featuring an enhanced version of The Way of Winter with deeper survival mechanics and improved strategic depth. Details on the update are below.
* The Way of Winter scenario with the Update Testing tag is not a new scenario, but an upgraded version of the existing The Way of Winter. During the initial testing period, both versions of The Way of Winter will co-exist. However, all subsequent The Way of Winter servers will exclusively feature the Update Testing tag.
1. Updated Thermal Tower Mechanics: Thermal Towers are now large structures that can be built within your territory. You can share their effects with other players via their permission settings. They no longer take up large amounts of space in the wilderness.
2. Updated Extreme Weather Mechanics: Extreme weather will now spread gradually across the wilderness as the scenario progresses. In each phase, new extreme weather effects will appear—not just temperature changes, but special regional effects that bring different survival challenges. If players don't deal with the extreme weather in time, the temperature impact will spread to nearby areas.
3. New Public Structure - Chaosium Hubs: You can use a special item called the Chaosium Heart at Chaosium Hubs to reduce the level of extreme weather in an area. You can also summon the Chaosweaver and defeat it to dispel the temperature effects. Doing so will completely remove the extreme weather for that phase. Also, you can spend Raw Chaosium at Chaosium Hubs to gain special regional buffs to help you survive harsh environments.
4. Updated Scenario Endings: The scenario ending is now tied to the number of times players clear the extreme weather. Work together to overcome the harsh conditions and secure a brighter future for the snowy realm!
5. Other Optimizations: Improved the temperature-related prompts and transitions between regions, making it easier for players to understand and respond to temperature changes.
NOTE: This update test for The Way of Winter does not include expanded PvE content. All tasks, dungeons, Public Crisis Events, and other gameplay elements are also unchanged. Only the survival mechanics and strategic depth have been optimized. Please try the updated scenario and let us know your thoughts via social media or the Co-Dev Feedback Platform!
For more information, see https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2139460/view/545610646775924370
New Item Loss Prevention and Recovery Features
1. Many players have reported losing items during scenario transitions. We've found that this is primarily due to the Spacetime Backpack becoming full during scenario settlement, causing excess items to be lost. To address this issue, we are optimizing the scenario settlement process so that items will no longer be sent to your Spacetime Backpack or Temporary Backpack upon leaving a scenario. Instead, they will stored in the Transit Storage, which has ample capacity to hold all your items from the scenario. You can then manually transfer items to your Spacetime Backpack as needed.
* If you lost items before this fix, please contact the in-game Customer Support. Due to the high volume of data, be sure to include detailed information about the lost items to help our team locate and restore them.
2. We've also introduced a new item recovery feature, allowing you to retrieve personal items (such as collectibles) left in other players' territories. This feature is only available in PvE scenarios.
For more information, see https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2139460/view/545610646775926291
New Events
Visional Wheel S1 Limited-Time Event: Stargate Rush
As the Vision descends, Stargate Rush begins!
Period: June 5 – June 19 （server time）
The inverted star unleashes its gravity tides, lifting racetracks of passion and glory into the sky!
Team up with the one and only V and soar freely through the air at extreme speeds, carving your dazzling legacy into Nalcott's skies!
Collect reward rings during the event to unlock an awesome new V skin, the Zero Gravity namecard theme, and many more rewards!{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/ae9e379f65021a107bcaacd2bab0ca61bcb86257.jpg
New Limited-Time Wish Machine Prize Pools
After the update on June 4 (PT), the following new Wish Machine prize pools will be available for 3 weeks.
Doom Hunter: Includes the Legendary weapon blueprint: Doombringer.
Outer Power Surge: Includes the Legendary weapon blueprint: Outer Space.

New Shop Arrivals
1. Lightforge Loot Crate: Dusk Echo (available after the June 4 update, PT)
"Is it an echo of quantum entanglement, or the herald of eternal dusk?"
New Void Wings cosmetics are here! The herald from beyond the skies brings the blessings of dusk. Lightforge Loot Crate: Dusk Echo includes the Quantum Echo fashion set (Legendary), Dusk Herald Void Wings skin (Legendary), Quantum Fission - HAMR weapon skin (Legendary), and Torrent Bastion territory collectible (Epic Hype). 2. Future Shop Arrivals (available from June 12, 6:00 AM server time)

Optimizations
Once Human: RaidZone - Early Access Optimizations
1. Moved Wish Stones from the Consumables tab to the Special tab in the Backpack.
2. Improved the storage of completed buildings. You can now deposit buildings constructed during a match into built Storage Crates.
NOTE: You cannot store buildings in scenarios other than Once Human: RaidZone.
3. Optimized the lockdown method for restricted areas.
4. Added skin support for the Rustic Crossbow. To maintain balance, the ADS zoom ratio has been standardized for all crossbows equipped with the Iron Sight weapon accessory, ensuring consistent magnification whether or not a skin is applied.
5. Reduced bullet spread by 10% for all weapons. Reduced horizontal recoil by 20% for all weapons. Reduced vertical recoil by 10% for pistols, rifles, and light machine guns. Reduced vertical recoil by 20% for SMGs. Reduced visual recoil for fully automatic weapons.
6. Reduced horizontal gliding speed by 15%. Reduced sprint stamina cost by 50%. Increased movement speed when downed by 100%.
7. Adjusted the bullet-loading and ready-to-fire timings when reloading to better match the character's reload animation.
Endless Dream - Early Access Optimizations
1.The highest-level Light Dreamers now only drop Pro-rarity mod selection crates.
2. Optimized the lightning strike environmental effect. After lightning destroys certain ores, it will directly produce the corresponding metal ingots.
Monetization Experience Optimizations
Optimized the displayed sorting on the Weapon Sticker and Weapon Charm interfaces.
Visional Wheel
Gliding now interrupts continuous fire, ADS, and OTS inputs. You must press the respective button again to reactivate these actions.
Wilderness
Improved the camera while performing low-gravity jumps, making it easier to observe from the air.
Construction
1. Changed the PC shortcut for water and electricity management to the J key to prevent accidental disconnections during batch collection.
2. Interacting with a production facility now opens the output selection list by default.
3. Added an option to establish a territory after entering Construction mode in the wilderness. Available in Once Human: RaidZone and scenarios where players can have multiple territories.
4. The Disassembly Bench's quick select feature now remembers the last selection.
5. Optimized the issue of frequent jittering when snapping structures during placement preview.
Combat Optimizations
1. Improved the auto-fire settings in the mobile version. Due to player feedback regarding confusion over multiple toggles, the auto-fire toggle has been removed from the Settings. Now, the Auto-Fire button in the combat HUD serves as the master toggle. The button's visibility can be adjusted in the custom layout settings. We've also added separate auto-fire and delay settings for the Standard, OTS, and ADS views. All auto-fire settings will be reset after this update, so remember to reconfigure them.
2. Reduced the animation amplitude and camera shake frequency for all weapons when idle in first-person view.
3. Reduced the camera shake frequency for all weapons when idle in OTS view.
4. Added destructible vehicle windows. Glass components on vehicles can now be shattered in PvP combat and repaired at a Garage or with Electric Drills.
Dungeons
Fixed an issue where damage blocked by Stardust Barriers was not counted toward scoring during The Prime War in the Manibus scenario.
Tasks
