iv. Compensation will be sent via system mail after the cross-character sharing is activated.
After the March 27 update, all players will receive a set amount of Starchrom and blueprint conversion attempts to allow you to adjust your blueprints as needed. The changes we are making are not designed to invalidate your previous efforts, but to reduce grind and allow you to enjoy the game's content more flexibly.

IV. Resource Allocation and Deviation Optimizations
1. Deviation Acquisition and Interaction Optimizations
Planned Launch: March 13
The acquisition methods for Morphed Deviations will be made more focused and streamlined. The probability of obtaining these Deviations will not change. Before the update, we will announce the affected Deviations and their acquisition methods, and we will continue to make adjustments based on your feedback.
We have also improved the rules for spawning Deviations when opening Lunar Oracle Crates. Deviations belonging to the player will be prioritized for display, and there will be a cap on the total number of visible Deviations. Additionally, the duration of Deviation spheres will be shortened. This is to prevent confusion when trying to capture Deviations.

2. Resource Allocation Optimizations
Planned Launch: March 27
High-risk zones will yield rarer resources, including advanced resources and some new rare resources. This change is designed to enhance the risk-reward experience of exploration.
The yield rate of advanced resources will also be adjusted, as some of the yield has been reallocated to high-risk zones. Some Memetic Specialization effect values and game mode rewards will also be changed.
New special ammo and tactical items will also be added. These items require rare resources to craft and introduce new combat effects and strategic options to scenarios.
Controllers and all Controller-related features will be removed. Affected rewards will now yield mods directly, but some resource rewards have been reallocated to high-risk zones.

More details on these optimizations will be unveiled in the update announcement. Stay tuned!

V. Construction System Optimizations
Planned Launch: March 27
1. Intuitive Power Management
In response to player feedback about the complexity of connecting Generators and the ambiguity of power consumption calculations, we have overhauled the electricity system to make power management more intuitive.
Optimizations
Automatic Power Connections: Generators in your territory will automatically connect and form an electrical network by default, eliminating the need to manually lay cables.
Visualized Power Consumption Data: In Construction mode, you can view the total and current power consumption in real time. You can also monitor the power usage distribution on the Generator screen.

2. Water and Production Management Optimizations
To address player's feedback regarding inefficient water management, we have revamped how you interact with the water system.
Optimizations
Smart Output Management
The Water Pump and Rainwater Collection System will allow you to select their outputs. Available outputs are dependent on the resources of the current region.
The Water Filter and Brewing Barrel will also allow you to choose their outputs, making it easier for you to manage your territory's production line.
Automated Liquid Transport
Impure Acid and Barreled Crude Oil can be transported using water pipes.
Some redundant connections will also be removed.
Offline Output
Offline output will be automatically calculated based on your offline time, resolving the issue of production stagnating while offline.

3. Territory Relocation and Construction Optimizations
In response to feedback regarding terrain glitches during relocation and the limited variety of building parts, we have focused on improving freedom and mistake tolerance during construction.
Optimizations
Smart Terrain Adaptation
The experience of relocating your territory to locations with significant terrain variation will be improved.
Trees and rocks within the target location will also be cleared automatically, removing the need for tedious manual clearance.
More Creative Construction Options
New building parts including mirrored stairs and half-height fences will be added.
You will also be able to directly place carpets below furniture, instead of having to move the furniture first.
Control Optimizations
The green target preview in Construction mode will be optimized to make it easier to see the target's texture and orientation.

4. Future Direction: A Construction System with More Freedom
Our next plan is to optimize and revamp various aspects of the territory.
Improvements are coming to the load system, snapping rules, building permissions, House Blueprint sharing, and more. Our aim is to deliver unique construction and survival experiences for each scenario, and to provide more freedom and fun in building your territory.

We know that there remains much room for improvement.
However, we have faith that your suggestions and criticisms will help us to improve the game. Your expectations and feedback are the cornerstone of this world. Please don't hold back, and let us know your honest thoughts! Let's work together to make Once Human as great as possible!

Since the official release of Once Human version 1.4.2, we have been gathering community feedback and actively addressing your concerns. Here are the latest fixes we have implemented or are actively working on:

Recently, we've discovered a bug in Lunar Oracle that caused an excessive number of Lunar Oracle enemies to spawn when large groups of Metas gathered. Thank you for your understanding and support!

Waterside Building Height Adjustment
Thank you for your continued attention to the waterside building height adjustments. After carefully considering your feedback, we've decided to revert the building height from 1 meter back to 10 meters. This change has been implemented as of February 27 to ensure a smooth construction experience.

*Please note that under the previous rules, not all structures were calculated at 10 meters—some were below 10 meters. This rollback will not change anything from the original rules.

This adjustment was initially aimed at improving the PvP gameplay rules. However, during the design phase, we didn't fully consider how this would impact construction freedom. After an urgent discussion, we've found an alternative solution that maintains the fun of construction while also optimizing the gameplay.

We always value the voices of every Meta and encourage you to continue providing suggestions through the co-dev platform, community, and social media to help improve the Once Human experience.
Thank you for your understanding and support!
Once Human Development Team

Optimizations

NOTE: The novice Scenario Challenge tasks for Manibus scenarios opened before February 26 (PST) will not change. Optimizations to other scenarios are under development. We will update you on our progress in future announcements. Thank you for your patience!
Weapon Balance Adjustments
After analyzing combat performance and community feedback, we discovered that some weapon builds are not performing as intended, which limits the player's strategic options. To ensure weapon diversity and fair competition, we will make phased weapon adjustments, starting with the following:
1. Hazardous Object
Attribute 2: Reloading Time -40%, and the reload action is replaced by throwing your weapon, consuming all ammo to deal Blast DMG to targets within 3m range equal to 50% + consumed ammo × 18% of Psi Intensity, capping at 450%→480%. The effect benefits from Unstable Bomber's DMG and range bonus, and deals 50%→40% to yourself.

5. Optimized the dimensions of 1/4 materials.
Vehicles

2. Optimized the stability of vehicles while airborne.
3. Added the ability to steer vehicles while airborne. You can now control the vehicle's angle and position more precisely before landing.
Wilderness

Audio

notes.title: Lightforge Loot Crate Changes and Rerun Plans
notes.notes:
Dear Metas,

Your opinions matter to us. In January, we optimized the Lightforge Loot Crate system based on your suggestions. We have since received additional feedback and would like to address some of your questions.

1. Why did you change the Lightforge Loot Crate's draw system?
Many players reported difficulty obtaining their desired rewards when opening Lightforge Loot Crates under the previous guarantee system. On January 2, we introduced Lightforge Gems, which can be collected by opening Lightforge Loot Crates and used to redeem your preferred Lightforge Collection items.
Since these changes went live, we've received much positive feedback and suggestions for future improvements. Hence, we plan to keep the current Lightforge Gem redemption system.

2. Will players receive any compensation for the changes to the draw system?
The revamped Lightforge Loot Crate system has reduced the cost of obtaining individual rewards, which may players who drew rewards under the previous system to feel disadvantaged. Future paid content will have a uniform acquisition method across all platforms to ensure consistent pricing.
To thank you for supporting Once Human, we will provide compensation benefits to players who opened Lightforge Loot Crates between August 15, 2024, and December 19, 2024. The details are as follows:
1. If you obtained 1–4 Lightforge Collection items under the previous system, you can spend 1× Energy Link to redeem 5× Lightforge Ingots.
2. If you obtained 5–9 Lightforge Collection items under the previous system, you can spend 1× Energy Link to redeem 10× Lightforge Ingots.
3. If you obtained 10+ Lightforge Collection items under the previous system, you can spend 1× Energy Link to redeem 1× Lightforge Gem and 10× Lightforge Ingots.
In addition, all players can spend 1× Lightforge Relic to redeem 1× Lightforge Ingot and 1× Lightforge Relic.
These benefits will be available at the 'Lightforge Loot Crate: Frostshade' Redemption Shop from January 27 to February 26. Be sure to claim your benefits in time and remind your friends!
NOTE: The redemption benefits are under development. If there are any changes, we will promptly inform all players through various channels.

3. How will the Pyro Glide rerun work?
A rerun pack containing all Lightforge Collection items from Pyro Glide will be available from the 'Lightforge Loot Crate: Frostshade' Redemption Shop starting January 27. The pack can be purchased at its original price using Lightforge Relics.

Thank you for your suggestions and feedback. If you have any other questions, let us know through the Co-Dev Feedback Platform!

Once Human Development Team

notes.title: Once Human Version 1.4 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Metas,
We're planning a server maintenance and update on January 15 at 8:00 PM (PT). The maintenance is expected to last about 2 hours. Please plan your gameplay accordingly for the best experience.
Since Once Human's official launch, we've been closely monitoring community feedback and working on fixes and optimizations.
Below are the details of this update.

New Content
Visional Wheel Goes Live!
1. The Visional Wheel is a mysterious multidimensional Deviation. Its origin is unknown, and it cannot be secured. Once activated, it warps reality across all dimensions, triggering a range of anomalous phenomena in each scenario.
2. Scenarios affected by the Visional Wheel are known as Visional Scenarios and feature unique rules that affect the Survival, Combat, and gameplay. These scenarios can be accessed via the sign-up system.
3. Each Visional Wheel cycle lasts for approximately 3 months. At the end of each cycle, the Visional Wheel will spin again, generating new anomalies.

Visional Wheel S0 - Lunar Oracle
Tag Introduction: At dusk, a crimson moon will cast its anomalous light on the wilderness. Deviants will gain enhanced stats, while players will experience falling Sanity, which must be recovered by defeating enemies. Players also gain increased yield and special crate rewards when their HP is low!
'Lunar Oracle' Visional Scenarios for Manibus, Evolution's Call, Prismverse's Clash, and The Way of Winter will be available. They are marked by the corresponding tags under Season Tags at the Scenario screen.

Period: January 16–April 24
Key Update Schedule:
January 16: All Visional Scenarios are open for registration, Lunar Oracle goes live
February 13: S0 exclusive event Crimson Moon begins, don't miss the chance to get exclusive skins!
March 13: 'Lunar Oracle' gameplay is upgraded as a mysterious shadow appears.

Lunar Oracle Effects:
Lunacy
1. When outside your territory, Lunacy causes you to steadily lose Sanity, down to a minimum of 20%. It also greatly reduces your Sanity recovery rate, requiring you to defeat enemies to recover Sanity. However, Lunacy also grants you a resource acquisition buff that grows stronger as your HP falls.
2. During a Lunar Oracle, you can earn Lunar Whispers by defeating enemies and participating in various game modes. When you have Lunacy, the lower your HP, the more Lunar Whispers you will obtain. Lunar Whispers are time-limited and must be used before they expire.
3. If you die, the crimson moon will grant you a blessing that protects you from Lunacy during the current Lunar Oracle. You will also lose a certain quantity of Lunar Whispers based on your Sanity level at the time of death. The lower your Sanity, the more Lunar Whispers you'll lose.
4. When infected with Lunacy, you'll be able to see the world's true form, allowing you to discover hidden Oracle Crates in settlements and more deviated plants in the wilderness. However, gathering resources in the wilderness will carry the chance of triggering Deviant attacks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/702ae7126d62c1c997cc97fd542a1ddc8ce1ce22.png

Wilderness Changes
1. During a Lunar Oracle, Deviants in the wilderness will go berserk, growing more aggressive and dealing increased damage. Unique Elite enemies will also appear in settlements.
2. Oracle Crates will appear in settlements and can be unlocked using Lunar Whispers. These crates come in different grades, each requiring a different amount of Lunar Whispers to open. Inside, you'll find exclusive formulas that will significantly enhance your abilities. Oracle Crates also contain mods with the 'Lunar' suffix, Lunar animal skins, unique animals, and Lunar Oracle Morphed Deviations.
3. In response to the threat posed by Lunar Oracle deviations, you can enhance your abilities by mixing and matching gear, mods, deviations, dishes and medicine of different Lunar Oracle genres.
4. If The Prime War or Stronghold Conquest is started during a Lunar Oracle, the game mode will also be affected by the anomalous vision and Lunacy. If a Chaosweaver descends during a Lunar Oracle, the region will be affected by both the Lunar Oracle and the blizzard or volcanic storm.
5. In response to the challenge posed by Lunar Oracle deviations, you can enhance your abilities by mixing and matching gear, mods, deviations, dishes and medicine of targeted genres.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/eca7e47a29ac94d2014544cec46a7d428bd13561.png

*Visional Scenarios will go live after the January 16 update. Ordinary scenarios without Lunar Oracle will be available at the same time. Please select accordingly.

Scenario Arrangement
1. Since the current tags for Hard-difficulty scenarios offer a somewhat repetitive experience, the original Hard modes will be discontinued following the launch of Visional Scenarios.
2. To cater to players who find Visional Scenarios too challenging, regular scenarios of each type will continue to be available. The schedule can be viewed in the sign-up system.
3. For details on the Visional Scenario servers, refer to: January 16 Server Opening and Scenario Sign-Up Announcement: 
https://www.oncehuman.game/news/update/20250107/40780_1204947.html
4. To ensure that everyone can choose the game mode that is most suitable for them, we will remove the CD for Scenario Exit and give everyone a free Scenario Exit Card.

New Gear
1. New Weapons
Critical Pulse: Trigger consecutive Power Surges to generate Orb Lightning pulses!

https://r.res.easebar.com/pic/20250115/529cfbae-c32a-4f9f-ac1d-8ee7c29d18dd.gif

Primal Rage: Transform HP into ammunition!

https://r.res.easebar.com/pic/20250115/94c6009b-41d4-4ac3-8c0c-b286620dd93d.gif

Hazardous Object: Make everything go boom with this explosive pistol!

https://r.res.easebar.com/pic/20250115/9230943f-ef3e-42c8-a5db-66af62e3d0af.gif

2. New Armors
Unique Armor: Overloaded Pants
Temporarily gain unlimited ammunition after dealing Power Surge DMG a number of times.

Unique Armor: Charmed Mag Top
When in Fast Gunner status, you have a chance of firing extra bullets per shot. The less ammunition in your current magazine, the higher the chance.

Unique Armor: Viper Mask
Greatly increases the range of Unstable Bomber, which also deals increased DMG proportional to its range.

Set: Treacherous Tides Set
1 piece: Weapon DMG reduction.
2 pieces: When your HP is below 70%, you gain a buff to Weapon and Status DMG.
3 pieces: Reduces the effect of Sanity on Max HP. Grants a buff to Weapon and Status DMG that increases as your Sanity goes down.
4 pieces: Gain a shield when your HP is low.

3. New Mods
Helmet Mods
Weapon Symphony: Weapon Symphony: After switching weapons, you receive a boost to Fire Rate and Weapon DMG. The effect weakens over time.
Quick Toss: After using a throwable, grants a Fire Rate buff and replenishes the magazine of the last weapon held.

Top Mods
Ardent Shield: When shielded, you gain additional DMG Reduction, and single instances of DMG will not penetrate the shield.

Pants Mods
Elemental Resonance: Grants the next magazine an Elemental DMG buff based on the amount of Elemental DMG dealt by the previous magazine.
Critical Surge: Gain a stackable Crit DMG buff upon reloading from an empty magazine.

Shoes Mods
Against All Odds: Gain a stackable Weapon and Status DMG buff upon receiving damage.
Power of Striving: Upon expending Stamina, gain a Weapon and Status DMG buff. The lower your Stamina, the stronger the buff.

Lunar Oracle Mod Suffix
In scenarios with the Blood Moon tag, you can find Lunar Oracle Crates containing mods with unique suffixes in the wilderness.
Applicable Mods: Helmet and Top
Suffix Effect: As your HP falls, you gain Crit DMG, Elemental DMG, Weapon DMG, and Status DMG buffs.

New Seasonal Cradle Effect

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/4f2a914ea36bf01a382e87ba5d704dc5c006a6fe.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/4d25cd750620941867e4033c4051c1c39edc8bc2.jpg

Combat Environment Tags
Combat Environment Tags are updated to: Void, Coherence, Phase:
1. Void Deviants start with a shield that reduces most DMG effects.
Countermeasures: Cradle Override: Anti-Void, Unstable Bomber DMG, Power Surge DMG
2. Coherence Deviants carry a Coherence device. While the device is intact, Coherence Deviants are invincible.
Countermeasures: Cradle Override: Anti-Coherence, Bounce DMG, DMG while in Fast Gunner state, DMG while in The Bull's Eye state
3. Phase Deviants have high DMG Reduction.
Countermeasures: Cradle Override: Anti-Phase, Shrapnel DMG, DMG while in Fortress Warfare state

New Deviation [Wish Box]
Wish Box is a special Territory Deviation. By placing it in the Isolated Securement Unit, you can find it in the territory. Wish Box has a separate storage space that transforms any item placed inside into something else at every hour. See the wonders that the Wish Box can perform!
Wish Box can be purchased at the Stellar Planula Shop or obtained from Morphic - Crates.
Take note that only the owner can interact with the Wish Box. When the Wish Box is discarded, any item stored inside will be cleared.

Wish Machine Prize Pools
After the update on January 16, 2025, new Wish Machine prize pools will be available for 3 weeks:
Critical Power Surge: Includes the Legendary weapon blueprint 'Critical Pulse.'
Contradictory Shrapnel: Includes the Legendary weapon blueprint 'Conflicting Memories.'
Overload Power Surge: Includes Legendary gear blueprints: 'Overloaded Pants,' 'Blackstone Pants,' 'Blackstone Gloves,' and 'Blackstone Mask.'

On January 30, 2025 afternoon, new Wish Machine prize pools will be available for 3 weeks:
Raging Barrel: Includes the Legendary weapon blueprint 'Primal Rage.'
Tranquil Frost: Includes the Legendary weapon blueprint 'Silent Anabasis.'
Magic Gunslinger: Includes Legendary gear blueprints: 'Charmed Mag Tops,' 'Treacherous Tides Helmet,' 'Treacherous Tides Pants,' and 'Treacherous Tides Shoes.'

Gender Conversion
Build a Floor Mirror in your territory and interact with it. Enter the character selection screen and choose other genders in the top left corner. Add item Metamorphosis Token for the change to take effect. Metamorphosis Tokens are available in the Shop at 1 Energy Link.

New Shop Arrivals
Spring Festival Carnival! Get ready for many surprises, including Lightforge Gem rate up and 20% higher draw probability!
1. New Functional Items:
Gender change item 'Metamorphosis Token' is now available under Other Items in the Shop. You can purchase one at the price of 1 Energy Link. This redemption is limited to once per account. Alternatively, you can get more 'Metamorphosis Token' using Crystgins.
2. Lightforge Loot Crate: Frostshade (available from January 17, 10:00 AM server time)
"The crimson moon... the serpent lies in wait!"
Lightforge Loot Crate: Time-limited Frostshade Legendary Collection Vehicle Skin 'Tidal Hunt,' Legendary Character Set 'Cambrian Nightfall Set,' Legendary Weapon Skin 'Nightbreaker - MG4,' Legendary Furniture 'Starry Cloud Bed,' Legendary Territory Collectibles 'Abyssal Teardrop,' and Epic Collection Theme Pack 'Sea & Butterfly'.
*Crazy limited Spring Festival Loot Crate promotion! Get Lightforge Gem rate up and 20% higher draw probability for Lightforge Loot Crates!

3. Wacky Racing: Spring is a season for laughter and travel! Under the influence of the Lunar Oracle, vehicles in the event seem to move even faster. Gather your friends and embark on an open-world racing spree!

5. Spring Festival Lucky Painting: Collect Spring Festival-themed outfits to unlock the New Year's Painting! Decorate your home and get a Spring Festival Lucky Bag!
6. Daily Gifts: Starting on the first day of the Spring Festival, a new gift unlocks each day, leading up to a grand gift on the day of the Lantern Festival. Invite your friends to join and claim them together!

Optimizations

Balance Adjustments

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/f4189bdb48ba472bcfeec79cda72c61fa8d21be3.jpg

Movement Speed Adjustments
1. Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where eating Stardust Ratatouille would let players exceed the maximum Movement Speed.
Fixed an issue where the actual Roll Speed bonus of Golden Wool was between 30% and 100%, causing players' Roll Speed to become too fast. We have also increased the Roll Speed bonus of Golden Wool to between 10% to 25%.
2. Effect Adjustments
Fixed an issue where Stardust Corn Ale's Movement Speed buff only affected jump height. It now grants Sprint Speed +20%.
Changed the effects of Snow Trekking Gear and Enhanced Snow Trekking Gear to no longer stack.
3. Stat Display and Maximum Adjustments
Added the display of Sprint Speed and Roll Speed bonuses to the Stats panel.
Increased the maximum Movement Speed bonus from 20% to 30%. Increased the maximum Sprint Speed bonus from 20% to 40%. Reduced the maximum Roll Speed bonus from 100% to 60%.
Movement Speed Guide: Movement Speed bonuses apply to all movement states. Sprint Speed bonuses apply when sprinting. Rolling speed is partly based on your current Movement Speed. Roll Speed increases your initial speed when rolling.
4. Aero Leap Adjustments
Fixed an issue where Movement Speed would become too fast after dashing with Aero Leap due to the frame rate.
You can now hold the Roll button to increase Aero Leap's dash distance by expending Stamina.

Developer Notes:
1. We have heard your concerns on longstanding issues that have yet to be resolved. We take your feedback seriously and have conducted an internal review. Moving forward, we will fix combat-related bugs more promptly and ensure timely communication with players through regular announcements. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.
Previously, due to our development schedule and processes, we required some time to address issues reported by players, and we only made announcements after issues had been resolved. We acknowledge that this may have caused communication delays. From now on, we will include information about identified and confirmed issues in our regular announcements, even if they have not yet been fixed.
2. We have also heard your concerns about spending time and resources on certain items, only for them to get nerfed. We understand and appreciate the effort you have put into your builds. Moving forward, we will exercise greater caution with balance adjustments, especially for items that require significant time investment. Your responses to the recent Co-Dev Update showed us how much you care about balance adjustments. In the future, we will communicate more actively with players to share the logic and reasoning behind any adjustments made.

Teleportation
1. Teleporting back to a campsite, your territory, or a teammate's territory now share a unified cooldown timer.
2. Added a new item: Anti-Blockage Capsule. When used, it resets the cooldown for teleporting back to a campsite, your territory, or a teammate's territory, allowing for immediate teleportation. This item has a chance of being found in Medicine Boxes in the wilderness.
3. The cooldown for teleporting back to a campsite, your territory, or a teammate's territory will now be reset after taking part in Public Crisis Events, including Where Does Disco Go?, The Dark Side, Dig to Hell, Paradise Lost, Operation Chiron, Fatal Signal, Battleship Blockade, Fishing, and Close Encounter: Dakini.
4. Added a prompt for when the player gets stuck in the foundation due to network or loading issues after teleporting back to their territory. The player's position will also automatically be corrected once the loading is complete.

 Social Feature Optimized
1. Enabled chat between strangers.
2. Added a trade message filter to the World chat channel. Enable the filter to collapse all trade messages and keep your chat box distraction-free.

Cosmetics

1. Optimized the soft-body physics of fashion items.
2. Changed the standing pose of female characters on the Character screen and in the wilderness.
3. Changed the appearance and physics of the basic female character model's chest.
4. Optimized characters' standing poses and some interactive animations in the territory.
5. Changed character lighting in the wilderness, including indoor, outdoor, and low-light environments, to improve character appearance.
6. Stocking fashion items (Nighttime Rose, Sailor's Spirit, Star of Tomorrow, Combat Medic, Frosty Glory) now cover the feet when the character is barefoot or wearing footwear that partially reveals the feet.
7. Optimized the preview images of stickers and decals in the Shop and Lightforge Loot Crate interfaces.

Combat
1. Optimized the appearance of the quick Switch Ammo function.
2. Optimized the display of the Stats screen. Stats of the same category are now grouped under descriptive subheadings, making it easier to understand what each stat does.

Wilderness
1. Optimized the display quality of some areas.
2. Increased the DMG of the Laser Gun's laser beam.
3. Added turn signs to some roads.
4. Optimized some paths in Wish Land – West.
5. Optimized the lighting effects on the player character in the wilderness.
6. Optimized the frequency of weather change alerts in each scenario. Players can also manually set the alert frequency in the Settings.
7. Adjusted the Chaosweaver's drop mechanics. Drops can now be collected by moving within 50 meters after they appear.

 Scenario
1. Optimized the server selection process.
2. Optimized the scenario recommendations for returning players.
3. The player sign-up limit for each server will now be lifted after a certain number of days.
4. Due to Evolution's Call (Novice) being too challenging for new players, and Manibus (Novice) being more suitable and showcasing the game's unique features better, we will discontinue the Evolution's Call (Novice) scenario starting January 16.

Dungeons
Added a hidden loot crate to Securement Silos that can be opened with Controllers. Inside a Securement Silo, mysterious Deviations will keep spawning. Defeat them all to reveal a hidden loot crate containing mods, weapons, Energy Links, or Stardust Source.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/a0869bbc4d574b4945bc489c190d9bf197bef3de.jpg

Storage
Optimized the item transfer process. When depositing items into the Vault or Spacetime Backpack, items with the lowest value will be replaced first.

Other
1. Adjusted the appearance of the Shadow Hound's Shadow in the Main Story Task.
2. Players can now check Deviation trait details in the Backpack.
3. Increased the drops of temperature-affecting facilities.
4. The Glide key can now be customized separately.
5. Optimized the Download Center screen.
6. Changed the location for using redemption codes to Settings > Account > Redeem Code.

Bug Fixes
Public Crisis Event
1. Fixed an issue where the player would fall underground when teleporting to the Public Crisis Event – Dig to Hell.
2. Fixed an issue where the Seed of Life would get stuck on some terrain types during Cargo Conquest.
3. Fixed an issue where the Public Crisis Event – Surge of Fish would sometimes appear outside the scenario map in Prismverse's Clash.

Cosmetics
1. Fixed an issue where high-heeled shoes would sometimes become distorted and cause the character's sitting pose to float in the air.

Shop
1. Fixed an issue where some items in the Romantic Misty Purple Street building panel pack were displayed incorrectly in the Shop.

Ranching Gameplay
1. Fixed an issue with lag when viewing ranched animals.

Territory
1. Fixed an issue with the load-bearing calculations when placing a Water Pump.
2. Fixed an issue where ceilings would sometimes leak water.
3. Changed the permissions for Fish Tank interactions. Only friends with the Storage permission can interact with the Fish Tank.

Boss Dungeons / Securement Silos
1. Fixed an issue where after clearing a Monolith, its map icon would not change.

Others
1. Fixed an issue causing visual effect errors.
2. Fixed an issue where the player could become stuck on Sulfur outcrops when inputting certain controls.

Controller
1. Fixed an issue where a tip saying the building does not exist would appear when using a controller to apply a home decor cosmetic and pressing X.
2. Fixed an issue where the Claim All and Back buttons would overlap when using a controller to interact with territory facilities.

Deviation
1. Fixed an issue with incorrect Deviation spawn descriptions in the Manibus scenario.

Enemy
1. Fixed an issue where Morphic Loot Crates would not drop loot crates after death.

Vehicle
1. Fixed an issue where vehicles would suddenly explode.
2. Fixed an issue where vehicles could not be dismounted after getting stuck on a rock or wall, causing the game to jam.

notes.title: Lightforge Loot Crate Rules Update
notes.notes:
You can spend "Lightforge Ingot" to open the Lightforge Loot Crate, and each opening guarantees a cosmetic item or a Lightforge Gem. Only one character per account can participate in opening the Loot Crate and redeeming items, but the cosmetics obtained can be used by all characters under the account. You can have different characters participate in different Loot Crates.

1) The Lightforge Loot Crates are time-limited. Unused Lightforge Ingots, Lightforge Relics, and Lightforge Gems will be retained for future Loot Crates and are usable account-wide.

2) Each purchase and opening of a Loot Crate requires 1  Lightforge Ingot, valued at 160 Crystgin. The first10 purchases of Lightforge Ingots within the Loot Crate will enjoy a half-price discount on Crystgin. Each opening of the Loot Crate will randomly yield a Lightforge Gem or a cosmetic reward based on probability. You can open this Loot Crate up to 9999 times.

3) The Loot Crate introduces a new token Lightforge Gem, with specific guaranteed rules:
- Every 20 openings will guarantee one "Lightforge Gem".
-The guaranteed count resets when you obtain a Lightforge Ingot, and you can obtain the next within a maximum of 20 times.
- There is no limit to the number of Lightforge Gem that can be drawn. You can also  spend Lightforge Relics to redeem Lightforge Gem at Shop.

4) The Shop offers cosmetic items from various Lightforge Loot Crates, as well as Lightforge Gems, Lightforge Ingots, and Colorful Badges.
- Each Cosmetic item can only be redeemed once and will be removed from shop if you obatin it from the Loot Crate.
- If you draw a Lightforge Collection that you have already owned, all Lightforge Relics spent to redeem this item will be refunded.

5) Lightforge Loot Crates are independent of each other and have different limited-time discounts.

6) For the same Lightforge Loot Crate, only one character per account can participate, while all cosmetics items obtained can be shared by all characters.

notes.title: Once Human Version 1.3.5 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Metas,
We're planning a server maintenance and update on January 1 at 8:00 PM (PT). The maintenance is expected to last about 3 hours. Please plan your gameplay accordingly for the best experience.
Since Once Human's official launch, we've been closely monitoring community feedback and working on fixes and optimizations.
Below are the details of this update.

Character Deletion
1. You can now delete characters using the Character Management function.
2. After initiating deletion, there will be a five-day countdown during which you can cancel the deletion process. The character's name will still be reserved and cannot be taken by other characters during this time.
3. When the countdown ends, the character will be permanently deleted and removed from your character list.
Notes:
1. During the deletion countdown, you cannot use or make any changes to the character, so you should manage your items beforehand. After the character is deleted, all their items will be permanently lost.
2. After deleting a character, a character slot will be freed up on your account. The character limit per account is still 10.
3. If your character is mistakenly deleted, please contact customer support, and we will do everything necessary to recover the lost data in part.

New Wish Machine Prize Pools
After the update on January 1, 2025 (PT), three new Wish Machine prize pools will be available for 3 weeks:
- Money Rain: Includes the Legendary weapon blueprint 'Raining Cash.'
- Depth Charge: Includes the Legendary weapon blueprint 'Jaws.'
- Armored Cowboy: Includes the Legendary gear blueprint 'Cowboy Boots,' and the Savior Jacket, Savior Gloves, and Savior Shoes.

Optimizations
Vehicles
Added the vehicle repair function:
You can now unlock Vehicle Repair Electric Drills under Modification II and craft them at the Intermediate or Advanced Workbench. Vehicle Repair Electric Drills can be used to repair vehicles' HP in the wilderness.
Ranching
The ranching game mode has been updated as follows:
1. Reduced the Energy and Hydration loss rates of animals.
2. Food deposited into the Animal Trough will no longer spoil but cannot be withdrawn.
Wilderness
1. Added an option to control weather reminders in the Settings. The default setting varies between scenarios.
Construction
1. Attack ranges of trap and weapon combat facilities are now displayed when building them.
2. Added separate Recent tabs to Structures, Facilities, Furniture, Cosmetics, and Eternaland in Construction mode. In these tabs, components are sorted by frequency of use.
Controls
1. Added a setting for the Glide key. You can now independently customize the Glide control.
2. Simplified the controls for interacting with enemy drops and containers (e.g. Trash Cans and Medkits). Now, you can press the key to quickly pick up items, or press and hold to view their details before collecting them.
3. You no longer need to click on individual items to clear their red dots. Switching tabs will automatically clear all red dots in the previous tab.
After switching TABs, all red dots from the previous TAB are cleared.
4. You no longer need to click on individual items to clear their red dots. Closing the tab will automatically clear all red dots within it.
After closing the screen with the current red dot, all red dots from the previously selected TAB are cleared.
Survival, Open World, and Crafting
1. Increased the Durability of Ice Cubes in the wilderness.
2. Improved the Fridge's functionality. Food items placed in the Fridge now last 20 times longer.
3. Expanded the types of furniture formulas that can be disassembled at the Designer's Workstation. All furniture formulas obtainable from the Designer's Workstation can now be disassembled into blueprint fragments.
New Shop Arrivals
1. New Battle Pass: Frosty Glory (available from January 1 post-update, PT)
"The moon's placid light illuminates the glorious frost."
A new Battle Pass theme is here, including the 'Frosty Glory' fashion set (Epic), 'Love at First Sight' weapon skin (Epic), 'Cutie Cub' Cradle skin (Epic), and 'Elegance of Time' furniture formula series (Fine).
Experience greater convenience with the new cross-character sharing feature:
• The Battle Pass is now shared across all characters on the same account. Every character can collect Battle Pass EXP and contribute to the Battle Pass level, giving you the freedom to choose which character to play.
• All cosmetic rewards from this Battle Pass cycle will be shared across all characters on the account, eliminating the need to grind with multiple characters.
• Automatic outfit recommendations will be provided. Let's see which one looks the best!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/aae839df606b7e6867e073b5bf8611e57e212f23.png
2. Lightforge Loot Crate: Stardust Edge (available on January 3 at 10:00 AM server time)
"A glimmer of hope amidst the dust, exuding a sharp, chilling edge."
The limited-time Lightforge Loot Crate: Stardust Edge includes the 'Stardust Mayfly' fashion set (Legendary), 'Weapon Rack - Ice' facility skin (Legendary), and 'Ice Age - Crossbow' weapon skin (Epic).
Plus, a new feature that lets you choose your favorite reward:
• You can now redeem Lightforge Collection items with Lightforge Gems!
• Every 20 Lightforge Loot Crates will yield at least 1 Lightforge Gem!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/52db582cce23a45a9874f4a7a607594e9d235f37.png
* Lightforge Loot Crate: Arcane Celestial will be removed from sale on January 2, 6:00 AM server time.
3. Post-update shop arrivals (January 9 update, server time):
"I bring news of spring!" The spirit bird of the east brings good tidings from afar! The 'Aerial Navigator' collection set (Epic) and 'Liberty Plume' theme pack are coming to the Shop.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/ac6a22a0856c0b28048ff07bb9c383a72db4dc77.png
"The sun shall never forsake this garden." The 'Afternoon Garden' territory furniture pack (Epic) lets you create a pure and refreshing place of rest.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/184c092111a6afa222a150925566416d52ad0ec9.png
Fine weapon skins and bundles will also arrive. To learn more, go to the in-game Shop.

Bug Fixes
Ranching
1. Fixed an issue where Planter Boxes in sealed rooms would sometimes still detect natural light.
2. Fixed an issue where after interacting with the Flamingo or Sea Turtle, they could not be recalled and their Details button would become unresponsive.
3. Fixed an issue where animals would not eat or drink while the player was offline.
Storage
1. Fixed an issue where Storage Crates would automatically switch to the Food tab.
Deviations
1. Fixed an issue where Lonewolf's Whisper would not attack some large bosses.
Camera Mode
1. Fixed an issue where photos could not be uploaded to the Photo Frame furniture item if the network connection was weak.
Wilderness
1. Fixed the issue with water reflections in areas with high contamination.
Gameplay
1. Fixed an issue in The Prime War where the Shadow Hound's ultimate attack would land too close to the Staroid Restrainer.
Deviants
1. Fixed an issue where the Star Walker elite enemy would sometimes clip through walls.
Public Crisis Events
1. Fixed an issue where new Ammo Crates would not spawn in the 'Battleship Blockade' Public Crisis Event.
2. Fixed an issue that would occasionally teleport players underground instead of to a Public Crisis Event.
UI and Controls
1. Fixed an issue where opening a crate would sometimes be interrupted, forcing the player to open it again.
Cosmetics
1. Fixed an issue where Shadow Panther fashion pieces for female characters would sometimes clip through other outfit items.
2. Fixed an issue where the character's eyes would sometimes be rendered on the lenses of Glasses-type fashion pieces.
Vehicles
1. Fixed an issue where vehicles would bounce after hitting a tree.
2. Fixed an issue where the player could not dismount the Pickup Truck or RV if a building was above the vehicle.

Once Human Development Team

notes.title: Once Human Version 1.3.4 Bug Fixes (December 26)
notes.notes:
Dear Metas,

Since the official release of Once Human version 1.3.4, we have been gathering community feedback and actively addressing your concerns. Here are the latest fixes we have implemented:
1. Fixed an issue where the game would freeze while compiling shaders.
2. Fixed an issue where the Fast Gunner effect would block the crosshairs when in first-person mode.
3. Fixed an issue where submitting a photo to the Photo Frame would fail due to timeout if the network connection is poor.
4. Added a function that lets you recall lost animals. You can see which animals are lost and recall them to your Backpack from the Animals list.
5. Fixed an issue affecting water pipe flow.
6. Fixed an issue where the visibility of pipes and wires in the territory would sometimes be reset.
7. Fixed an issue where resources from the water cycle would not be deposited into the Water Tank. Resources in the water cycle will now flow into downstream facilities as outputs. If they cannot be converted into further outputs, they will be stored in the Water Tank. If no space is left in the Water Tank, they will remain in their original facility.
We will further refine the territory's water cycle system to minimize stoppages caused by specific facilities in the production chain, thus simplifying resource management and planning.
8. Fixed an issue affecting Wish Machine blueprint fragments.
We have received feedback about duplicate gear blueprint fragments drawn from the Wish Machine disappearing.
In fact, duplicate gear blueprint fragments do not disappear, but are automatically converted into armor set fragments for the same item, which can be found in the Blueprints backpack.
We will add a tutorial addressing this mechanic to prevent further misunderstanding.
Sorry for any inconvenience caused.
9. Fixed an issue affecting the Deviation guarantee mechanism.
10. Fixed an issue affecting the appearance of some models.
11. Fixed an issue with excessive camera shake when driving the Off-Roader at high speeds.
12. Fixed an issue where the player could not dismount the Pickup Truck if the location overlapped with a building.
13. Fixed an issue where the trigger chances of certain weapons and gear were incorrect (including the Desert Dust Mask's reload chance, the Tattoo Pants' reload chance, and the Bullseye's chance of triggering The Bull's Eye in conjunction with the Old Huntsman Boots).
14. Fixed an issue affecting the appearance of some items in the Shop.
15. Fixed an issue where construction was impossible in shallow water.
16. Fixed an issue affecting the MG Turret's damage stats.
17. Fixed an issue where the player would randomly get teleported while in the wilderness.
18. Fixed an issue where transformation facilities would sometimes have abnormal output.
19. Fixed an issue where an extreme minority of players would encounter errors while sending greeting cards.
20. Fixed an issue where the Bounce effect would not trigger if there were too many buildings nearby.
21. Fixed an issue affecting the display of stat details on the Armor Workbench's crafting screen.
22. Fixed an issue where some players could not trigger the Cradle cutscene during the novice tutorial.
23. Fixed an issue where Prism Deviations would sometimes produce output too quickly in Prismverse’s Clash.
24. Fixed an issue where the novice tutorial sometimes could not be completed if Prismverse’s Clash or The Way of Winter was selected with a new character.
25. Previously, the Grow Light's illumination range did not match its effective range. This issue has been fixed in the current update, but this caused some previously installed Grow Lights to no longer provide adequate coverage. To resolve this, we have increased the vertical range of the Grow Light so that previously installed Grow Lights continue to function as intended.
26. Fixed an issue affecting the offline output rate of mining and oil-refining facilities.
27. Fixed an issue where Chaotic Cortexes would sometimes be moved to the Vault when relocating the territory.
28. Optimized the drop rate of Prism Deviations when using Electric Drills or the Electric Chainsaw.

notes.title: Version 1.3.4 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Metas,
We're planning a server maintenance and update on December 18 at 8PM (PST). The maintenance is expected to last about 2 hours. Please plan your gameplay accordingly for the best experience.
Since Once Human's official launch, we've been closely monitoring community feedback and working on fixes and optimizations.
Below are the details of this update.

New Starchrom System
The new Stellar Stairway system for acquiring Starchroms operates independently of scenarios, so you don't have to play specific scenarios to maximize your gains. Simply play Once Human as you wish and easily earn Starchroms along the way!

Stellar Stairway Launch Rewards
1. One-Time Launch Reward: The update will go live on December 19, after which all players will be deemed to have completed Phases 1 and 2 and can claim all 36,000 Starchrom for those phases. Players can then start collecting Asterisms for Phase 3. Just log in before December 31 to claim this reward!
2. Login Rewards: Starting December 19, players will receive 3,000 Starchroms per day via in-game mail for seven consecutive days, totaling 21,000 Starchroms. Just log in before January 31 to claim them!
Don't forget to invite your friends to join the festivities!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/f98f863bdc1e1fe3a7e7eb6133a6e8b6f396bd11.png

Stellar Stairway Guide
1. Stellar Stairway resets on the 1st day of each month. Players can obtain up to 66,000 Starchroms per month, not including Starchroms obtained through events, mail, and other means. Most former methods of obtaining Starchroms in scenarios now grant Asterisms instead. You can also earn Asterisms by defeating enemies, gathering, crafting, and completing Eternaland orders. Asterisms are used to unlock Stellar Stairway progress and earn Starchrom rewards.
2. Each month is divided into four phases. Phase 1 (1st to 7th), Phase 2 (8th to 14th), Phase 3 (15th to 21st), and Phase 4 (22nd to the end of the month). Phases 1 to 3 each include 20 standard rewards (totaling 12,000 Starchroms) and one phase reward (6,000 Starchroms). Phase 4 features a single monthly reward (12,000 Starchroms) that does not require Asterisms to unlock. Instead, it is unlocked by collecting all Starchroms from Phases 1 to 3.
3. Phases remain locked until their corresponding date is reached. For example, if it is January 5, Phases 2 to 4 remain locked. If you have completed all progress and collected the maximum number of Asterisms for the current phase, you cannot earn more Asterisms until the next phase unlocks. At the end of each month, all Stellar Stairway progress will be reset, and you will start again from 0 Starchroms. If you have any unlocked but unclaimed Starchroms from the previous month, you can claim them from the Past Rewards screen.

Changes to Starchrom Acquisition
After the update, all unclaimed Starchroms from various game modes will be changed to Asterisms. Please claim them as soon as you can.
1. All Starchrom rewards from the following modes will be changed to Asterisms: Season Goals, Territory Purification, the Stellar Planula Shop and Season Shop, Journeys, The Prime War first-clear rewards, Prismverse's Clash faction loot crates, Chaosweaver progress rewards, and Thermal Towers.
2. Stronghold Conquest and Warband Rankings: Warband rankings no longer provide Starchrom rewards. Instead, Asterisms can now be earned from Stronghold Conquests. Warband members who do not participate in a specific Stronghold Conquest will still receive a part of its Asterism rewards.

Weapon Balance Adjustments
We have revised some previously announced weapon balance adjustments based on player feedback and internal testing, as follows:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/16784a4b6ce5afd3aa21c10d9ceb8c7225b2f1a0.png
For more details, see the Developer's Co-Dev Update | Major Balance Adjustments to Weapon Builds!

Blueprint Collection Level System
As previously announced, after the update, you can unlock and upgrade blueprints to earn Collection EXP, increase your Collection Level, and obtain rewards. You will also receive Collection EXP on a pro-rata basis for gear blueprints you have already developed.

Custom Nicknames for Weapon Blueprints
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/533169c728701c220280036cdf2dda7b22340f79.png
Rules:
1. Renaming a weapon blueprint costs 1 Weapon Renaming Card, which can be earned by increasing your Collection Level.
2. After renaming a weapon blueprint, all crafted weapons of that type will adopt the new nickname.
3. Weapon nicknames are visible to other players on some screens, such as the Defeat screen.
4. When a weapon changes users (e.g., when dropped upon defeat), its nickname will be removed.

Prove Your Mastery with Weapon Nameplates
Rules:
1. Each weapon blueprint has 3 unlockable Blueprint Emblem slots.
2. Each slot has a specific condition (e.g., Defeat a Meta) to be achieved with the same weapon. The condition can be fulfilled whether or not the corresponding Emblem has been unlocked.
3. Unlocking a Blueprint Emblem slot costs 1 Emblem Unlock Item, which can be earned by increasing your Collection Level.
4. Unlocked Blueprint Emblem slots will be upgraded as conditions are fulfilled. Currently, only Ancient Copper, Silver, and Gold Emblems are available.

Limited-Time Holiday Week Event
This year-end holiday season, embark on a journey of joy and reunion, and seek out legendary treasures with Snowsprite! During your adventures, Snowsprite will reward you with three exclusive skins, three adorable holiday-themed Deviations, lots of Starchroms, and other valuable resources!

1. Weekly Gifts: Unlocked on December 19, 23, and 30. Just log in to claim these special gifts!

Optimizations
Seasons
1. Reduced the scenario exit cooldown from 60 days to 30 days.

Ranching
1. Fixed the issue where ranched animals would sometimes stray too far from the territory and get lost.
2. Lost animals can now be viewed and recalled on the list of animals.
Construction
1. Optimized the Generator's fuel display. It now shows how long the Generator's fuel will last.
2. Optimized the snapping rules of some 1/4 structures.
3. Added range indicators for some facilities in Construction mode. You can enable or disable these indicators to your preference.
a) Press L to open a screen to enable or disable the range indicators (same as the key to show or hide water and electrical lines).
b) Planting Facilities: Added a range indicator for the Automatic Irrigation Facility.
c) Cooling Facilities: Added range indicators for the Fridge and Cooling Fan.
d) Heat Facilities: Added range indicators for the Furnace, Campfire, and Electric Heater.
e) If a facility is not in operation, its range indicator will be red.
4. Optimized the Grow Light.
a) Fixed the issue where the Grow Light's illumination range and effective range were inconsistent. The illumination range used to be rectangular, whereas the effective range was a square.
b) Added a highlight effect to plants and facilities that receive the Grow Light's effect.
c) Improved the snapping of the majority of structures when attaching to a structure of a different size.
5. Other
Bound items can now be deposited into the Meat Drier, Water Filter, Brewing Barrel, and Compost Bin.
Spacetime can now detect and highlight animal corpses.
Mod Acquisition
1. Added mod parts to Stardust Advent's Loot Crates, Keyword Suffix Mod Boxes, and Chaosweaver clear rewards.
2. Added a 'Lifeforce Boost' mod that applies to all armor to the list of mod conversion targets.
Deviations
1. Adjusted the levels of Deviations in the first-clear rewards for dungeons across various difficulties in Evolution's Call, Prismverse's Clash, and Manibus.
2. Increased the average quality of Gazocchios in The Way of Winter.
3. Increased the chance of obtaining Deviations from Workshop Defense.
4. Added Logging Beaver to The Way of Winter. You can find them in Strongholds.
5. Growshrooms can now use fertilizer. Give them fertilizer, and they will automatically use it when planting.
6. Growshrooms can now automatically plant when the player is offline.
7. Increased the success rate of low-level players when securing high-level Deviations.
8. Added the ability to rename Deviations. You can now give Deviations a custom name at their Securement Units.
9. Added a Deviation Storage Crate where you can store your Deviations.
10. Added a guarantee for Morphed Deviations to drop in a dungeon after a certain number of attempts.
11. Growshrooms now produce output when the player is offline.
Vehicles
1. Camera
a) Improved the sense of speed of the Motorcycle, Coupe, and Off-Roader.
b) Fixed the issues with camera shake and motion sickness while turning as reported by players.
2. Off-Road Performance
a) Optimized the vehicle collision effects. Vehicles now shake less and are less likely to stop after a collision.
b) Increased the reverse speed of vehicles. You can now quickly back out of trouble after a collision.
3. Airborne Performance
a) Player vehicles no longer nosedive when airborne, reducing the chance of flipping over. This allows players to change vehicles less often.
b) Player vehicles no longer bounce after landing. Instead, they will quickly stabilize on the ground, reducing the likelihood of losing control.
4. Road Performance
a) Fixed the bumpiness on most roads in the Lone Wolf Wastes, preventing excessive vehicle shake.
b) Removed trash bags and mud blocks from roads to reduce the frequency of collisions.
Dungeons
Changed the Birth Point in the Secret Servitor dungeon, and added birth protection for players when they enter the dungeon.
Deviants
1. Changed the Chaosweaver spawn mechanics. Chaosweavers will no longer repeatedly spawn at the same coordinates.
2. Some boss skills now instantly kill Elite enemies.
3. Weakened the Elite shield enemies in The Forsaken Giant on Pro difficulty. The shields can now be broken by throwing flower buds.
4. Adjusted the Weakspot DMG multiplier for some enemies.
5. Adjusted the explosion damage caused by some fire-type enemies upon death in The Way of Winter.
6. Added an extreme weather layer to the map. Use this layer to check areas affected by extreme weather, including the weather type and temperature effects. Added Chaosweaver icons to the World Map and Mini Map after they spawn. A 3D guide will also be shown if you are within 200 meters of a Chaosweaver.
Chaosweaver
1. Removed the Chaosweaver's immunity to Elemental DMG.
2. The Chaosweaver's chest, left upper arm, and tail are protected by armor. Destroy these parts to turn them into Weakspots.
3. Reduced the difficulty of destroying a Chaosweaver's parts.
4. Adjusted some of the Chaosweaver's AI behaviors.
5. Optimized the targeting of some of the Chaosweaver's skills.
Public Crisis Events
1. Optimized the range of the 'Dig to Hell' Public Crisis Event.
2. Added the new 'Battleship Blockade' Public Crisis Event to Ember Strand in The Way of Winter.
Interactions
1. Added auto-refill functionality to the hotbar. Players can enable or disable this setting to their preference.
2. Removed collisions with ziplines in the wilderness, reducing the likelihood of getting obstructed when riding a zipline.
Storage
Added icon markers to some storage crates, making it easier to identify and manage them.
Social
1. Teammates' current Worlds are now displayed if they are in a different World.
2. Optimized the feature that lets you invite friends to join your team.
Other
1. Movement Speed bonus is now displayed on the gear stats panel.
2. Increased the maximum number of loadout presets from 10 to 20.
3. Hidden gear is no longer shown on the dungeon settlement and Shop screens.
4. Optimized the models of the Rustic Crossbow and Recurve Bow.
5. Improved the reminder displayed if you have unclaimed mail items when moving to a new season.
6. Optimized the trigger timing of the Spacetime Backpack guide.
7. Added controller support to the Camera and Piano.
8. Added the ability to unlink your Discord account.

Bug Fixes
Eternaland
Fixed an issue where the output of some Deviations would not have the 'Eternaland' tag even if produced on Eternaland.
Fixed an issue where Growlights and Irrigation Facilities placed in Eternaland using a House Blueprint would not operate.
Fixed an issue where players were sometimes unable to place Planter Boxes in Eternaland and would instead receive a message saying that it overlaps with other objects.
Deviants
Fixed an issue where Frostellas did not trigger their mechanics when critically injured.
Fixed an issue where enemy corpses disappeared too quickly after death.
Fixed an issue where Super Anomalies would not spawn as expected in some dungeons.
Fixed an issue where the death and turning animations of some new enemies in The Way of Winter were incorrect.
Cosmetics
Fixed an issue where skirts and other soft fabrics would sometimes ride up rather than fall naturally.
Survival and Crafting
Fixed an issue where players with the Spectral Cloak would not exit stealth after blacking out, preventing teammates from rescuing them.
Fixed an issue where placing a Planter Box would sometimes fail.
Fixed an issue where House Blueprints would sometimes not be displayed.
Fixed an issue where Loamy Soil would not snap to grid.
Fixed an issue where a 'Cannot be placed here' message would sometimes be displayed when building a roof.
Fixed an issue where buildings would sometimes disappear when relocating a territory.
Gear
Fixed an issue where animal hide effects would persist even after unequipping the corresponding gear.
Fixed an issue where the 'Momentum Up' gear mod's effect did not match its description.
Servers and Seasons
Fixed an issue where, when signing up as a squad, players sometimes could not join the new server and were unable to leave the squad.
Wilderness
Fixed an issue where the player would sometimes float in the air after teleporting.
Fixed an issue where the player would sometimes float in the air after hitting an obstacle during a high-altitude fall.
Dungeons
Fixed an issue with Securement Silo - EX1 where players would still get petrified when moving even after clearing the dungeon.
Deviations
Changed the effect of Growshroom's 'Green Touch' trait and fixed its original effect description.
Fixed an issue where Zeno-Purifier's buff would persist even after putting it in the Backpack, causing the player to teleport when attacking enemies with a melee weapon.
Vehicles
Fixed an issue where vehicles would float in the air after relocating a territory while in water.
Fixed an issue where vehicles would get stuck and could not be interacted with in certain situations.

Once Human Development Team

1. Added grid alignment functionality to walls, roofs, and furniture surfaces.
2. Optimized the placement calculation rules in Construction mode.
Previous: Select the building you want to place, then move the cursor to the target location. A placement that meets the snapping and load requirements is recommended based on the target and the direction of the cursor movement.
Now: Select the building you want to place, then move the cursor to the target location. If snapping and load requirements are met, the building can be placed; if not, the indicator will be red and warning text will be displayed.
Developer Note: Many players reported that previously, buildings could only be placed if the cursor pointed to an object they could snap to, which felt clunky. Under the new rules, you just have to place a building, and it will automatically snap into place.
3. Due to changes in facility categorization, we have also changed the facility placement limits. If an existing blueprint has excess facilities, a pop-up will be shown with the following message: "Due to facility limit changes, any excess facilities in your current blueprint will be removed after construction. Please re-save your blueprint once completed!"
Category Changes:
All agricultural facilities have been merged into one category, including the Planter Box, Loamy Soil, Irrigation Facility, Grow Light, and Compost Bin.
4.Shortened the names of some structures and facilities in Construction mode.

Dungeons
1. Optimized Securement Silo - Taurus in The Way of Winter scenario.
- Changed the region access restrictions.
- Reduced the number and strength of enemies in the dungeon, and changed the spawn locations of Super Anomalies.
2. Optimized the skill warning effects of Empty House in Securement Silo - PSI. The duration of the danger zone indicator has been extended.
3. Optimized the difficulty of Securement Silo - Delta. The dungeon has been simplified and the number and density of enemies in the dungeon have been reduced.
4. Optimized the way skipping cutscenes works in multiplayer dungeons. Each player can now choose separately whether to skip or watch the cutscene.
5. Reduced the damage of the Secret Servitor's skills during its light phase.
6. Weakened the stagger effect of the Secret Servitor's lightning skill during its light phase.
7. Added a tip during the Secret Servitor's dark phase: "Quickly light up the runes to reduce the damage reduction of the Secret Servitor."
8. Changed a boss mutation that may appear in Securement Silo - EX1 in the Manibus and Evolution's Call scenarios. 'Energy Surge' has been changed to 'Berserk.'
9. Optimized the 'Winged Warriors' mutation. Its effect is now: "The boss takes 10% more DMG. When the boss's HP falls below 33%, it will summon 9 Stinger Bulbflies. The boss takes -10% DMG for each living Stinger Bulbfly on the battlefield. The mutation also no longer applies to Elite enemies in the Monolith, the HP and Attack of Stinger Bulbflies have been greatly reduced, and all Stinger Bulbflies will now die when the boss is killed."
10. Optimized the 'Careless' mutation. Its effect is now (using Pro difficulty as the example): "Enemies gain 15% HP, and take 30% more DMG from the first attack."

Eternaland
1. Added the ability to discard items in bulk from the Backpack.
2. Increased the stack limit of some materials.
3. Optimized the usability of the inter-season resource inheritance system.
4. Prism Deviations can no longer be converted into Astral Sand in the Backpack.
5. Added a mail system to Eternaland. It operates independently from the mail system on season servers.
6. Added the ability to discard or store items from all Spacetime Backpacks while in Eternaland.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/a5886cb4c2f24ad529311353a4309138de94d705.jpg

Mods
1. Keyword Suffix Mod Boxes dropped in Public Crisis Events now grant a Keyword Suffix Mod Self-Selection Crate when opened with a Controller.
2. In The Way of Winter scenario, high-level Chaosweavers now drop Keyword Suffix Mod Self-Selection Crates.
3. Added the ability to search for mods by suffix or attribute. You can also now search for multiple keywords separated by spaces, and case sensitivity no longer applies.
4. On the Mods tab at the Disassembly Bench, filtering by mod rarity has been replaced with filtering by highest attribute, and sorting by attribute level has been added. This should make it easier for you to select unneeded mods in bulk.
5. Added the ability to sort the Mod Backpack by time obtained.
6. The number of mods required to unlock a mod for Mod Conversion will now be updated based on the number of corresponding mods in the Mod Backpack.

Public Crisis Events
1. Optimized the 'Dig to Hell' Public Crisis Event:
- Extended the duration of the portal that appears after the event ends.
- Increased the HP of The Scorcher when many players are present in 'Dig to Hell - High Risk.'
- After the event is upgraded to Legend, a portal that leads to the final area will appear at the event's entrance.
2. Added combat invitation functionality to the 'Close Encounter: Manibus' Public Crisis Event.
3. You can now preview rewards and check already obtained rewards on the screen after completing a Public Crisis Event
4. Increased the speed at which disco balls rise when multiple players are dancing in the 'Where Does Disco Go?' Public Crisis Event. This should make it easier to upgrade the incident.
5. Optimized the reward cooldown indicator for recently completed Public Crisis Events. You can now view the remaining reward cooldown time for the current Public Crisis Event on the event's details screen.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/bb067152efedb2d8dfec6e2eb3cd9578eefd0a85.jpg

Enemies
1. Adjusted the Weakspot DMG multiplier for some enemies.
2. Fixed an issue where Frostellas did not trigger their mechanics when critically injured.
3. Fixed an issue where enemy corpses disappeared too quickly after death.
4. Adjusted the mechanics of the shielded Elite enemies in The Forsaken Giant dungeon on Pro difficulty. The shield can now be broken by throwing Flower Buds, and the enemies can be instantly killed by The Forsaken Giant's pound attack.
5. Adjusted the explosion damage caused by some fire-type enemies upon death in The Way of Winter.
6. Fixed an issue where the death and turning animations of some new enemies in The Way of Winter were incorrect.

Character Controls
1. Optimized the movement speed and throwing mechanics when using telekinesis.
2. Added a 'Switch to Melee Weapon' button. Players on mobile can now easily switch to their melee weapon.
3. Optimized the responsiveness of pressing the key to enter OTS.

Deviations
1. Optimized the visual effects of some Morphed Deviations.
2. Added the ability to rename Deviations. You can now give Deviations a custom name at their Securement Units.
3. Added a Deviation Storage Crate where you can store your Deviations.
4. Optimized the collision of Deviations in the territory. Non-combat Deviations will no longer have collisions.

Wilderness
1. Optimized the weather effects in the novice region.
2. Added a setting for weather reminders. You can go to Settings > Game Settings > Gameplay > Dynamic Interface. You can choose to show notifications for all weather, show them only for unusual weather (caused by Chaosweavers etc.), or disable them.
3. Changed the rewards for 'Frozen Loot Crate' Riddle Spots at Onyx Tundra in The Way of Winter from Stardust Source to weapon accessories. These weapon accessories are rewards from Riddle Spots in Eastern Nalcott. If you have already obtained the accessories in Eastern Nalcott, you cannot obtain them again.

Reporting System
1. Reduced the cooldown of the reporting function to 5 minutes.
2. Added a display of the remaining cooldown time for reporting.
3. Changed the control for reporting vehicle parking violations. To reduce accidental reports, you now have to press and hold the key.

Other
1. Your character's current Shield is now displayed on the screen.
2. Adjusted the appearance of Stardust Flora to better match the temperature at the time of the player's death.
3. A model of the last completed drink is now displayed while crafting at the Bartender Table.

Co-Dev Feedback Platform
Added a showcase of the most frequently reported bugs and suggestions. Each listed issue will include information on how it is being addressed and the expected resolution timeline. This feature aims to improve communication with players, ensuring your concerns are responded to promptly.

Bug Fixes
Combat
1. Fixed an issue where Overflow blueprints would not work in some situations.
2. Fixed an issue where the Surge Empowerment buff would not correctly replace the previous buff.
3. Fixed an issue where excess Exp would sometimes prevent blueprint enhancements.

Ranching
1. Fixed an issue where the trait descriptions of animal hides were incorrect.
2. Fixed an issue where some animals would not produce hides.
3. Fixed an issue where some animals would not produce hides when killed in the wilderness.

Deviations
1. Fixed an issue where ZapCam could not target dummies.
2. Fixed an issue affecting collisions between ZapCam and the player.
3. Fixed an issue where ZapCam's Deviant Power consumption was too fast.
4. Fixed an issue where Simplified Chinese text in some Deviation archive entries was incorrect.
5. Fixed an issue where some Deviations could not be picked up in scenarios other than The Way of Winter.
6. Fixed an issue where Growshroom would stop harvesting crops if its backpack data was not reset after becoming full.

Survival Tech
1. Added the Chaosium Lantern's resource consumption to its description.
2. Fixed an issue where the Psi Intensity buff provided by the 'Colossal Hunt' Thermal Tower tech did not work.
3. The new 'Refining Facility: Smelting' specialization now applies to Super Refineries.

Territory Construction
1. Fixed an issue where Tri Roofs would not adhere perfectly when used to create a hexagonal roof.

Cosmetics
1. Fixed an issue where the Romantic Misty Purple Street cosmetic pack's curved wall and rev curved wall models appeared the same when placed.

Map
1. Fixed an issue where entering coordinates on the map sometimes would not work.

Vending Machine and Wish Machine
1. Fixed an issue that allowed linked items to be sold in Vending Machines.
2. Fixed an issue where Wish Machine prize pool information was incorrect in the second phase of some scenarios.

SFX
1. Reduced the BGM volume during the Secret Servitor fight.
2. Removed the sound effect that played constantly when using the Snowmobile.

Dungeon
1. Fixed an issue where enemies would keep spawning even after defeating the Empty House in Securement Silo - PSI in The Way of Winter.

Interactions
1. Fixed an issue where players sometimes could not press 'F' to interact with Stardust Ore and Gold Ore deposits.

Eternaland
1. Fixed an issue that allowed Deviations with Prism Energy to be converted into Astral Sand.
2. Fixed an issue where material cosmetics would not take effect when constructing in Eternaland.

Enemies
1. Reduced the HP of Super Anomaly - Phase.

Public Crisis Events
1. Fixed an issue where Public Crisis Events in the first phase of the Prismverse's Clash would not refresh.

Other
1. Fixed an issue where players could pass through containers in the dark at Fiskur Harbor.

Once Human Development Team

notes.title: Scenario Sign-up System 2.0 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Metas,

Since our launch, we've been closely monitoring your scenario experience. Based on your feedback, we're introducing the all-new Scenario Sign-up System 2.0, which will go live after the November 21 update. This update will bring features such as advance registration, faction scenario sign-up, and team sign-up. Here are the details:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/d351f486ecba46c96b3474910e9c839ce4d377ac.png

Advance Registration
1. You can now register in advance for the types of scenarios you want to play.
2. Each round of advance registration has two phases: a registration period and a lock-in period. After the registration period ends, the lock-in period begins. When the lock-in period concludes, servers will launch based on the number of players signed up, which will also determine the number of servers and Worlds.
3. The 24 hours before a server opens is the lock-in period. If you cancel during this time, you'll lose your advance registration spot for that round (any advance registration made after the lock-in period starts will count toward the next round). Exact server opening times are displayed in the game panel.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/60f35b1f138f1bec334fe4622d60baba016e85dd.png
4. If you don't want to wait, you can also directly sign up and join scenario servers that are already open.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/d25e48790150c25d2b0e4b45bba6c6ec7ad483be.png

Faction Scenario Sign-up
1. For faction scenarios like Prismverse's Clash, you'll need to choose a faction when signing up (or be assigned one by the system).
2. Servers will decide whether to open at the scheduled time based on overall player numbers and faction balance. If conditions are met, they'll open as planned; if not enough players have signed up, the scenario may be delayed once but will definitely open after that.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/53e707a8b751cc26261438ee63892242a136c6d1.png

Team Sign-up
1. We've added a team sign-up option. You can now invite friends to form a team. All team members' sign-up statuses will follow the team leader.
2. When a team signs up for a scenario, all members will be placed on the same server (and in the same faction, if applicable).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/e4dcd829212c274df04595cf34f89263f21160eb.png

Scenario Co-Dev
1. To better meet the needs of players from different regions, we'll regularly release in-game surveys to gather your feedback and opinions on various scenarios.
2. If a scenario receives low overall ratings and has few participants, we may consider temporarily taking it offline and will announce it accordingly.
3. Scenarios that are taken offline will undergo targeted optimizations and will be re-released once the experience is enhanced.

These are the main updates in the Scenario Sign-up System 2.0. For detailed rules, please check in the game. If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions during your gameplay, feel free to share them through our Co-Dev Feedback Platform. We'll carefully review your input, discuss internally, and regularly update you on the progress and conclusions regarding key issues.

Once Human Development Team

notes.title: Version 1.3.1 Bug Fixes：November 14
notes.notes:
Dear Metas,

Since the official release of Once Human version 1.3.1 we have been gathering community feedback and actively addressing your concerns with adjustments and fixes.

Ranching Gameplay Issues
1. Disappearing Animals
Animals may disappear when they're attacked by enemies or other units, or when they wander too far from your character. This is due to our current game design. We're optimizing related mechanics and will release a solution in a future update.
2. Animals Not Eating or Drinking
When players go offline, animals might appear to stop eating or drinking due to a glitch that causes them to get stuck. While it seems they're not consuming food or water, the resources are actually being deducted. This is due to our current game design. We've introduced a temporary fix and are working on a permanent solution to be released in a future update.

Here are the issues we have fixed:
1. Fixed an issue that prevented some blueprints from being placed in Construction Mode.
2. Fixed an issue that caused the Sunny-Side Up collection to push away the RV when placed.
3. Fixed a permission error for some players on their own Eternaland.
4. Fixed the occasional disappearance of Teleportation Tower and camp icons on the world map.
5. Fixed an issue where Public Crisis Events in the first phase of the Prismverse's Clash scenario wouldn't refresh.
6. Optimized the visual effects of the "Street Art" weapon skin.
7. Fixed missing traits on deployed Nutcrackers.
8. Fixed an issue that prevented players from completing certain side story tasks under specific conditions.
9. Fixed occasional errors when inviting friends during the Wish Land Party event.
10. Fixed an issue in The Way of Winter scenario where the disappearance of the flying monsters in Securement Silo - PSI caused progression to be blocked.
11. Adjusted the number of Teleportation Towers for Public Crisis Events from one to several to reduce lag caused by players gathering at a single Teleportation Tower.
12. Fixed an issue where players standing under elevators could be crushed by the car.
13. Fixed an issue that prevented task completion in the H37 Unstable S-Vessel event.
14. Fixed an issue where the male Doomsday Dominator top would disappear when viewed from a distance by other players.
15. Fixed an issue where the female Sailor's Spirit skirt would disappear when viewed from a distance by other players.
16. Fixed an issue in Wish Land – West and Dangling Vessel Cove where players would enter a swimming state in certain areas.
17. Fixed an issue where players would teleport to an incorrect location after leaving a dungeon, resulting in death due to area restrictions.
18. Fixed an issue where the "Intense Explosion" buff provided by Popcorn would be removed upon entering or leaving a dungeon.
19. Fixed an issue where switching between actions during shop preview caused all actions to stop and required re-entering the shop.
20. Fixed an issue where the Thermal Tower sharing permissions became invalid after the November 7 update. If you applied for permissions on November 7, please contact the tower owner to cancel and reapply. For further questions, please use the feedback platform.
21. Fixed an issue in the Secret Servitor dungeon where the light orb failed to ignite the rune when hitting the brazier for the first time.
22. Fixed an issue where defeating the Chaosweaver sometimes didn't yield loot.
23. Adjusted the following Memetic Specializations in The Way of Winter:
- Stone Structures: Intense Defense: Removed the effect that increases the Structure Limit by 100.
- Building Master: Changed the effect from "Material structures +200, furniture +100" to "Material structures +150, furniture +50."
Developer's Note: The Way of Winter servers in some regions have been facing excessive load due to the increased number of players and buildings on the map. To ensure smooth performance for players in these regions, we are temporarily adjusting the "Stone Structures: Intense Defense" and "Building Master" specializations. We're actively working on server optimizations and will restore and improve relevant specializations once the optimizations are complete. Please stay tuned for future announcements.
As compensation for this adjustment, all players will receive: Starchrom ×500, Mitsuko's Mark ×100, and Stardust Source ×200. The compensation has been sent via mail. Please check your inbox.

Stay in the loop with our bug fixes! Please find regular summaries of recent updates on our official website and Steam. For immediate daily fixes and the latest information, please head to the official Discord.
