notes.title: Version 1.3.1 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Metas,

We're planning a server maintenance and update on November 7 at 12:00 noon (UTC+8). The maintenance is expected to last about 4 hours. Please plan your game time accordingly for the best experience.
Since the official launch of Once Human, we've been closely monitoring feedback from the community and working on fixes and optimizations.
This update includes a brand-new event, Battle Pass III, a Season Calendar, and major optimizations to the Prismverse's Clash scenario.
Note: Unless otherwise stated, all times in this announcement refer to local server times.

Below are the details of this update.

Server Optimizations
1. Optimized server performance to reduce latency when many players are assembled in the same place, such as when fighting Chaosweavers.
* We will continue to optimize and adjust server performance. Please continue to send us your feedback.
2. In certain regions, we are piloting a new network protocol that is expected to improve latency issues on some servers. If the pilot test is successful, we will roll out the new protocol to the other regions and servers.

Prismverse's Clash Optimizations
In response to your feedback, we have been working to resolve various issues with the Prismverse's Clash scenario. This update includes optimizations to Public Crisis Events and Prism Deviation drop rates. More optimizations will be delivered in the next update on November 21.
Changed the following Public Crisis Events:
1. Removed Dig to Hell from Phase 1.
2. Moved Sproutlet Conquest to Phase 1.

Adjusted Prism Deviation spawn time and quantity, and added more ways for individual players to get Prism Deviations:
1. Changed the Prism Deviation spawn time from 18:00 to 20:00 (server time).
2. Increased the number of Prism Deviations spawned at 20:00 (server time) to 100.
3. Changed the spawn frequency of Berserkosaurus Rex and Radiant One to once every 24 hours.
4. Added the following ways of obtaining Prism Deviations in contest areas: weapon crates, gear crates, and gathering plants.
5. Reduced the chance of obtaining Prism Deviations from fishing in contest areas.

Gameplay Rules Optimizations
Players with the same score in Prismverse's Clash will now all receive the highest tier of rewards they are eligible for.

New Livestock Animals
The following animals can now be tamed as livestock: Wild Buffalo, Polar Bear, Snow Fox, Fox, Snapping Turtle, and Sea Turtle.
Randomized patterns for the above animals will be added in a future update. The patterns of existing tamable animals will not be affected.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/375aa4c937e1b20c9e494a43536c9cca6580d8ea.jpg

New Feature – Season Calendar
We have added a Season Calendar feature to let you check the game's schedule at a glance. On the calendar, you'll be able to view upcoming scenario openings, game updates, and events, as well as subscribe to notifications for the latest news.

How to Access: Events screen > Season tab > Season Calendar
Event Updates

New Event – Wish Land Party
In a region of turbulent spacetime, a peculiar Eternaland has appeared—and it seems like there's a party going on there! Grab your friends and join the autumn celebration together!
Wish Land Party is accessible from the Events screen. Once there, you can invite your friends to join you via the event interface.
Event Period: November 7 (after the maintenance) – November 18, 6:00 AM
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/c4abfa0fcc185c29bf2a6fe51c40b9807f77c5fe.jpg

H37 Unstable S-Vessel Phase II
This event is now available in The Way of Winter (after reaching Phase 3) with a new series of exclusive Snowy Realm tasks.
The update also adds Phase II of 'Nutcracker' Morphed Deviations to nurture, with a total of nine new variants including two rare colors!
You can freely choose which phase you want to nurture and collect!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/c0d36b22a1f2fbcf9de1c17782e6956513cde9bf.jpg

New Shop Arrivals
1. New Battle Pass: Sailor's Spirit (available from November 7, after the maintenance)
"Set sail and begin your nautical voyage!"
A new Battle Pass theme featuring the 'Sailor's Spirit' fashion set (Epic), 'Gemmed - DE.50' weapon skin (Epic), 'Undersea Memories' Cradle skin (Epic), and many other exciting cosmetics.
Optimized the Battle Pass screen. You can now switch to a preview of your character holding the selected weapon from the Details panel.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/b10849c0e00c7cc34948db43e6f51af07188c5c6.jpg

2. Lightforge Loot Crate: Urban Oddities (available from November 8, 10:00 AM)
"I control the future, and the world moves to my command."
A new Lightforge Loot Crate is available for a limited time! This 'Urban Oddities'-themed crate consists of three rounds and includes the 'Doomsday Dominator' fashion set (Legendary), 'Abyssal Mirror' Cradle skin (Legendary), and 'LCD TV' interactive furniture formula (Epic).
* Lightforge Loot Crate: Cloud Command will no longer be available after November 7, 6:00 AM.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/06f18ee600cc3515fae22f4a929f7cccd44f02e1.jpg

3. New Arrivals: The 'Boundary Breaker' fashion set (Rare) will be available for purchase with this update. Don't be afraid to be yourself!
Also arriving are the 'Peninsula' hairstyle (Epic) and various Rare individual pieces. For more details, check out Shop > Cosmetics in the game.

Bug Fixes
1. Fixed an issue where Medium Frame Ⅵ could not be interacted with.
2. Fixed an issue that allowed Thermal Towers to be built in water.
3. Fixed an issue that caused Ram byproducts to be incorrect.
4. Fixed an issue where Butter was missing from the Memetics in The Way of Winter.
5. Added a new fish pheromone formula: Large Freshwater Pheromone.

13. Fixed an issue where a message would incorrectly state that a facility could not be demolished because other objects were placed on it.
14. Fixed an issue where dish categories and effects did not match up at cooking facilities.
15. Fixed an issue where Dried Seaweed would still spoil, contrary to the description of the Air-Dried effect.
16. Fixed an issue where animal younglings would not become adults even after their Maturity was at the maximum.
17. Fixed an issue where livestock animals would consume too much or too little food while the player was offline.
18. Fixed an issue where Stardust Mining Facilities could not gather Stardust in Pollution Zones.
19. Fixed an issue where Thermal Tower tips would sometimes not disappear when the player was in a dungeon.
20. Fixed an issue where an error popup would be triggered when opening the drops interface of a dead livestock animal.

23. Fixed an issue where interior ceiling wallpapers could not be applied to 'Beehive Tile Sloped Roof - Misty Purple.'

31. Fixed an issue where the Thermal Tower's tech effects would prevent Growshrooms from producing Deviations when harvested.

39. Fixed an issue where withdrawing then re-depositing a Deviation into a Secure Unit would cause the Deviation's Securement Environment to lose effect. If you encounter this issue, try removing and re-placing any items that affect the Deviation's Securement Environment.

Once Human Development Team

notes.title: Version 1.3 Bug Fixes：November 6
notes.notes:
Dear Metas,

Since the official release of Once Human version 1.3, we have been gathering community feedback and actively addressing your concerns with adjustments and fixes.
In particular, we have received a lot of feedback regarding animals, so we would like to first highlight these issues in a separate section.

The following fixes have been implemented:
1. Fixed an issue that caused Ram byproducts to be incorrect.
2. Fixed an issue where animal younglings would not become adults as expected.
3. Fixed an issue where non-capturable animals were incorrectly labeled as being capturable.
4. Fixed some issues with incorrect animal attributes. We will also continue to fix any wrong data causing these issues.
5. Fixed an issue where some animals had missing trait attributes. We will continue to restore missing traits to other affected animals.
6. Fixed an issue where Ewes would disappear in certain situations.

We are working on urgent fixes for the following issues and will provide updates in an official announcement soon:
1. Issue where animals consume a large amount of water.
2. Issue where animals incorrectly produce Rock Wall Wool.
3. Issue affecting livestock animals' feeding behavior.
4. Issue where some animal younglings would lose attributes after becoming adults.

Pup Buddy, Upper World Spawn, and Festering Gel in The Way of Winter
These Deviations cannot be obtained in The Way of Winter. However, we did not update the season description accordingly. The description will be fixed in the next update.
Unable to Gather Water in Pollution Zones
Our investigations have shown that the inability to gather water in Pollution Zones is caused by both bugs and design issues. Facilities gather different resources in various environments, which sometimes leads to a lack of clarity in what items can be obtained. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.
1. We will continue to verify player feedback, fix the relevant bugs, and update you via official announcements.
2. We plan to simplify and update the functionality of gathering facilities to give players more freedom in choosing what to produce.

Here are the other issues we have fixed:
1. Fixed an issue where Ewes would disappear in certain situations.
2. Fixed several issues that would cause the Secret Servitor to disappear during its light phase.
3. Fixed an issue where the Super Anomaly 'Phase - Ghoul' in Securement Silo - PSI would sometimes blink outside the stage, where they could not be killed. We have removed its blink ability for now and will reinstate it after making the required changes.
4. Fixed an issue where NPCs in cut scenes would sometimes not be generated.
5. Fixed an issue where the 'Surge of Fish' Public Crisis Event in northwest Onyx Tundra would take place in an area with little water coverage.
6. Fixed an issue where materials in crates could not be used for building or crafting in certain situations.

notes.title: Version 1.3 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Metas,

We're planning a server maintenance and update on October 17 at 12:00 noon (UTC+8). The maintenance is expected to last about 4 hours. Please plan your gameplay accordingly for the best experience.
Since the official launch of Once Human, we've been closely monitoring feedback from the community and working on fixes and optimizations.
Below are the details of this update.

New PvE Scenario - The Way of Winter
Scenario Profile
Name: The Way of Winter
Category: PvE survival and exploration
Unique Mechanic: Survive extreme temperatures
Description: Metas will travel to the snow-covered land of Arkam and join forces with a faction of local survivors known as the Column. Together, you will find ways to survive the extreme cold and heat and discover the secrets hiding within the mountains. You must also foil the dark plans of Igna, the leader of the Vultures, destroy the massive living machines causing climate disasters, and save the world from destruction once again.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/bd9c008dc9352babb0fae269699e45c3663684e9.png

New Region
In The Way of Winter, the new region of Arkam will be available, granting access to Onyx Tundra, Vena Fjord, and Ember Strand.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/67183feff34db2c9632bb019aa74bff5c3476098.png

Exploration
The vast region of Arkam contains 60 riddle spots in the following seven types: [Frozen Loot Crate], [Ray Tracer], [Tiny Bear Balloon], [Doll Consortium], [Hoarder Rat], [Greedy Rat], and [Follow the Footprints]. Completing a riddle spot challenge will earn you a special reward.
In addition, The Way of Winter's map has 30 Scenic Viewpoints, typically found near locations with majestic natural or man-made wonders. If you encounter a Lonely Camera while exploring, interact with it to obtain a Scenic Viewpoint reward and unlock the corresponding Field Guide entry.
Precious Mystical Crates can also be found in the new region of Arkam, with five in each sub-region. Keep an eye out for those purple lights.

New Story and Tasks
Led by Igna, the Vultures of the north have built up a fanatical army powered by Chaosium and plan to use giant living machines to complete the apocalypse!
Meta-Humans, the world needs your help once again. You must stop Igna from achieving his plans!
1. Added The Way of Winter story tasks.
2. Added The Way of Winter journey and season goals.
3. Added The Way of Winter commission tasks.

Temperature System
Following the update on October 17, Once Human will include a temperature mechanic that applies in all scenarios. The Way of Winter takes place in the far north where extreme temperatures dominate, making survival much more difficult. This will not affect players playing in the Evolution's Call, Manibus, and Prismverse's Clash scenarios.
The temperature system is composed of two main factors—temperature and resistance. Temperature is affected by region, weather, time of day, environment, and certain items, while resistance determines how much you can withstand extreme temperatures. The higher your resistance, the less you will be impacted by scorching or freezing environments.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/79d3be9665956fd8c81ca4dc5f35edce74ae8204.png

New Wonder - Thermal Tower
A type of Wonder, the Thermal Tower is a huge structure that can alter the temperature and environment over a large range, influencing the course of the world. After The Way of Winter enters its second seasonal phase, you can unlock the Thermal Tower under Memetics.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/96f3e843b4f90b533ae63664b0b5b421d94df600.png

New Dynamic Weather System
More weather types with various environmental effects are now available. Extreme weather conditions offer a more challenging survival experience.
Changes in the weather, temperature, and other environmental factors will have a series of effects on Metas, enemy units, and buildings and facilities.

Chaosweaver Events
Chaosweavers are gigantic and mysterious living machines. Wherever they emerge, blizzards or volcanic storms follow, severely worsening survival conditions. As the seasonal phases progress, Chaosweavers will become stronger and appear more frequently. Locate and defeat them to end their disastrous influence and earn rewards.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/0263e1654a26165774e89ca872ad559e6a5714af.png

Scenario Season Rules
Seasonal Phases
1. The Way of Winter consists of five seasonal phases, lasting 7, 8, 10, 10, and 28 days respectively.
2. Like the existing scenarios, the first four phases are the main gameplay phases. During the last phase, you can sign up for a new scenario and wait until it begins.

Phase 1 - Arctic Domain
Duration: 7 days
Gameplay Features: Public Crisis Events, Hales' Moving House, Cargo Conquest, and Securement Silos are available.
Vena Fjord and Onyx Tundra are accessible.

Phase 2 - Scattered Ash
Duration: 8 days
Gameplay Features: Ember Strand is accessible. All sub-regions of the Snowy Realm are now accessible. The new prize pools [Destructive Flames] and [Blazing Fire] are available. Dungeons are available in Hard Mode. The season progress task [Eliminate the Chaosweaver] is available.

Phase 3 - A Glimmer of Hope
Duration: 10 days
Gameplay Features: Dungeons are available in Pro Mode. The seasonal progress task [Eliminate the Chaosweaver] is available.

Phase 4 - The End of Ice and Fire
Duration: 10 days
Gameplay Features: The event [Frost and Flame] is available: the most powerful Chaosweavers will spawn, affecting temperature over a large range, and can now be completely defeated. The new prize pools [Tranquil Frost] and [Frost Domain] are available. The seasonal progress task [Eliminate the Chaosweaver] is available. The seasonal progress task [Upgrade and Defend Wonder - Thermal Tower] is available.

Phase 5 - Break of Dawn
Gameplay Features: Players can sign up for a new season.

New Dungeons
New Monoliths

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/8fb07d2cc0b071a450feb36f8a545f98e6d88aa5.png
[Rift Space - Secret Servitor], [Rift Space – Treant]
Securement Silos
[Securement Silo - Delta], [Securement Silo - Taurus], [Securement Silo - EX1], [Securement Silo - PSI]
New Challenges
Stardust Challenge - Zone of Haze

New Deviations
The following Deviations have been added:
1. Tar Pudding: Gathers fuel around the territory and increases fuel refining speed when assigned to a Refining Facility.
2. ZapCam: Attaches to your back. When you are in OTS or scoped mode, it will lock onto a part of the enemy and deal damage.
3. Hydronaut Fish: When activated, it gathers sea-water from outside your territory, occasionally yielding fish. Also increases production speed when assigned to a Water Filter or Brewing Barrel.
4. Invincible Sun: Deals Blaze DMG to a designated target.
5. Snowsprite: Continuously generates Ice Crystals near the target. Ice Crystals shatter when shot, dealing Frost DMG to nearby targets.
6. Ice Pot: Produces ice blocks with magical adhesiveness.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/fddde25bf6daefe7928cbaeadf03f6f7abc28ff7.png
7. Gazocchio: Patrols your territory and attacks suspicious targets. Its beams of light can paralyze enemies.
-----------------------------------------------
Season Tag Updates
We plan to update the season tags on October 17. Starting from then, all scenarios will use the same set of season tags, including consistent tags for seasonal combat environments, Cradles, prize pools, Deviant invasions, and more. This will make it easier to select a scenario and play with your friends.

New Prize Pools
The season tags launching on October 17 will include the following new blueprints:
[Destructive Flames]: Includes the Legendary weapon blueprint "Pyroclasm Starter." 
[Blazing Fire]: Includes the Legendary gear blueprints "Fire Rune Boots," "Lonewolf Hood," "Lonewolf Gloves," and "Lonewolf Mask."

Cradle Override
In the new season available on October 17, the following Cradle Override adjustments will be made:
All weapon builds will provide buffs and several keywords will gain new mechanics, increasing the fun of shaping your builds.

Seasonal Calibration Blueprints
Vanguard Style, Boost Style, and Overflow Style calibration blueprints will drop during this season.

Close Encounters
Super Anomalies - Regen, Void, and Phase will appear in certain combat situations. Defeat them for a chance to obtain seasonal calibration blueprints. The drop rate and rarity of the calibration blueprints are higher than in previous seasons.

New Content
Scenario Reselection Special Event
Event Period: October 17–November 17
The rules are as follows:
1. During the event period, if a player joins a scenario that isn't to their expectations, they can exit the scenario within 24 hours without incurring any cost.
2. If more than 24 hours have passed since the player joined the scenario, they must use a [Scenario Exit Card] to exit the scenario.
3. [Scenario Exit Card] can be purchased for 1x Mitsuko's Mark at the Season Shop during the event period.
4. When exiting a scenario, resources obtained will be carried over based on the abiding season transfer rules.
5. To ensure fairness and maintain a high-quality gaming experience, this feature has a 60-day cooldown period after being used. Please use it carefully based on your needs.
6. Players who use this feature to exit the Novice Scenario cannot join the Novice Scenario again. As non-novice scenarios feature higher difficulty levels, please proceed with caution! 
7. After exiting the scenario, you can either go to Eternaland to sign up for a new scenario or join an open server from the server selection list.
8. We will continue to refine the scenario exit feature to make it easier to try out various scenarios. Stay tuned to our official announcements for more details.

Snowy Realm Journey
Event Period: October 17–November 17
Cumulative Login Rewards: Log in daily to claim a Wish Land Login Lucky Bag, and log in for 7 days to unlock all rewards! Rewards include "Wish Land Sugar" event tokens, which can be used to redeem the unique Morphed Deviations: "Shattered Maiden - Wandering Witch" and "Buzzy Bee - Pumpkin Lantern."
Weekly Gifts: Special gifts will be unlocked every week, including the "Smiling Sponge Vest" limited-edition cosmetic, "Smiling Pumpkin Lantern" furniture formula, Starchroms, and more! Invite your friends to claim these gifts together!
Eternaland Loot Crates (available October 24): What could be more exciting than loot crates sprouting from the ground? Mysterious treasure maps will appear in Eternaland. Follow the maps to discover Eternaland Loot Crates. Visit your own or another player's Eternaland and join the treasure hunt!
Wish Land Party (available November 7): A marvelous party is coming to Eternaland. Stay tuned for more news!

New Cosmetics
1. The "Romantic Misty Purple Street" territory material pack (Epic) will launch after the October 17 update. Create a serene streetscape, and seek warm love in the cool daylight. Behind every glass window hides an elusive romance. 
2. The "Steel Claw Raid" fashion set (Epic) and "Steel Claw and Swift Shadow" value pack will be available, along with a Cradle cosmetic (Epic) and helmet pieces. The urban jungle is full of danger. Be wary of the hunters' speedy attacks! 
3. The Wild Rush weapon skins (Rare) for the DB12, ACS12, and M416, as well as the corresponding Small Gift Boxes will be available. Try your luck and immerse yourself in change.

New Gear Blueprints
1. Five new weapon blueprints: M416 - Scorched Earth, M416 - Autumn Equinox, ACS12 - Pyroclasm Starter, M416 - Silent Anabasis, and MG4 - Conflicting Memories.
2. Two new key gear blueprints: Fire Rune Boots and Snow Camo Gloves.
3. Two new set blueprints: Snow Panther Set and Blackstone Set.
New gear blueprints can be obtained from the Wish Machine and will also drop from Gear Crates.
Some weapon and armor blueprints can also be obtained by gathering sufficient fragments from Mystical Crates in The Way of Winter scenario.

Blueprint Conversion
How to Unlock: Reach Lv. 40 in the first season to access the blueprint conversion feature from the Blueprint screen. Alternatively, it will be automatically unlocked upon reaching the second season.
How to Use: Expend blueprint conversion attempts to swap the rating of any unlocked blueprint with that of another unlocked blueprint of the same rarity and gear type (weapon or armor).
Cost: Each conversion will cost 1 blueprint conversion attempt. These attempts will recover at various points (e.g. when you unlock this feature for the first time, when a new season begins, upon a seasonal balance adjustment, and at a fixed time each week). You can hold up to 10 attempts at a time, so please use them accordingly.

New Radio Content
1. Added 45 songs to the radio. Enjoy the dynamic beats!
2. Added hosts to the six existing radio stations, accompanied by new names and icons for certain stations. The radio hosts have special voice lines, so listen in and hear them out!
3. Added the new Hometown FM radio station, hosted by three sisters from the Column who will regale you with lighthearted stories from their daily lives.

New Deviants
Added three new Deviants: the Portal, the Staff Badges, and the Luna Moth.

Gameplay Optimizations
Deviation Optimizations
1. Optimized the method for using and controlling Combat Deviations. Players can now click once to use a Deviation quickly.
2. Fixed the issue where some Securement Units in the wilderness could be interacted with multiple times in a short time (with no output).
3. Adjusted the following Combat Deviations:
Butterfly's Emissary: Increased model visibility. Improved AI for better target selection.
Polar Jelly: Optimized attack visual effect.
Festering Gel: Optimized AoE healing visual effect. Optimized hitbox that better fits its model.
Enchanting Void: Removed the wind-up animation before it is thrown.
Mini Feaster: Revamped the Touch of the Abyss combat effect. Mini Feaster will now follow the player, generate tentacles more frequently, and provide a Status DMG buff. Improved AI to reduce unnecessary movement.
Shattered Maiden: Reduced delay after appearing or attacking. Improved target selection AI.
Zeno-Purifier: Improved target selection AI. Zeno-Purifier will now attack targets designated by or near the player.
4. Adjusted the Deviant Power expenditure of Combat Deviations to improve their effectiveness. Most Deviations now have reduced Deviant Power expenditure when on standby or moving. Instead, Deviant Power will mainly be expended when the Deviation attacks or uses a skill.
5. The Season Shop has added seasonal loot crates for Deviations exclusive to Prismverse's Clash—the Berserkosaurus Rex and The Radiant One. All players can redeem them using Mitsuko's Marks.

Mod Optimizations
To make collecting mods more enjoyable, the mod system has been adjusted in this update as follows:
1. If, previously, using a Controller in a dungeon may drop Legendary weapon mods from multiple builds or armor mods for various parts, a Self-Selection Loot Crate containing these mods will now be dropped instead.
For example, the Ravenous Hunter dungeon on Hard Mode drops Burn or Frost Vortex weapon mods. After this update, a Weapon Mod Self-Selection Loot Crate will be dropped instead, allowing you to choose either the Burn or Frost Vortex weapon mod.
As another example, Securement Silo - EX1 on Hard Mode drops random mask mods. After the update, three types of Self-Selection Loot Crates will drop instead, containing Burn, Power Surge, and Unstable Bomber mask mods; Shrapnel, Bounce, and Fast Gunner mask mods; and Frost Vortex, Fortress Warfare, and The Bull's Eye mask mods respectively.
These changes affect Monolith boss dungeons on Hard and Pro Modes, Securement Silo dungeons, and major phases of LEA Research Lab dungeons.
2. Mod Self-Selection Loot Crates can now be redeemed in limited quantities from the Stronghold NPC "Severin." These loot crates allow you to choose a weapon mod of any build or an armor mod for any part. The mod obtained is guaranteed to include an Epic attribute.
3. In the mod conversion feature, target mods are now unlocked permanently once the conditions are met. They do not need to be unlocked again upon entering a new season.
4. Obliterate mods have been adjusted as follows:
Obliterate's effect increases Shrapnel DMG by 15% per part hit. This DMG increase is now capped at 45%.

Accessory Optimizations
1. Added a control to switch between ammunition types. Players can now hold the Reload button ('R' key by default) to quickly switch ammo types.
2. Added new optics: Precision Holographic Sight, ALPHA Holographic Sight, Loner Reflex Sight, Simple Reflex Sight, Grizzly Reflex Sight, Raptor Optic Sight, and Advanced Sniper Sight.
3. Added new muzzles: Quick Flame Brake, Multi Brake, Assault Brake, Range Compensator, Simple Suppressor, Tactical Suppressor, and Stealthy Suppressor.
4. Added new weapon accessories: Angled Grip, Elite Vertical Grip, Mobile Vertical Grip, Light Grip, Guardian Front Grip, and Small Flashlight.
5. Fixed the issue that sometimes made it difficult to hit targets when firing at close range.
Deviant Optimizations
We have optimized Deviants as follows:
1. Greatly reduced the amount of DMG needed to remove the special statuses of Super Anomalies.
2. The Super Anomalies - Void and Regen, and Coherence Devices (attachments on Super Anomaly - Coherence) are no longer immune to non-countermeasure DMG. Instead, they take reduced non-countermeasure DMG.
3. Super Anomalies now require more time to recover their special statuses once removed.

Task Optimizations
1. Optimized the display of dialogue options.
2. Added a cutscene for the Secret Servitor boss in Zone of Haze.

Public Crisis Event Optimizations
1. Added the Disturbance mechanic to the "Surge of Fish" Public Crisis Event. When players fish in the event zone, they will accumulate Disturbance. Upon reaching a certain amount of Disturbance, the fish surge will be upgraded to a higher quality, attracting more rare fish.
2. Optimized the Sproutlet drop rules when attacking the host in Cargo Conquest. Sproutlet drops now require less DMG to trigger, but now have a 5-second cooldown between drops.

Vehicle Parking Rules Optimizations
The rules for parking vehicles have been adjusted to prevent any negative impact on other players.
1. Regular vehicles (motorcycles, coupes, and off-roaders) will be automatically recalled if left unused for an extended time. The vehicle owner can then summon the vehicle again as needed.
2. Trucks and pickups may be recalled to the Garage if parked in areas where construction is not allowed. A warning will be displayed to inform the player.
3. A no-parking zone has been added at the entrance to Blackfell. Trucks and pickups left in the no-parking zone for a certain period will be automatically recalled to the Garage.

Reporting System Optimizations
1. Optimized the reporting options in some situations. There are now more report categories to choose from.
2. Added the "Malicious Exploitation of Bugs" option to the in-game reporting system.

Bug Fixes
1. Fixed an issue that sometimes affected server stability and caused lag.
2. Fixed an issue where the player would sometimes be unable to interact with anything after swimming.
3. Fixed an issue where a Rift Anchor's lighting effect would be blocked by iron-net fencing.
4. Fixed an issue affecting the display of shadows in The Forsaken Giant dungeon.

notes.notes:

15. Based on player feedback, there is an issue where extra effects from cooking with selected materials stacked indefinitely under rare circumstances. This will be fixed during the October 17 maintenance.

Here are explanations for the current Prismverse's Clash issues:
Issue 1: When a Prism Deviation drops near the edge of a safe zone, the Deviation's orb might enter the safe zone, making it impossible to capture.
Adjustment: We've updated the orb's pathing logic. Now, if it enters the safe zone, it will move to the last recorded contest area coordinates. This solution will be implemented, with further improvements planned for the October 17 update.
Issue 2: The entrance to Dig to Hell sits on the boundary line of the safe zone, preventing the Prism Deviation in this Public Crisis Event from being extracted through normal means.
Adjustment: We will move the boundary line between the safe zone and contest area outward by approximately 50 meters, creating a clear path from the entrance to the contest area.
Issue 3: The Prismverse's Clash scenario doesn't have a PvP mod, and players currently need to switch to Evolution's Call for that.
Adjustment: We're adding the PvP scenario exclusive mod—battle mod—to the Sproutlet Shop in Prismverse's Clash.
Issue 4: Some players are exploiting a bug to place buildings underwater and achieve invulnerable purification.
Adjustment: Prism Deviations can no longer be placed in Securement units underwater. In addition, we will investigate reports of players exploiting this bug. If you witness such behavior, you can report it by capturing a screenshot of the player's territory namecard and contacting customer service. Violations will be verified and penalized accordingly.

notes.title: Devs Talk: The Way of Winter Patch Preview
notes.notes:
In this Devs Talk, we will give you a sneak peek into The Way of Winter patch and walk you through what The Way of Winter PvE scenario is going to look like when it is released on October 17.

The Way of Winter Scenario Preview
Seasonal Phases 
The Way of Winter scenario contains 5 seasonal phases, which last 7, 8, 10, 10, and 28 days, respectively. 
Just like the existing scenarios, the first 4 phases are the main gameplay phases of a season. During the last phase, you can sign up and wait until it's time to proceed to the next scenario.

Phase 1 - Arctic Domain
Duration: 7 days
The raging wind and snow devastate everything in their path. Prepare yourself to survive in the extreme environment of the Snowy Realm.
Important Gameplay: Public Crisis Events, Hales' Moving House, Cargo Conquest, and Securement Silos are available.
[Vena Fjord] and [Onyx Tundra] are available.
Wish Machine Prize Pool: The [Echoes from the Rift] prize pool.

Phase 2 - Scattered Ash
Lava flows and surges, and the scorching air carries away all hope. The extreme climate brings only arduous challenges.
Duration: 8 days
Important Gameplay: The [Ember Strand] area is available. All areas of the Snowy Realm are unlocked. The new prize pools [Destructive Flames] and [Blazing Fire] are available. Dungeons are available in [Hard Mode]. The seasonal progress task [Eliminate the Chaosweaver] is available.
Wish Machine Prize Pool:
[Echoes from the Rift] Prize Pool
[Destructive Flames] prize pool, featuring the Legendary Weapon Blueprint: Destructive Flame.
[Blazing Fire] prize pool, featuring the Legendary Armor Blueprint: Fire Rune Boots, Lonewolf Hood, Lonewolf Gloves, and Lonewolf Mask.

Phase 3 - A Glimmer of Hope
Humanity's strength shows itself during great crises like a spark that lights up the north. You must work with other Metas to build a home.
Duration: 10 days
Important Gameplay: Dungeons are available in [Pro Mode]. The seasonal progress task [Eliminate the Chaosweaver] is available.
Wish Machine Prize Pool:
[Echoes from the Rift] Prize Pool
[Destructive Flames] prize pool, featuring the Legendary Weapon Blueprint: Destructive Flame.
[Blazing Fire] prize pool, featuring the Legendary Armor Blueprint: Fire Rune Boots, Lonewolf Hood, Lonewolf Gloves, and Lonewolf Mask.

Phase 4 - The End of Ice and Fire
Deep in the snowy mists, giants of ice and fire begin to rise, shaking the earth. The north shall soon be enveloped in the shadow of annihilation.
Duration: 10 days
Important Gameplay: The event [Frost and Flame] is available (the Chaosweaver spawns on the highest level and affects area temperature in a large range; you can completely eliminate this threat). The new prize pools [Tranquil Frost] and [Frost Domain] are available. The seasonal progress task [Eliminate the Chaosweaver] is available. The seasonal progress task [Build and Protect Wonders - Thermal Tower] is available.
Wish Machine Prize Pool:
[Echoes from the Rift] Prize Pool
[Destructive Flames] prize pool, featuring the Legendary Weapon Blueprint: Destructive Flame.
[Blazing Fire] prize pool, featuring the Legendary Armor Blueprint: Fire Rune Boots, Lonewolf Hood, Lonewolf Gloves, and Lonewolf Mask.
[Tranquil Frost] prize pool, featuring the Legendary Weapon Blueprint: Tranquil Frost.
[Frost Domain] prize pool, featuring the Legendary Armor Blueprints: Snow Camouflage Gloves, Blackstone Hood, Blackstone Jacket, and Blackstone Shoes.

Phase 5 - Break of Dawn
The dark days will eventually pass, but the Snowy Realm is forged in hope and courage which shall never fade.
Important Gameplay: A new season becomes available for signing up.

[The Way of Winter] Patch Seasonal Tags Update Preview 
We plan to update the seasonal tags on October 17. Starting from then, all scenarios will use the same set of seasonal tags, including tags related to seasonal combat environments, cradles, prize pools, Deviant Invasions, and more. They remain consistent so that players can select the same server as their friends, unaffected by the layering mechanic. 

Tags Prize Pool 
The tags of the new season becoming available on October 17 will include these prize pools: 
[Destructive Flames]: Includes the Legendary Weapon Blueprint, Destructive Flames. 
[Blazing Fire]: Includes the Legendary Gear Blueprints: Fire Rune Boots, Lonewolf Hood, Lonewolf Gloves, and Lonewolf Mask. 
Cradle Override 
In the new season available on October 17, we'll make adjustments to the Cradle Override: 
All weapon builds will provide buffs, and several keywords will gain new mechanics so that players can enjoy a new experience.
Blueprint Conversion 
After the update on October 17, the blueprint conversion feature will become available for all scenarios. Here's how it works: 
How to Unlock: In the first season, when you reach level 40, you can access the blueprint conversion feature on the Blueprints screen. Alternatively, you can wait until season 2 for it to automatically unlock. 
How to Use: You can spend blueprint conversion attempts to swap the star levels of any unlocked blueprint with another unlocked blueprint of the same rarity and gear type (weapon or armor). 
Attempt Cost: Each conversion will cost 1 blueprint conversion attempt. These attempts will recover at various points (when you unlock this feature for the first time, when a new season begins, upon a seasonal balance adjustment, and at a fixed time each week). There is a limit to how many attempts you can have.

That's it for this preview of [The Way of Winter] patch content. For more details, please stay tuned for the full patch note of [The Way of Winter]. We will regularly communicate our update plans, gather feedback, and solve major issues you find in the game. Feel free to share any thoughts you may have with us!

notes.title: Once Human 1.2 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/a79089245e271bb5ea4fa2a114848b7e0dfa5c3a.jpgDear Metas,
Once Human will undergo server maintenance on September 26, 4:00 AM (UTC). Due to the extensive nature of this update, the maintenance period is expected to last approximately 4 hours. Please plan your gaming sessions accordingly. We appreciate your understanding and continued support.
* The maintenance period for SEA and Japan servers is expected to last 5 hours due to server upgrades.
Since our global release, the development team has been diligently monitoring feedback and suggestions from the Once Human community. Your input is invaluable, and we are committed to addressing your concerns.
This update brings a new PvP scenario called Prismverse's Clash, a new animal ranching system, new cosmetics, and more.

Below are the details of this update.
I. Added a new PvP scenario: Prismverse's Clash. For more details about the scenario, visit New Scenario: Prismverse's Clash.
II. New Content
[Ranching System 2.0]
1. Animals will now start breeding if the following conditions are met:
a. The animal has high Tameness.
b. The animal is not a youngling.
c. You have the Youngling Hut facility in your territory, and it is not at full capacity.
2. Newborn animals will have random changes to their colors or patterns. You may even encounter rare special patterns!
3. Added ranch animals: Capybara, Flamingo, and Leopard.
[Eternaland Roaming]
1. Added the Eternaland Roaming screen, from which you can access the Eternalands of random players.
2. Added an Eternaland recommendation system. You can use the Island Roaming feature to browse other players' Eternalands.
If you appreciate an Eternaland, you can give it a Like. The more Likes an Eternaland has, the larger its display on the Eternaland Roaming screen. Support your favorite Eternaland now!
[New Weapons]
1. Added the melee weapon blueprint: The Fabled Masamune. It can be purchased in the Blueprint Shop after the update.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/ae0dd53fb8a71ebbae166d2a8803339f4eda7e78.png
[New Cosmetic Items]
1. Lightforge Celebration Crate: Electro Bash will be available for a limited time from September 27, 10:00 AM. "Destruction or celebration? Crank up the volume and hit the gas!"
The Lightforge Celebration Crate comes with a new mechanic: Lightforge Crystals. A Lightforge Crystal is guaranteed every 30 draws, and comes in three varieties: Ⅰ, Ⅱ and Ⅲ. These can be used to select a reward from the corresponding Lightforge Collections: Treasure (Ⅰ), Legend (Ⅱ), and Grand (Ⅲ). Each reward cannot be selected more than once. All Lightforge Crystals are guaranteed within 10 rounds of up to 30 draws each. For more details, please check the relevant screen in the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/7c91cb03faaedb6c24b42ce527635472bc01f040.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/8ac349bfe7fc6ed9cb284f169e92e0d9b96f8aae.jpg
2. The Epic furniture pack "Neon Symphony" is now available. Build a weekend party getaway with your friends! "Neon lights shine at midnight, creating a symphony of colorful luminance."
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/f3e35b8654b22954048969fbe18af0ffb69898c9.jpg
3. New fashion pieces are available! Go to the Shop > Cosmetics > Parts to check out the trendy outfits and become the center of attention!
4. The Epic fashion set "Raven Feather" and value theme pack "Raven Strike" will be available from next week. "The creatures of the night bring an invitation to a dangerous party."
The Epic weapon cosmetics "Wild Hunter - DE.50," "Wild Hunter - MPS7," and "Wild Hunter - HAMR" and their bundle will also be available.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/4ac5e9a84325c823fb0430bb9de2372403e04d62.jpg

[Event Updates]
1. The Northern TourEvent Period: September 26, 2024 (after update) – October 17, 2024, 6:00 AM
The rock band Castle Wishes received an invitation from the north, and the snowy landscape depicted in it made everyone long to go. The decision was immediate: head to the Snowy Realm!
Incidents involving the Snowy Realm will be gradually unlocked as the event progresses. Complete the incidents to obtain furniture blueprints, Starchroms, and more!
Also, if you sign up for the scenario during the event, you'll obtain the exclusive cosmetic "Strawberry Ice Wool Hat" when you join the The Way of Winter scenario!
2. Gather Friends
Event Period: September 26, 2024 (after update) – October 17, 2024, 6:00 AM
Players can generate an invitation link to invite new or returning players to join the game. When a friend uses your invitation code, they will receive a free shared weapon of your choosing, and you will earn Friendship Points that can be exchanged for valuable rewards in the Event Shop.
* Note that invitations and Friendship Points from the second phase will not carry over, but the Event Shop now features even more exciting rewards. Invite your friends now and share the bounty!
* Accounts that have not logged in to the game for at least 14 days are considered returning players.
3. Returnee Event: Get Back on Track
How have you been doing since leaving Nalcott? It's time to come back and see how this continent has changed!
Returning players who meet the conditions will be able to participate in an exclusive event to help you get back on track in Once Human.
Receive valuable rewards including Starchroms, Morphed Deviations, Mitsuko's Mark Loot Crates, Mitsuko's Marks, and more! You'll also get EXP and Load buffs, plus lots of resources to help you along on your adventure!
Event Start: September 26, 2024 (after maintenance), starts when you meet the conditions
Conditions: Accounts that have not logged in to the game for at least 14 days are considered returning accounts, and up to 3 characters from such accounts can take part in the Returnee event. Once triggered, the Returnee event has a 60-day cooldown before it can be triggered again.
Rules: If you enter the game and meet the conditions, a 21-day Returnee event will start. In this event, you will be able to claim gifts and complete special tasks to earn Return Emblems and unlock reward tiers. You can also use Return Emblems to redeem resources and items to help you grow your character.
* To make it easier for you to play with friends, you can also participate in the Returnee event with a new character. The rewards for new and existing characters are different and can be viewed in the game.
III. Optimizations
[Combat]
1. Tactical items, defensive installations, and weapons now have a destructiveness parameter that decides how much damage they deal to different buildings.
For example, the Molotov Cocktail has low destructiveness, so it deals high damage to wood buildings, but less damage to stone and concrete buildings. On the other hand, the RPG7 Rocket Launcher has high destructiveness, so it deals full damage to wood and stone buildings and considerable damage to concrete buildings.
2. Recalibrated the material type and durability (used for damage calculation) of some buildings to align them with unlocked Memetics and building types.
[Social and Chat]
1. Added a background to the chat area with a default transparency of 50%. The transparency level can be adjusted in the Chat Settings.
Instructions: Press Enter to open the chat interface, then click the gear icon to open Chat Settings. Then, go to Chat HUD and adjust the Background Transparency setting.
2. Adjusted the layout of the chat interface. The chat channel will now also change when you switch the display channel. You can still press Tab to change the chat channel when on the General channel.
3. Added a Private chat channel where you can view chats with friends. To quickly reply a message, hover your cursor over the player's name and click the reply button.
4. If you leave the chat interface after entering text, the draft will be kept and can be edited again when you return. The draft is deleted when you close the game client.
[New Journey Tasks]
Added the new Journey tasks: Animal Farmer and Architect: Part II.
[Dungeons]
Added Normal and Hard difficulties to The Forsaken Giant dungeon. Pro difficulty has also been adjusted.
Removed the requirement to reach Phase IV before being able to challenge The Forsaken Giant dungeon.
[Vehicle Obstruction and Other Issues]
We have been working on the issue of vehicles blocking passages in the wilderness, and our backend data now shows that the problem has been somewhat mitigated. Many players have also reported that their vehicles were automatically retrieved after being parked in the wilderness. Our investigations have shown that these vehicles were parked in restricted zones (areas where construction is not permitted).
We are also aware of your requests for trade zones in the wilderness and are currently working on a solution. We will update you once the solution is confirmed.
IV. Bug Fixes
- Fixed the error with the guaranteed drop in Securement Silo EX1.
- Fixed the issue affecting enemies' movement animations when on certain types of terrain.
- Fixed the issues where the Cradle perk "Sustained Suppression" only granted a 15% buff per stack (should be 20%) and did not have a buff icon displayed after being triggered.
- Fixed the issue where the Battle Pass's display effects would sometimes appear on other screens.
- Fixed the issue that would sometimes affect the camera angle when moving a Turret back to a building in Construction mode.
- Fixed the issue affecting some items where, after moving from a scenario to Eternaland, Astral Sand would not be displayed in the Field Guide and, after moving from Eternaland to a scenario, materials would not be displayed in the Field Guide.
- Fixed the issue where, when viewing gear mod details, the display time of the details screen was too short.
- Fixed the issue in Construction mode where glass ceiling models would not align properly.
- Fixed the issue where buff icons in the status bar would be hidden after entering or exiting a scenario.
- Fixed the issue where food would sometimes not be spoiled even when its Durability reached 0.
- Fixed the issue where the icon for Securement Silo EX1 could not be seen on the map.
- Fixed the issue where some Deviations would not work in the player's territory.
- Fixed the issue with the spawning of the "Lethal Rabbit" Deviation in Securement Silo SIGMA.
- Fixed the issue where the player would sometimes be unable to teleport using the "Strange Door" Deviation.
- Optimized the teleport tip shown when a Public Crisis Event is overpopulated.
- Fixed the display issue affecting the hair of female characters wearing the "Human Barricade Academy" fashion set when on the Low graphics setting.
- Fixed the issue where the blouse of the "Human Barricade Academy" fashion set would appear gray under strong light in the wilderness.
- Fixed the issue where, when equipping fashion items, filtering by rarity would cause the icons to be mismatched with the actual preview.
- Fixed the issue where High-Risk Public Crisis Events would become available during the wrong phase.
- Fixed the issue where Buzzy Bee would not increase the chance of obtaining deviated crops.

notes.title: Update Announcement (September 12, 2024)
notes.notes:
Dear Metas,

We're planning a server maintenance and update on September 12 at 12:00 PM Beijing Time. This update brings a significant amount of new content, and the maintenance is expected to last about 4 hours. Please plan your gameplay accordingly for the best experience.
Since the official launch of Once Human, we've been closely monitoring feedback from the community and working on fixes and optimizations. Below are the details of this update.

I. Deviation Adjustments and Optimizations
1. Increased Drop Rate
The drop rate for Morphed Deviations has been increased.
2. Additional Ways to Obtain
- In addition to public areas, we've added new private methods for obtaining Deviations to the wilderness. You can now search neutral securement facilities at the camp for Deviations.
- Deviation drop rates during dungeon settlement have been increased, while Securement Silo acquisition methods remain unchanged.

II. Season Adjustments and Optimizations
World Merge and Territory Relocation:
We've heard your feedback about the dropping player number as Scenarios end. To keep the the social and cooperative excitement alive, we've introduced World Merge in the latest update.
When a Scenario enters the Settlement Phase, worlds will merge. This ensures you can keep engaging with others in a lively and dynamic environment. We will inform you if your World is about to merge. Please make sure to move your territories to a safe World before the merge.

III. Vehicle Optimizations
We've improved the vehicle reporting system. Now you can directly report parked vehicles that are blocking the way.

IV. Public Crisis Event Optimizations and Adjustments
1. High-Risk Public Crisis Events Added
In Phase III of Manibus and Evolution's Call, there's a chance that regular Public Crisis Events will transform into High-Risk Public Crisis Event whens they refresh. In these events, you'll face stronger enemies, but the completion rewards will also be greater.
2."Public Crisis Event - Where Does Disco Go" Adjustment 
We've optimized and lowered the HP of the Big Light Bulb in "Public Crisis Event - Where Does Disco Go" to improve the overall experience for Metas.

V. New Items in Shop
1. New Battle Pass: Nighttime Rose (Available on September 12)
This update introduces the new Epic fashion set "Nighttime Rose", the Epic weapon cosmetic "Dragon Dance - MPS7", the Epic Cradle cosmetic "Deviation Cage", and the Rare furniture series "Commander's Lounge". Tons of stunning cosmetic items are waiting for you! "Join the nighttime banquet and admire the blood-red rose."
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/727ccbaf156c4c991b0a40f6fed2a68ea7fd366c.png
2. Lightforge Loot Crate: Freezing Mist (Available on September 13 at 10:00 AM)
A new limited-time Lightforge Loot Crate is here! The Freezing Mist Loot Crate brings the Legendary fashion set "Ethereal Feathers", the Legendary Cradle cosmetic "Cold Breath", and the Epic weapon cosmetic "Sad Blossom - MPS5". Don't miss out! "They float through the cold mist, like two feathers drifting in the air."
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/39fad4914c4fd5d938bb981be3022b8e02d7f08d.jpg
3. Limited-Time Discount Sets
The Rare fashion set "Wander's Tavern" is now available for only 60 Crystgins! You can also get individual items from the "Future Beats" series for stylish new combinations.
* The special-priced "Modern Era" set will return to its original price after the update.
4. Upcoming Releases
The Epic fashion set "Combat Medic", the value theme pack "Total Healthcare", and new Rare weapon cosmetics such as "Blossoms" and "Dusty", along with mini gift boxes, will also be available next week! "For your health and safety, we recommend following the doctor's advice!"
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/45caa8bcc2ad1f410a8b5502a8917307034e1c3a.jpg
5. Optimizations and Fixes
- Improved the display of namecards in the Shop.
- Optimized the Steam client so users can restart the payment process after interruption.
- Unified the display of item names during purchase to match in-client language and names.
- Improved the Discord community binding process.

VI. Monster Adjustments and Optimizations
1. Super Anomaly - Coherence: Corrupted Voodoo Doll Adjustments
- Increased its size to make aiming and shooting easier in various environments.
- Adjusted defense mechanics: Anti-type weapons now deal more damage and no longer resist other damage types. The Voodoo Doll's HP has been increased accordingly.
2. Super Anomaly - Morphic Adjustments
Box monsters were made less aggressive with increased attack intervals to give Metas more room to survive and counterattack.
3. Super Anomaly Phase - Rosetta Heavy Skill Adjustment
The special skill [Rift Command] has been temporarily disabled due to issues with teleporting to invalid locations. We'll re-enable it once the issues are fixed and the skill experience is improved.

VII. World Map Optimizations
Optimized the Highway Pursuit event's map icons.

VIII. Survival Exploration - Resources Optimizations
Optimized the item acquisition descriptions. You can now view disassembly sources and crafting methods for items.

IX. Character/Camera/Control Optimizations
Climbing and vaulting mechanics have been optimized.
- Press the jump key near obstacles to prioritize jumping.
- When facing a passable obstacle mid-air, your character will now automatically climb or vault over.
- Movement actions are now more aligned with the terrain, and forward distance is more consistent.

X. [Bug Fixes]
1. System/Building Bug Fixes
- Fixed the description for photo frame-related facilities.
- Fixed an issue where corner cabinets couldn't be placed against walls.
- Fixed the missing interaction buttons on vending machines.
- Fixed a bug where pressing the "T" key didn't work on the Withdraw screen.
- Fixed an issue where changes to mini-map settings weren't applied after entering the game.
- Fixed an issue where Deviation drop rates sometimes didn't work as intended.
- Fixed an issue where the Grow Light and sprinklers couldn't be adjusted.
- Fixed an issue where opening namecards sometimes froze the interface.
- Fixed an issue where vending machines didn't show the purchase button when the backpack was full.
- Fixed an issue where vending machines didn't have a button to remove items when fully stocked.
- Fixed an issue where the temporary backpack expiration notice appeared even when no items were present.
- Fixed an issue where the weight reduction effect of Scarlet Calamus didn't work when crafting custom fruit tea dishes.
- Fixed an error in the fox spawns.
- Fixed most clipping issues when placing animals.
- Fixed the incorrect gender display for placed animals.
- Optimized behavior for low-Tameness animals, so they no longer attack Metas or allied units.
- Optimized the display of Message Flowers and fixed abnormal responses when multiple flowers were used together.
- Optimized the use of Message Flowers by automatically generating titles if none are provided.
- Fixed an issue where mining with a pickaxe wasn't working properly after consuming dishes.
- Fixed an issue where items split on the vending machine's Withdraw screen appeared incorrectly.
2. Gameplay Bug Fixes
- Fixed the icon tracking issue of Gameplay - Hales' Moving House. The icon will display and track if you activate the gameplay within the week.
- Fixed an issue in the gathering event where encounter tasks could still be completed after the event ended.
- Fixed issues in Public Crisis Event - Hales' Moving House where, in rare cases, the house's tentacles became unresponsive, blocking event progress. Please contact us if you still encounter the issues.
- Fixed an issue where direct rewards distribution at the end of Public Crisis Event - Cargo Conquest was abnormal.
3. Combat Bug Fixes
- Fixed clipping issues for players in Public Crisis Event - Ancient One.
- Fixed an issue where pistol burst fire didn't always work.
- Fixed a missing effect when balloons were popped in Public Crisis Event - Ancient One.
- Fixed an issue where the monster "Phase" Season Warrior's teleport skill caused player location errors.
- Fixed an issue where the Explosion attribute effect didn't always deal damage when frequently triggered.
- Fixed an issue where the Hammerhead weapon didn't work on primary targets when dealing group damage to electrophoresis Deviation units.
- Fixed an issue where the boss in the Ravenous Hunter dungeon occasionally became stuck.
- Fixed an issue where dungeon audio settings occasionally failed to apply.
- Fixed an issue with incorrect HP for Dr. Mannheim and the Mother of Life in the LEA Research Lab after the last update. Their HP was significantly lower than expected for a boss.

notes.notes:
Dear Meta,

We're committed to addressing your thoughts in the Once Human community, and to resolving issues and enhancing the game accordingly. Here's a summary of the fixes we've implemented:

Bug Fixes (August 30, 2024)
1. About the Frosty Blessing Mod's Delayed HP Recovery
Issue Cause: Because the number of Frost Vortex traps didn't have an upper limit, Icy Rain couldn't replace existing vortexes to trigger the mod's HP recovery effect by generating new ones. 
Instead, players had to wait 4 seconds for the vortexes to disappear before they could recover HP, so players would feel as if there was a delay with the mod's HP recovery effect. We have fixed this bug, so now Icy Rain should bring you the combat experience it's meant to deliver.
We received feedback about weapon adjustments, and we are here to tell you that we will never adjust the stats and effects of any weapon without prior notice. If you find any issue with a weapon, you may report it to us via our feedback platform or community. We will look into the case and resolve it accordingly.
Our plan is to release patch notes to keep you in the loop regarding details of any combat-related changes to be made, and the first of these patch notes will be here shortly. We welcome any suggestions or feedback coming from our player community.

2. Fixed the issue that some players could claim duplicate Manibus (Novice) seasonal rewards.
After looking into this case, we discovered that some players could claim duplicate Manibus (Novice) seasonal rewards after logging into Eternaland. So far, we've identified 72 such cases. We have resolved this issue, and we will review the cases with affected players and remove the duplicate Starchroms from their characters to make it fair for others. We are deeply sorry for any inconvenience this may have caused.

3. Shortened the refresh time of Deviations in the wilderness.
4. Fixed the issue that the Deviation Growshroom wouldn't work in Eternaland.

notes.title: August 29 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Meta,
       Once Human will undergo server maintenance on August 29 at 4:00 AM (UTC). Due to the extensive nature of this update, the maintenance period is expected to last approximately 4 hours. Please plan your gaming sessions accordingly. We appreciate your understanding and continued support.
       Since our global release, the development team has been diligently monitoring feedback and suggestions from the Once Human community. Your input is invaluable, and we are committed to addressing your concerns. Below are the details of the upcoming update:
[Gather Friends]
The "Gather Friends" Event is Live (Phase 2)
Event Period: August 29, 2024 (after maintenance) - September 19, 2024, 6:00 AM
Invite your friends to join the game using a unique invitation code and play together! When your friends use your invitation code, they will receive a free "Shared Weapon" you have prepared, and you will earn Friendship Points. These points can be exchanged for valuable rewards in the Event Shop.
*Please note that invitations and Friendship Points from the first phase will not carry over, but the Event Shop now features even more exciting rewards. Invite your friends now and share the generous prizes!

New Cosmetic Items

notes.title: Important Update on Scenario Registration
notes.notes:
Dear Metas,
Since the beginning of the new season, we've received a wealth of feedback. We’ve noticed that the demand for Hard Difficulty servers is far beyond our expectations. Currently, the number of existing Hard Difficulty servers cannot meet our players’ needs.

After a brief internal discussion, we've made some adjustments based on your suggestions and needs.
1. Due to high demand for more Hard Difficulty servers, we will monitor online activity in real-time and open additional servers as needed. Announcements regarding these openings will be made on our official platforms, allowing players to select their preferred server and plan their playtime accordingly.

We plan to open registration for the following Hard Difficulty servers in advance: 
North America: 
Registration for PVE01-X0050 begins on August 20, 2024, at 7: 00 AM (PDT), labeled Voidbringer, Regeneration, Hard.
Europe: 
Registration for PVE01-X0050 begins on August 20, 2024, at 7: 00 AM (UTC), labeled Voidbringer, Regeneration, Hard.

We will continuously update the list of servers that will be opened in advance and announce it on the official accounts of our channels. Please stay tuned.

Regarding Hard Difficulty servers that our players are highly concerned about, we will provide further explanations here: 
In Hard Difficulty, the amount of Starchrom obtainable through various methods is approximately 8%-9% higher than in Normal Difficulty. This difference applies only to Starchrom obtained from Seasonal Objectives and Purification; rewards from other sources remain the same between Hard and Normal Difficulties.
For the Manibus/Evolution's Call scenario in Normal Difficulty, the combat difficulty has been increased compared to Novice Difficulty. Hard Difficulty offers greater challenges in survival and combat, catering to players seeking a more demanding experience. We aim to provide different difficulty levels to meet the needs of various players, ensuring everyone can find a suitable pace for the second season.

2. To accommodate a diverse range of players and support server development, we have decided to postpone the launch of the Normal Difficulty servers initially scheduled to open after August 20, 2024.
The list of servers with postponed opening: 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/92952e4c8215de6e3b91a423d7984b5f6404c408.jpg

Players who have already registered for the above servers can choose a different server. We will automatically cancel the registration for those who do not do so themselves in the next few days. We will also provide compensation to those affected by this adjustment.
*Hard Difficulty servers will remain on their original schedule.

We deeply value your input and understand the desire for co-op and more challenging experiences. Please continue to send feedback through official channels such as Discord and Customer Support. We are committed to addressing your concerns promptly.

Thank you for your support and we will continue to optimize the game content to bring everyone a better gaming experience!

notes.title: Once Human Patch notes 1.1
notes.notes:
Dear Metas,

Once Human will undergo server maintenance on August 15 at 4:00 AM (UTC). As this update is fairly large, the maintenance is expected to last for 5 hours. Please plan your game time accordingly, and thank you for your understanding and support.
We have been listening to and addressing feedback and suggestions from our community since Once Human's global release. This maintenance will include the following content.

[New Animal Ranching Feature]
A brand-new animal ranching feature is now available. Capture and raise animals, and build the post-apocalyptic ranch of your dreams!
1. Most animals encountered in the open world (including deer, wolves, sheep, wild boars, bears, rabbits, and crocodiles) can be captured and brought back to your territory to be raised. Even more animals will be made available in the future!
2. Each animal has different habits and characteristics. You must build special housing for each type of animal and provide the appropriate food.
3. Once an animal is tame enough, you will be able to collect skins or meat from them.
4. Some animals are aggressive by nature and can even help you defend your territory against Deviant invasions!
* An upcoming September update will even allow you to breed animals to obtain rare and unique critters!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/a3ac4a97aa2b9a4f11c5ee765058613aea5b952e.jpg

[Revamped Fishing System]
Since launch, we've received a lot of valuable feedback concerning the fishing minigame. Players have reported being unable to catch fish or confusion regarding the fishing controls. We understand where you're coming from, so we've revamped some aspects of the fishing system. The waiting time has been reduced, and we've increased the number of fish each Fish Tank can hold.We've also added lots of rare new fish types.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/1841f6472523b4f1277c78ad919c1745dbcd1bea.jpg
1. The new fishing minigame is a battle between your Stamina and the fish's energy. The tension on the fishing line is displayed in the center of the screen. You must reel in the fish as much as possible while keeping the fishing line from snapping. When the fish runs out of energy, you have successfully caught it.
2. Some small fish can now be used as bait. Large and ferocious fish prefer small fish to common bait.
3. Optimized the fish types. Reduced the waiting time required when fishing or reeling in a fish.
4. Added new rare fish: Northern Pike (Blood Jade), Sunfish (Black Rose), Rainbow Trout (Blue Porcelain), Sucker Fish (Spotted), Oscar Fish (Amber), Pompano (Opal), Barracuda (Aquamarine), Koi Fish (Cloud), Guppy (Peacock), Black Bass (Pure White), Bighead Carp (Gold Knife), Sardine (Blood Mark), Tilapia (Red Giant), and Angelfish (Purple Dawn).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/e901aeadee8da77cfc32b46b62684de2f51f20ff.jpg
5. Optimized Fish Tanks to allow them to hold multiple fish at once. Each Fish Tank can hold up to eight fish, depending on the size of the fish.

[New Wilderness Game Modes]
Sproutlet Conquest (Exclusive to Evolution's Call)
Opening Time: Every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday at 4:20 PM server time. 
Locations: A random settlement in Chalk Peak, Lone Wolf Wastes, or Blackheart Region.
Rules: This game mode lasts for 20 minutes. Sproutletite will start spawning 5 minutes after the event starts, and can be obtained through various mining methods. Metas in the event zone will be in PvP teams. During the event, the more Sproutletite you carry, the more Sproutletite you will drop when defeated. 
Rewards: Metas can exchange Sproutletite for Sproutlets at a 1-to-1 conversion rate with Nisa in the camp.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/9a5842a5b94d3139e200352df1e8a8f3ebca38b7.jpg

Ancient One's Trial
People have reported seeing the Ancient One descend upon the highest mountain in Chalk Peak. The Ancient One's trial awaits any Meta who can climb to the top of that tall mountain. Board the Ancient One and face a trial that will test your determination and courage.
Metas who earn the Ancient One's recognition shall receive lots of rewards! Call upon your most trustworthy companions and attempt the Ancient One's trial together!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/5879fc5c6e3c00d9000276c1a921f5707a0160ea.jpg

[Mod Conversion]
1. Mod conversion is unlocked when you reach Lv. 40 in the novice season, or when you enter a non-novice season. The mod conversion function can be accessed from the upper-right corner of the Mod Backpack.
2. You can convert six unenhanced Legendary mods into a Legendary mod with a main attribute of their choice.
3. Mods obtained via conversion may contain basic suffixes (none, Violent, Precision, or Deviant Energy). If four of the six mods used for the conversion contain the same suffix, the converted mod is guaranteed to have that suffix. (This is assuming that the converted mod is able to have their suffix. For example, Lucky 7 cannot have the Precision suffix, and Embers cannot have the Frost Vortex suffix.)
4. The converted mod's attribute levels depend on the attribute levels of the six mods used for the conversion.

[Controller Support]
Once Human now supports game controllers! Experience the game in a different way with your favorite controller.
The game will automatically detect your controller's button layout. Currently, Xbox, PlayStation, and Switch Pro controller layouts are available. If your controller is not correctly recognized by the game, please report your controller's model and your preferred button layout to us.
You may choose from any of the following preset control schemes:
1. Default: Suitable for most Once Human players.
2. Left-Handed: Suitable for left-handed players.
3. Shooter: Similar to most mainstream shooting games.
4. Action: Similar to most mainstream action games.

As controller support is a new feature, we are still optimizing some parts of the game for controllers, and controllers may not work with all features.
We are working hard to make the necessary adjustments and improvements to give you the best experience possible.
Controller support is currently unavailable in the following features:
1. Camera mode
2. Actions relating to weapon or vehicle stickers
3. Playing the piano and other features that may be hard to use with a controller
If the game freezes or any other problem occurs while playing with a controller, please report it to us via our feedback channels. Your opinions and suggestions are important to us. We take them seriously and will address them as soon as possible.
We have also implemented other optimizations regarding keyboards, controllers, and their relevant settings, as follows:
1. Added support for controller vibration. This can be enabled or disabled at the Settings screen.
2. Added support for French and German keyboards. You can choose your keyboard layout at the Settings screen.
3. Optimized the display logic of the Controls settings screen, as well as some of the descriptions, to make it easier to find specific settings.

[Cross-Character Sharing for Paid Content]
Cross-character sharing for paid content is now officially available! Paid cosmetics and premium currencies (such as Crystgin) can be shared by all characters under the same account in the same region. For more information, refer to the Once Human Cross-Character Sharing Rules announcement on our official website.

[Server Invitations]
Special invitation codes are now available. If a server is full, players already on the server can find their special invitation code on their Player Info screen, which can be accessed via the menu. They can then share this special invitation code with their friends. Friends who receive the special invitation code can use it to enter the server even if it is already full.
Note: As servers have restricted capacity, there is still a limit to the number of players who can join each server using special invitation codes. Once a server reaches this limit, no more players may join it, even if they have a code. Hence, it is recommended that you invite your friends as soon as possible. Each player can invite up to five friends.

[Seasons]
Some servers will soon be changing seasons for the first time. The following is some useful information regarding Once Human's season system.
I. What are scenarios and seasons in Once Human? What is the game like in the long term?
We want to offer different survival experiences, so the game has a little something for everyone. We also want to keep updating the game so it's always exciting to play. That is why we've chosen to include multiple scenarios in the game.
A scenario is the gameplay theme of a server. Once Human's global launch initially offered two scenarios, with Manibus focusing on PvE and Evolution's Call centered around PvP.
In September and October, we're bringing in special events featuring new scenario content. September's scenario will involve faction-based PvP, while October will bring a cooperative PvE scenario with a new map and temperature-based survival mechanics. Also in the works are a scenario with unrestricted PvP and a longer season cycle, as well as a perpetual scenario. Furthermore, we plan to release at least four new scenarios every year.
Seasons refer to individual cycles and progress within a scenario. The duration of each season varies according to the scenario. Each season will also be split into multiple phases based on the scenario's features. In-game content will be gradually unlocked as your server progresses through the seasons, ensuring that you always have something new to enjoy. Once all the scenario content is available and the season reaches the transitional phase, you can sign up for a new scenario while keeping your gains from the current scenario. Of course, you can also choose to continue playing and completing objectives on your current server until the transitional phase ends. Currently, the transitional phase is set to last four weeks. That's our vision for the game, which we hope will bring you a multifaceted and consistently engaging experience.

II. How do I sign up for a new scenario?
You can sign up for a new scenario during the final phase of the current scenario. Once you do so, you can start your new journey right away. Alternatively, you may choose not to sign up immediately, and continue exploring and fighting on your current server for up to four more weeks, during which you can sign up for a new scenario at any time.
If you haven't decided on which new scenario to join by the time your server's final phase ends, your current server will be closed and your character will be returned to Eternaland, where you can continue playing or sign up for a new scenario at any time.
If you haven't decided on which new scenario to join by the time your server's final phase ends, your current server will be closed and your character will be returned to Eternaland, where you can continue playing or sign up for a new scenario at any time.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/d409057ae22c11b404e0e39d5cb14a82cbe44c50.jpg

III. When a scenario is over, does that mean I will lose my in-game progress?
No, it does not. We value the effort and time you put into our game. Even when a scenario ends or you exit a scenario midway, you'll be able to keep the rewards you've earned (there are a few rare exceptions, including scenario-specific items or Memetics items ). However, to ensure that each scenario offers a self-sufficient experience and to allow all players to enjoy the game regardless of their progress, we have the following rules in place:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/0a3e026e5c0c0133046d9ee3681cbc5e6b932faa.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/7fa177a08fa5732da9b46e904d201d88e0bad7a6.jpg

IV. How do I bring items from the Eternaland Depot into a new scenario?
You will have a certain amount of Resource Points when entering a new scenario. Each item you choose to bring into the new scenario will cost a certain amount of Resource Points. The actual amount required varies between items and can be checked in the game. You will obtain new Resource Points every time you join a new scenario.

 [Season Optimizations]
In the upcoming season, we are releasing a new scenario with higher difficulty. The scenario will include two combat environments, with each environment containing different Cradle Override combinations, Super Anomaly types, exclusive blueprints, and calibration blueprints. There are also two combat difficulty levels for this scenario: Normal and Hard. On Hard difficulty, Deviants, dungeons, and other challenges will be tougher, but also yield more rewards. You may choose whichever combat difficulty level you prefer.
When the season enters its settlement phase, your personal territory and your vehicles' mobile territory will automatically be saved as house blueprints for use in the new season.

[New Shop Arrivals]
New cosmetics are coming to Once Human! You can view and purchase them in the Shop.
1. The Afternoon Latte fashion set (Rare quality) will be available to purchase after the update. Return to school with this pretty and affordable set!
2. New Epic hairstyles and Rare makeups will be available. You can view them in Cosmetics - Hair and Makeup.
3. The Teddy Warrior fashion set (Epic quality) and Teddy Partner discounted theme pack will be available after the update. This versatile warrior fights, heals, and even carries a chilled backpack full of ice-cold drinks!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/cbeba64fb9d834b3d4d1b71281a2f5b6574a42d0.jpg
4. Lightforge Loot Crates are now available! Open the Lightforge Loot Crate to receive a guaranteed cosmetic, as well as a chance to obtain Lightforge Collection cosmetics! You will not receive duplicate Lightforge Collection cosmetics. A Lightforge Collection cosmetic is guaranteed within 30 openings. Duplicate cosmetics obtained will be converted into tokens that can be used to redeem Lightforge Loot Crate rewards or Siderite.
5. The Pyro Glide vehicle cosmetic (Legendary quality), Psychedelic Skull fashion set (Legendary quality), and Primordial Flame weapon cosmetic (Epic quality) will be available on August 16. Open the Lightforge Loot Crate for a chance to get these limited-edition collectibles. Embrace the eternal flames and soar to freedom!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/0738f1e804b1cb89e421666982a0a2ab7e8dcde4.jpg

[Event Updates]
1. Wilderness Express: starts on August 15
Enjoy racing through the wilderness alone or as a team, and earn points for mileage and collisions. Reach the required score to claim rewards including Starchrom and the limited-edition Fulfilled Wish Vest cosmetic!
- Secure on Sight: starts on August 22
During the event, defeat enemies to earn loot crates which may contain specimen cards. Collect specimen cards and fill out the Field Guide to earn rewards.
* Refer to the event screen for detailed rules.

Please click the link below to check more optimizations:
