notes.title: Once Human Official Release FAQ
notes.notes:
Once Human Official Release FAQ

1. Platforms and Servers
Q1: How many characters can I create on the same account?
A1: In response to user feedback, we have expedited the re-introduction of the multiple character creation feature. You are now able to create characters across all servers and embark on adventures alongside your companions.

The decision to temporarily disable multiple character creation was made due to the suboptimal gameplay experience associated with this feature. Originally, we aimed to re-enable this functionality following its refinement by August 1. Regrettably, this approach resulted in a diminished gaming experience, for which we extend our sincere apologies.

Q2: Are game accounts cross-platform? Can I play on multiple platforms?
A2: Once Human accounts are cross-platform. If you log in using the same account, you will gain access to your character, regardless of platform.
However, cross-platform support is not available for some account types, such as Steam accounts, due to their inherent limitations. We will be adding more account options in the future to make it easier for you to play across platforms. For now, please choose your platform based on your personal preferences.

Q3: Can I play with players on other platforms if I log in using Loading Bay?
A3: Of course you can! All platforms have access to the same servers. Whether you log in through Loading Bay, Steam, or any other platform, you will be able to play with your friends so long as you are all on the same server.

Q4: What are seasons in the game? And what are scenarios?
A4: Once Human has a season system. Each server only exists for a single season, and only has a single scenario. The content available on the server depends on its scenario. Every scenario offers different rules, environments, and stories to diversify your experience.
When your current server's season ends, you can move all resources and items you have earned during the season to your personal domain at Eternaland. You will then be able to register for another season.
To make things easier to understand, we will have two servers at launch: Manibus (PvE only) and Evolution's Call (includes PvP content). You are free to choose whichever server you prefer.
We have many scenarios in reserve and are currently developing new scenarios. Keep an eye out for later announcements regarding new scenarios, they should be coming very soon.

Q5: Which scenario should I choose, Manibus (PvE) or Evolution's Call (PvP)?
A5: To make things simple for new players, Manibus (PvE) and Evolution's Call (PvP) will be similar at launch, with basically the same rules, content, and story. The main differences are as follows.
1. Manibus (PvE) does not include any PvP content. You will be able to fight powerful monsters and experience open-world survival with your friends and at your own pace.
2. Evolution's Call (PvP) includes PvP content, such as Stronghold Conquest. Nearly all PvE content will also be available, so you will still be able to enjoy fighting fearsome entities.
Rewards in both scenarios are the same. You should choose your scenario based on whether or not you want to take part in PvP content.


Q6: Will I lose all my rewards and items when a season ends? If not, which items will I keep?
A6: At the end of a season, you get to keep important resources like Blueprints, Cosmetics, Furniture Formulas, and Weapon Accessories. 
However, common resources, weapons, and items will be transferred to your personal domain, Eternaland, to maintain fairness.  Some resources in Eternaland can be carried over to a new season, while others can be used to construct your personal domain.
Eternaland offers freedom for customization, and we plan to add more features to encourage user-generated content. You can design Eternaland as you like and invite friends to join in the fun.

2. System Requirements and Installation
Q1. What languages does Once Human currently support?
A1: At launch, the PC version of Once Human is available in English, German, French, Japanese, Korean, and Traditional Chinese. We plan to add Russian and Spanish in September, and aim to support more languages in the future. Stay tuned for updates!
If you want the game to support your language, please let us know.
Just drop us a message on the Customer Service channel in the Feedback section on our Discord server.


Q2: What are the minimum and recommended system requirements?
A2: The following requirements are a reference for playing Once Human at 1080p.
Minimum:
OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
CPU: Intel Core i5-4460
RAM: 8GB RAM
GPU: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti, 4 GB or AMD Radeon R9 270
DirectX: Version 11
Available Storage Space: 55GB

Recommended:
OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
CPU: Intel Core i7-7700
RAM: 16GB RAM
GPU: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060, 6 GB or AMD Radeon RX 580
DirectX: Version 11
Available Storage Space: 55GB SSD

For 60 fps performance:
OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
CPU: Intel Core i5-12400F
RAM: 16GB RAM
GPU: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6650 XT
DirectX: Version 11
Available Storage Space: 55GB SSD

Q3: Why does Once Human require so much storage space and RAM?
A3: Once Human offers a high-quality audiovisual experience. This requires a large amount of storage space for HD images, textures, sound effects, and map files. Additionally, as an MMO survival game, we aim to render long viewing distances so that players can see structures in the world as far as possible. We are continuously working to optimize the game for the best possible experience. Thank you for your understanding.


Q4: Why can't I change the install location of Loading Bay?
A4: While trying to change Loading Bay's install location, you may receive no response when you click the Browse button. If this occurs, try deleting all Once Human and Loading Bay files from your device, then download and install them again.
If you have not previously installed Loading Bay, and receive no response when you click the Browse button to change the install location, then please contact us via the Customer Service channel in the Feedback section on our Discord server
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42949884/4ec3efedfd2406dc99950df644b2794b3aa5d35b.png
Note: We are planning to release an update that will allow you to migrate the game files to a new location in the future. Stay tuned for more information!

Q5: The language I chose when installing Loading Bay is not available in Once Human. How do I fix this?
A5: When you install Loading Bay, you are asked to select a language for the launcher. However, Once Human has separate language settings available inside the game. We are working on adding more supported languages. Thank you for your understanding.

Q6: Why can't I switch to a different Loading Bay account?
A6:If you wish to switch to a different game account, you must first log out of your current Loading Bay account, then log in using your new account. We will continue to optimize account features to make it easier to switch accounts in the future.

Q7: When I click the Download button, nothing happens. How do I fix this?
A7: Check if you are using a VPN. If so, disable the VPN, then restart the client and re-download Once Human.

Q8: What should I do if the game fails to download or install?
A8: Check if your network connection is stable and that your device meets the minimum requirements. Try restarting the client or deleting all game files, then reinstall Once Human. If the issue persists, contact Customer Service in the Feedback section on our Discord server.
Tip: Before installing Once Human, check if you have sufficient storage space on the installation drive to avoid any problems with installing the game.

Q9: I get a low frame rate when playing Once Human. What should I do?
A9: Try reducing the game's graphics settings to increase the frame rate. For instance, 
a) Lower the resolution.
b) Lower special effects or texture quality.
c) Lower the rendering quality or other settings.
You can find these settings by pressing [ESC] → [Settings] → [Graphics] → [Performance].

Q10: My device exceeds Once Human's minimum system requirements. Why am I still getting slow performance in the game?
A10: Even if your device exceeds Once Human's minimum system requirements, slow performance could result from several factors. Try reducing graphics settings such as texture quality to improve the game's performance.
If you encounter slowdown during your playthrough, report it to our Customer Service in the Feedback section on our Discord server.

Q11: The game keeps crashing. How do I fix it?
A11: If the game keeps crashing or if you encounter any graphical errors, try updating your drivers or repairing the game client. If the issue persists, go to Customer Service in the Feedback section on our Discord server, and we will assist you as soon as possible.
Certain controllers, such as pedals and gearbox controls for driving games, or joysticks for flying games, may cause compatibility errors with Once Human. If you have any such controllers attached, try disconnecting them.

Q12: How do I give feedback if I encounter any problems?
A12: Visit https://discord.gg/ryyy9GtP to join our official Discord server, then send your feedback to our Customer Service in the Feedback section on our Discord server.
Method 1: Go to Customer Service in the Feedback section on our Discord server and follow the instructions.
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42949884/32234b2d30814941ce599a4cb62de45071f1d694.png
Method 2: Join our official Discord server, click on [Show Member List] in the top right corner, then click [Once Human Game Support] to send us a direct message.
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42949884/8b6d3b52ecbcfa3ac6905a1ab384584d3d6c6a65.png


Q13. Will Once Human support DLSS at launch?

Once Human does not support DLSS at launch due to the ongoing optimization and integration of certain features. However, DirectX 12 is supported, although it might result in a slight frame drop compared to DirectX 11.

Q14. Will Once Human support controllers and Steam Deck at launch?

Due to ongoing technical adjustments, Once Human does not support controllers and Steam Deck at launch. Our development team is actively working on changes to bring controller support as soon as possible. We expect to complete this by August.


3. In-game Rewards
Q1: Will there be any launch rewards for the official release?
A1: In celebration of Once Human making it to the top five on Steam's Global Top Wishlist, all players will receive milestone rewards.

Q2: How do I claim my rewards for participating in the CBT?
A2: Lightforge Medals will be delivered to the mailbox of your first character. Other rewards, such as Cosmetics and Avatars, will be sent to the email address you provided as Redemption Codes. You can then redeem these codes in the game.
Note: Lightforge Medals can only be redeemed to the same account used during the CBT. If you encounter any issues, contact us via the in-game Customer Service.

Q3: Where can I follow Once Human on social media?
A3: You can follow us on the following social media platforms to gain access to the latest news and events.
Discord: https://discord.gg/oncehuman
X (English): https://twitter.com/OnceHuman_
X (Japanese): https://twitter.com/OnceHuman_JP
Facebook (English): https://www.facebook.com/OnceHumanOfficial
Facebook HMT: https://www.facebook.com/OnceHumanHMT
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@oncehuman_official
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@oncehuman_official
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/OnceHumanOfficial/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/oncehuman_official/
NAVER: https://game.naver.com/lounge/Once_Human/home


Q4: What free cosmetics and rewards are available during the launch period?
A4: You can obtain all weapons and gear in the game for free. Additionally, you can unlock over 700 rewards as you explore the expansive 256 square kilometers open world. These rewards include 400 unique weapons and weapon accessories, 200 building modules, 100 armor types, and numerous cosmetic items. Stay tuned for the latest events and announcements for more details.

4. For Veteran Players
Q1: I lost my Redemption Code from Steam Next Fest. Can I recover it or receive a new one?
A1: No, we are unable to re-send Redemption Codes.

Q2: I have an existing installation of Once Human. Do I need to delete it before downloading the official release?
A2: Yes, you will need to delete previous game versions and launchers and re-download the game.


Other
Q: How do I report rule violations by other players? How do I appeal if I've been falsely reported by other players?
A: You can report cheating or other violations on our official Discord server. Visit https://discord.gg/oncehuman and join our Discord server, then file the report using the Anti-cheat Bot.
After joining our Discord server, click the [Show Member List] button in the top right corner, click [Anti-cheat Bot], and send a direct message to file the report.
Provide as much information as possible to help us verify and address the issue quickly.
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42949884/a514aeb715385f342bcbc7971473d200763b59e1.png

notes.title: ONCE HUMAN March Beta test with new trailer and new Mobile version
notes.notes:
Dear Metas,

As always, thank you for being part of this developing journey with us. We're thrilled to announce the March Beta test and share our new multiplayer trailer! Additionally, we're excited to reveal the new Mobile version.
A new gameplay trailer The trailer showcases various survival adventures in an anomalous world, where players can utilize firearms and supernatural abilities to fend off powerful Aberrant creatures. It also introduced exciting new features like the new Deviant gameplay. In addition to the trailer, we're excited to unveil our plans for a beta test on both PC and a brand new mobile version of the game, scheduled to start on March 28th, 2024.
We can't wait for players to have new adventures in our world!

New Trailer:
[previewyoutube=7MEJP6H2mLA;full][previewyoutube=7MEJP6H2mLA;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]
Once Human is an SCP-inspired multiplayer open-world survival game, where teams of players use firearms and supernatural abilities to survive against the unknowable and powerful Aberrant creatures that threaten the last remnants of mankind. Players must band together to unite survivors, rebuild the territory, and uncover the mysteries of their enemies, or risk destruction. 
 
Our game is currently ranked #2 on the STEAM wishlist for most anticipated multiplayer online survival game. It garnered significant player attention during its last Beta, with over 300,000 sign-ups within a week, and has so far garnered more than 330,000 Discord community members.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/58d8e8b4b6dc1c4533b790798898718f3a3009d3.png 
New feature, new monster and new area available for upcoming Beta
A variety of innovative gameplay elements will show up in our new Beta. These include new monsters showcased in the trailer, featuring a creature with a drill bit head, as well as other formidable new bosses. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/6420862878e7c0badd75d8f86b93e73dc87e5c41.png
Additionally, Metas can explore the much-anticipated Eternaland, a new personalized area where they have the freedom to construct diverse buildings, territories, and puzzle-solving. Furthermore, following the advice of players in the previous Beta, a brand-new PVP season will make its debut in this upcoming test! 
 
The new beta would also include the newly added Deviant gameplay, hints of which are hidden in the newly released trailer. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/5e3fab1e338ceb8dd8385a10d5eb1bde8044b020.png
New trailer demonstrates multiplayer gameplay and reveals hidden clue
With the announcement of the Beta, we released an exciting new trailer, which demonstrates the numerous in-game multiplayer gameplay modes available as players team up to explore the anomalous world and gather resources to build their shelter. They can also delve into aberration-ridden caves, board long-legged buses in search of treasure, and defend their territory from monsters alongside their comrades. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/d62a37a1873f98c2bba4214a92f9c09c8c3d9185.png  
At the end of the video, our Metas is accompanied by a magic alpaca, who instantly produces a rabbit from a hat that can be used as a food source, making people wonder if this could be a clue that a pet or companion gameplay will be coming in the future.

Access to join the coming Beta
Our new Beta will be open from March 28th, 2024.
To join the beta, be sure to visit our official Once Human website (https://www.oncehuman.game/) and secure your spot in advance.
The mobile version test registration is now on-going while pre-download for PC users will soon be available as well.
Don't forget to wishlist it on Steam!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/d6aa2d06fe3011737b2a36f54ef5734e9af0ceea.png
Keep up, Metas! Once Human is planned to launch in Q3, 2024!

To learn more about Once Human, please follow us on social media and wishlist it on Steam.

notes.title: Dev Blog - Update includes fishing, spatial transformations and new enemy types
notes.notes:
Double the Watery Fun - Catch the New Giant Northern Pike and Use it to Craft a New Weapon
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/b58eef7dcc53d46c472149bd33c34da00ad2918e.gif
Firstly, we are excited to introduce a new fishing system and easter egg melee weapon for Once Human! Players can now fish at any body of water in the game. If you're lucky enough to catch a "Giant Northern Pike," you can choose whether to cook it or to keep it as a pet in your fish tank. Players can also customize the aquatic plants and decorations that are displayed inside their fish tanks.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/53189cdb309fb5a40cce906fbbb64e99807bbb28.jpg
Alternatively, you can also try using your new Northern Pike as a melee weapon. (Better than a slap in the face with a wet kipper? I'll get my coat...)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/6fd87f7ef1aa28511faee6f71cdf9e2f70180699.jpg
If you don't yet have the materials to craft a fish tank, you're not hungry, and you generally prefer non-piscatory weapons, you can also freeze your new fishy friend by placing it in a refrigerator. And as it happens, a frozen Northern Pike packs an even greater punch at close range, with increased damage and a chance to inflict a slowdown effect on enemies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/e97fe46cb448dc59fadc0f631bb358b802840ca5.jpg
However, this is only a temporary weapon boost. As soon as you step outside of specific areas, the Pike will start to thaw out again. Dead fish can't be placed in fish tanks, but can still be used as an ingredient in cooking. Or, if you're a fan of the man-posing-with-fish aesthetic, you can also mount the fish on a wooden board and hang it on your wall.
PS: We would like to thank players @TWG-Jnutt12#2089 @ItsAnge#0013 @Mad Doggo#0001 @DoW Overlord Reborn#1910 for their invaluable suggestions regarding the fishing system and easter egg weapon design. We greatly appreciate your input, and welcome all players to send us their creative gameplay ideas!

Journey Across Time and Space - Rift Space Transformation Mechanic
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/fe4531e589ce53638a062a996d712c42f9272941.jpg
Rift Spaces are pockets of spatial chaos brought about by the power of Stardust, and connect this world to other spatial dimensions. After the Starfall, a number of large and highly mutated Deviations flooded into the human realm. Rosetta is able to secure smaller Deviations in underground bases, but giant, highly mutated Deviations can only be secured in Securement Silos, which are guarded around the clock by a squad of highly-trained Rosetta troops. The gates to these Securement Silos are locked, and players can only gain access to a Silo by obtaining the access card by killing and looting the elite Rosetta troops that are found in the open world. Once you've got the access card, call up your friends and challenge the Silo together to earn generous rewards. And watch out for reality-bending Rift Spaces that may be hidden within.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/6514418d3e09b3f95593f076e1117ebfd0feee0b.jpg
Rift Spaces function a lot like wormholes. They cause the player to shrink once they step inside. Inside a Rift Space, mice and even cockroaches suddenly become deadly threats, but on the other hand, players can also take advantage of their diminutive state to pass through narrow gaps and explore previously inaccessible locations.
Right now, we are still working to optimize and improve this Rift Space mechanic, as well as figuring out ways to flesh out the gameplay in interesting ways. However, we can say for sure that this system will only exist in specific raid modes, so players do not need to worry about Rift Spaces while exploring the open world. Rift Space research is a closely-guarded Rosetta secret, after all.

Introducing a New Deviant 'Seers'
We are excited to introduce a new Deviant species, the 'Seer' (subspecies 'mechahumanoid'). These gruesome humanoid Deviants stand at 5 to 6 feet tall, and have some kind of mechanical/electronic device sprouting out of their neck in place of a head. According to a recent Deviant behavioral report, it seems that the Seer's physical and behavioral characteristics are determined by the type of machinery that it has 'fused' with.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/6ae25e4931c1650d5b288d7c8348f3f934282af5.jpg
As mechahumanoids, Seers are formed when a humanoid Deviant parasitizes on a piece of surveillance or monitoring equipment. It seems that they are also able to alert other nearby Deviants to an intruder's presence, and function as patrol units within Deviant-invested areas. When a Seer spots a player, it will summon their fellows to surround and attack the player en masse.
  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/d9e5e5ffb9f34c7c6343284bc7cbf2c923785bef.gif
But Seers are not invincible. An effective way to defeat a Seer is to find a way to break its head-mounted flashlight, without alerting the Seer to your presence. This will blind the Seer, rendering it much more vulnerable.
We are working on adding more creative new monster types into Once Human in the coming months, and ideas from within our community are especially welcome! If you want to keep up with the latest Once Human news, or have a cool gameplay idea you want to share with the team, come join the Once Human Discord server!

To learn more about Once Human, please visit:
Official Website: https://www.oncehuman.game/

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/OnceHuman-108731781483917/

Discord: https://discord.gg/oncehuman

Twitter: https://twitter.com/OnceHuman_

notes.title: Update on co-op territory construction
notes.notes:
Based on feedback from the community, we understand that many players are very concerned about how the co-op elements will be implemented in our post-apocalyptic world. As a team, our goal has always been to create a game that is fully interactive and offers a realistic survival experience, and we’ve always considered co-op features to be central to achieving this goal.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/2e29595bdf447723ea65e272c93ebd62f25325ed.jpg
In this Closed Beta Test, you will be able to build your territory with your teammates, share resources, and work together to create a personalized place. 

【Gathering& Upgrading】
The territory is where everything starts. Facilities, decorations, and crafting equipment - as you consume more resources, you’ll be able to unlock new territory features. Teamwork is the key to building a strong territory. Work together with your friends to gather the resources you need and upgrade your home!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/a7de0b07aa73d79fc94a0618727c98d45590e13b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/7ea8cf429a3f4afc2b4a3df4c645d4f2d7a60a05.jpg

【Get ready for them!】
Your territory is both your headquarters and your shelter. But be cautious! THEY are watching! Beasts, Deviants, and even fellow human beings can all pose a serious threat to your territory. This cruel world makes people do horrible things, including joining the violent, hostile marauder gang. Danger lurks even within the natural environment itself, so make sure your shelter can protect you from extreme weather events, such as sandstorms and thunder. A well-designed territory should include a closed building structure surrounded by protective turrets and traps. Your home could be attacked at any time, so don’t make it too easy for ’em!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/ad7cdbddb61584898bea59655111139327565067.jpg

【Decoration& Design】
Ok, so you’ve built your shelter and installed some defenses. Now it’s time to have a little fun. Once Human offers a variety of different furniture options, including couches, wallpapers, and lighting, and a flexible construction system allows you to build structures however you see fit. Use your imagination, and make your shelter unique. Weare looking forward to seeing you guys get creative!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/ae05b5bf5f1a24ea8f01195965bdb47b96934a37.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/bb9b146748c38f7cb099a819da356784d0d15bc0.jpg

【Let there be light!】
Great job! Once you’ve built and decorated the perfect shelter, you’ll need to find a source of electricity to get the place up and running. Our electricity system was specially designed to enrich and expand the scope of territory building. It’s not just about keeping the lights on - most defensive and production facilities will require electricity in order to function. So, make sure to get yourself some generators and hook them up. Only then is your territory truly finished. Generators come in many forms: hydro, wind, biomass, solar, and even Deviation. That’s right, in this world you can burnStardust to generate energy!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/532f7ffa8f5660b4f99ecd720c1f05711bfa36c2.jpg

So come on Metas, get ready to do some building!

notes.title: DEV BLOG-Update on World Exploration, PVP and Character Performance
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/b0954440f025ff14a6c312afc800e0cbbab87c87.jpg
Hey Metas! The main focus of this dev blog will be all the latest updates and content changes for the upcoming CBT. We’re excited to share these changes, and give you a window into our development process. So, without further ado, let’s get going!

1 Going All in on World Exploration

We have added a lot of new content to our upcoming CBT. One big change was the ability to challenge the Great Ones. In our game-world, the Great Ones are a race of evil, god-like beings threatening to dominate the human world. As a Meta, your role is to fight back against the onslaught, cleanse the land, and drive the Great Ones back. In our upcoming CBT, players can now put their skills to the ultimate test by challenging the Great Ones in a special new game play feature. We hope that this new challenge mode will appeal to all our players, regardless of whether you prefer be always in the center of the action, or off to the sidelines, building your base, and hanging out with your friends. So, Metas! Grab your favorite weapon and get ready to fight, win, and take back this world!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/b11e030127e31716730aba68c4cd8ff91de1681d.jpg

Besides challenging the Great Ones, this most recent update will also include a number of special new hidden areas waiting for keen-eyed Metas to discover, such as Securement Silos. These Silos are special facilities built by Rosetta in order to control and study Deviations whenever they appear. Some of these Securement Silos are still under Rosetta's control, while others have been taken over by Deviants or infected with Stardust pollution. You’ll need to work together with your fellow Metas to discover and purge these Securement Silos, and make it back out with the loot. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/7b25a867d0976883b473cadd78c114c133092bb2.jpg

2 Enhanced PvP Gameplay

We have also tried to enhance our PvP gameplay elements through the addition of the Chaos feature. Chaos players are human players who have entered a Chaos state, during which they can attack other players and their territories to loot resources. If you’re looking for a hardcore PvP experience, chose the PvP server and experience the thrill of all-out sever-wide warfare. Watch your back out there, Meta.

However, we understand that not everyone likes this kind of intensity, and as a result, we’ve also created a dedicated PvE server for the upcoming test. In this server Chaos players can only target other Chaos players, allowing Metas to opt out of this new feature whenever they want.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/ff4739107db289151ae150822a7fbb848fd304c5.jpg
In addition to the threat posed by Chaos players, your squad can also get the chance to compete against other players in large-scale group combat. If you prefer being part of a team than fighting alone, this is the feature for you. In this upcoming test, players will be able to build Territories together with friends and occupy nearby resource points. Continued occupation will yield extremely rare resources, allowing you to craft the best weapons and tactical gear. But, be warned. If you want to wear the crown, you must learn to bear its weight. The bigger and richer your Territory becomes, the more threats you’ll face. Be ready - invading players may launch an attack at any time.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/4d46c71fad2e5665f22fb35be77fc10e033acf9c.jpg
As your group grows in size, you will have opportunities to assert your ownership over the most important core strongholds in each region. Peaceful negotiation or conquest by force – the choice is yours. How you build your territory is also entirely up to you. Want to play it safe? Build an impenetrable fortress. Got an eye for design? Let your creative juices flow!

3 Better Character Performance
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/7cda61023c5a29cd772640420976806992fda659.jpg
In addition, we’ve also been working on a more expansive range of combat gear for Metas. Learn to craft weapons and other items by acquiring blueprints and gathering the required materials. This is the key to making yourself stronger and leveling up your character. Gathering is the way to get your hands on important in-game items that may give you the upper hand in combat, or just because you want your character to have the best-looking gear.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/1abb272861fb31e3934244e922ae2f8e8dfde4eb.jpg
Based on player feedback, we have also fully optimized  the characters' basic movements and the way they interact with the various environments of the world for this upcoming test. We hope that we’ve succeeded in making our game-world more realistic and immersive, empowering our players to become the hero of their own story.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42949884/2107b0ab1961ca930926cdbf029d4a1103271c36.gif
This is just a snapshot of all the changes we’ve been working on for this upcoming test. Keep an eye on this dev blog for further details about next month’s CBT. Please stay tuned and leave your comments, letting us know what you’d like us to cover in our next post.
